prompts.prompt:
Ultra-realistic spontaneous vertical handheld vlog during a warm evening at a small local amusement fairground in Poland, early 15th century, around 1410.

FORMAT: Native vertical recording, 3:4 aspect ratio. The entire video is filmed vertically in portrait orientation. Never switch to landscape.

The footage should look like real footage casually recorded by a friend during a fun summer evening. Warm natural evening light, firelight and low sun. Slightly imperfect exposure. Real people, real reactions, real movement. No cinematic filmmaking. No staged acting. No influencer-style posing.

MAIN WOMAN

A young Polish woman in her twenties, plain and ordinary looking, no makeup, sun-touched skin, loosely braided brown hair with strands falling loose. She wears a plain belted linen dress in an undyed muted color, a simple woolen overdress, leather shoes, no jewelry. Her face, hair, build and clothing must stay exactly consistent from the first frame to the last. No identity drift, no facial morphing, no costume changes.

0–3 seconds

The camera is already recording vertically while the group walks through the fairground between wooden stalls and towering timber ride frames. The main woman walks with two friends, talking casually, holding a small baked snack. She suddenly notices the wooden rollercoaster and gets excited. She hurries toward it while looking back at her friends. The person filming follows naturally, causing handheld shake. A stranger briefly walks between the camera and the group. The framing is imperfect and spontaneous. Ends with her at the base of the ride, craning to look up, friends catching up.

3–6 seconds

She climbs into a small open wooden cart at the top of a launch ramp while a stallholder holds a rope brake. She grips the sides and concentrates seriously for a moment. The cart drops and she shrieks and laughs. Her friends laugh behind the camera. The camera whips to follow the cart down the timber track and briefly loses it. Ends with the cart slowing on the run-out, her hair wrecked, still laughing. Nobody looks prepared or posed.

6–9 seconds

The group continues walking past food stalls and a hand-cranked carousel where two men push a capstan to turn carved wooden horses. The camera casually follows from the side. The main woman suddenly stops because something catches her eye. One friend jokingly walks past holding a wooden bowl of food and refuses to share it. She laughs and follows him for a few steps. Another friend says something funny from behind the camera. Everyone laughs naturally. People casually pass through the frame, briefly blocking parts of the scene.

9–12 seconds

The group moves away from the crowd into a quieter muddy lane behind the rides, past a huge timber ferris wheel turning slowly, powered by people walking inside a wooden treadwheel drum. The main woman and her friend compare the food they bought. She casually takes a bite from her friend's without asking. He reacts with playful annoyance. She laughs and quickly walks away. The camera operator laughs and follows her, stumbling slightly on the rutted ground. She turns back toward the camera while walking and makes a playful expression before turning forward again.

12–15 seconds

The group walks back toward the warm torchlight of the fairground. The main woman notices that the camera is still recording and naturally smiles toward it. She starts to wave, but one of her friends accidentally walks between her and the camera. Everyone laughs. The camera tilts slightly as the person filming adjusts their grip. The final frame naturally catches the glowing torches, the turning wheel, people walking around, and the group moving forward before the recording casually cuts off.

CAMERA REALISM

Authentic vertical handheld home-video footage. Natural handheld movement with imperfect framing, realistic walking and movement shake, occasional autofocus breathing, automatic exposure changes, realistic evening highlights and shadows, realistic motion blur, slight rolling-shutter movement, occasional accidental cropping of people, natural lens flare from torches, minor exposure fluctuations, realistic distance and perspective.

The camera operator should behave like a real friend, not a professional videographer. Sometimes the camera should point slightly too low, too high, too close, or briefly lose the main woman. The camera should react naturally to the people and action instead of moving perfectly.

ENVIRONMENT

A small local amusement fairground in early 15th century Poland, warm evening. Every ride built entirely from timber, rope, leather straps, iron pins and counterweights, powered by hand cranks, capstans, treadwheels, animals or gravity. No metal frames, no paint, no machinery beyond rope and gear.

Rides and structures: a tall wooden rollercoaster of pegged beams and scaffolding with small open carts running in a hollowed timber track, a carousel of carved wooden horses turned by men pushing a capstan, a large ferris wheel of timber spokes with hanging plank benches turned by a walking treadwheel, a rope-and-plank swing on a timber A-frame, a strength-test post with a mallet and sliding wooden block, an archery stall with straw targets, a juggler and a fire-eater working a small crowd.

Around them: wooden trestle stalls with linen awnings, barrels and wicker baskets, clay cups and wooden bowls, hanging bread and cured meat, pitch torches and horn lanterns, muddy rutted ground churned by feet, timber-framed and thatched houses at the edges, a church tower in the distance, carts and tethered horses, chickens, summer vegetation, a light evening breeze.

Local people in period dress: linen tunics, woolen hose, hooded cloaks, simple belted dresses, married women in linen head coverings, leather shoes, a few merchants in dyed wool. Families, children running, teenagers, older townsfolk.

Everything should feel lived-in and ordinary rather than a tourism commercial or a historical reenactment. It should feel like a real local event that people attend every year.

HUMAN REALISM

Natural facial expressions, natural blinking, natural eye movement, natural laughter, natural body movement, natural walking and gestures. No perfect poses. No exaggerated reactions. Background people should behave independently and naturally. Every person should have a unique face, hairstyle, outfit and movement. People should not look at the camera unless naturally prompted by the situation.

AUDIO

Recorded on a poor built-in microphone: muffled, unedited, uneven levels.

Spoken Polish, short and simple only: a friend calling "Hej!" early on; the main woman shrieking and then laughing on the ride; a friend saying "Dawaj!" near the food stalls; a friend protesting "Ej! Nie!" when she takes his food; the main woman answering "No co?" through laughter at the end. All dialogue is one to three syllables, casual, partly buried under crowd noise. No long sentences. Speakers are mostly off-camera, turned away, or at distance, so no clear lip-sync is required.

Ambience: fairground crowd murmur, footsteps in mud, creaking timber and rope, the rumble of wooden cart wheels on the track, a hand drum and pipe playing off to the side, horses, chickens, children shouting, crackling torches, light evening wind, indistinct background chatter.

No dramatic soundtrack. No artificial sound effects.

STRICT RESTRICTIONS

No modern amusement park elements: no steel frames, no painted signage, no electric lights, no neon, no ticket booths, no safety bars, no plastic. No modern clothing, hairstyles, glasses, watches, zippers, buttons, printed fabric, glass windows, metal poles, wires or modern architecture. No phones or cameras visible in frame. No armor, knights, banners or battle imagery.

No cinematic color grading. No beauty filter. No slow motion. No professional camera movement. No artificial stabilization. No staged influencer behavior. No duplicated people. No cloned faces. No identity drift. No facial morphing. No plastic skin. No perfect symmetry. No exaggerated expressions. No AI-looking crowd behavior. No text. No subtitles. No logos. No watermark. No landscape shots.

FINAL FEEL

It should look like a completely impossible piece of found footage — an ordinary summer evening at a village funfair six hundred years ago, captured spontaneously by a friend. It must feel like a real video from someone's camera roll, not an AI-generated historical film.

PROMPT (ran in @higgsfield)

[Characters]
<the protagonist> corresponds to [PROTAGONIST REFERENCE 1]. Use only the appearance, hairstyle, and clothing.
<the antagonist> corresponds to [ANTAGONIST REFERENCE 2]. Use only the shifting architectural silhouette and violet energy. [Scenes]
<the concourse> references [LOCATION REFERENCE 3].
Use only the spatial layout, raw concrete architecture, and blue twilight lighting. Do not use the people in the image. Do not interchange the characters' appearances, clothing, actions, positions, or dialogue. No text overlaid anywhere in the frame.

[Stage 1] 0s - 2s
Initial state: The protagonist is backed against a concrete pillar, eyes darting left. Composition holds DEPTH: near / mid / far — cracked tile close, protagonist mid, distant storefront far.
Primary event: A mass of jagged shadow and violet light, the antagonist, erupts from a shattered storefront 20 feet away. Prismatic highlights fracture across broken glass shards.
End state: The antagonist is fully visible, hovering mid-air, facing the protagonist. <Loud glass shattering> <Low ethereal hum>

[Stage 2] 2s - 4.5s
Continue from the previous stage: The protagonist remains pinned to the pillar.
Primary event: The antagonist lunges forward, transforming into a spear-like shape of rebar and shadow. The camera operator pans rapidly to follow the movement, losing focus briefly.
End state: The antagonist is halfway across the concourse. <Whooshing air sound> <Camera autofocus clicking>

[Stage 3] 4.5s - 6.5s
Continue from the previous stage: The protagonist is in the path of the lunge.
Primary event: The protagonist dives to his right, rolling through an oil puddle. The antagonist slams into the concrete pillar, causing deep cracks.
End state: The protagonist is on his knees, covered in oily water; the pillar is fractured. <Heavy concrete impact> <Water splashing>

[Stage 4] 6.5s - 8.5s
Continue from the previous stage: The protagonist is on the floor.
Primary event: The protagonist raises his cracked iPhone; the screen suddenly emits a blinding white and violet strobe light. The camera operator zooms in on the phone.
End state: A cone of bright light illuminates the antagonist. <High-pitched electronic whine>

[Stage 5] 8.5s - 10.5s
Continue from the previous stage: The light beam hits the antagonist.
Primary event: The antagonist recoils, its form becoming unstable and smoky. Controlled chromatic aberration fringes its destabilizing silhouette. The tendril is cropped by the frame edges at the top as it arcs down.
End state: The protagonist is knocked backward, his hoodie torn at the shoulder. <Flesh impact thud> {Argh!}

[Stage 6] 10.5s - 13s
Continue from the previous stage: The protagonist is falling back.
Primary event: The protagonist catches himself on a piece of debris and thrusts the phone forward again. A shockwave of violet energy ripples through the air. The camera shakes violently.
End state: Dust and pebbles are lifted off the ground, swirling around the fighters. <Deep bass rumble> <Wind howling>

[Stage 7] 13s - 15.5s
Continue from the previous stage: The concourse is filled with dust.
Primary event: The antagonist merges with a nearby concrete pillar, causing the pillar to grow jagged stone teeth. Extreme photorealism captures every pore and fracture in the animated concrete under cinematic lighting.
End state: A massive concrete mass is inches from the protagonist. <Grinding stone sound>

[Stage 8] 15.5s - 18s
Continue from the previous stage: The pillar is swinging.
Primary event: The protagonist slides under the swinging pillar, his AF1s skidding on the granite. He reaches out and grabs the silver chain around his neck, which begins to glow.
End state: The protagonist is behind the antagonist's main mass. <Sneakers screeching on stone>

[Stage 9] 18s - 20.5s
Continue from the previous stage: The silver chain is glowing.
Primary event: The antagonist spins around, its face-void expanding to swallow the protagonist. The camera operator stumbles, the frame tilting 45 degrees. Blacks tinted rather than pure black at the void's deepest core.
End state: The protagonist is partially obscured by shifting shadows. <Terrified breathing from the camera operator>

[Stage 10] 20.5s - 23s
Continue from the previous stage: The protagonist is surrounded by shadow.
Primary event: The protagonist screams and clenches his fists; a massive burst of pure violet energy explodes from his chest, pushing the shadows back. The subject is lit only by this scene.
End state: The frame is momentarily white before fading back to the scene. {Get away!} <Energy explosion>

[Stage 11] 23s - 25.5s
Continue from the previous stage: The light settles.
Primary event: The antagonist shatters into thousands of concrete fragments and dissipates into purple mist. Extreme photorealism and fine 35mm grain render every tumbling shard with weight and texture.
End state: The protagonist is center frame, exhausted, hands trembling. <Mist hissing> <Protagonist's heavy breathing>

[Stage 12] 25.5s - 28s
Continue from the previous stage: The protagonist is on his knees.
Primary event: The protagonist looks directly at the camera, his eyes glowing faintly violet before fading to brown. Subtle halation softens his irises at the moment of violet glow. No text anywhere.
End state: The protagonist is looking up at the lens. {Did you... did you get that?}

[Stage 13] 28s - 30s
Continue from the previous stage: The protagonist is looking at the camera.
Primary event: The camera operator drops the phone; the screen hits the ground, showing a tilted, blurry view of the cracked ceiling and flickering lights. Fine 35mm grain spikes as the autofocus spins.
End state: Static and black screen. <Phone hitting concrete> <Electronic static noise>

[Maintain Consistency]
Keep the protagonist's South Asian features, black hoodie, olive cargo pants, and silver chain consistent. The antagonist must remain a shifting blend of concrete and violet energy. Maintain the vertical 9:16 aspect ratio and handheld camera shake. All damage to the pillars and protagonist's clothing must persist throughout the scene.

prompts.prompt:
Seedance 2.5 Animation prompt (raw output) + added Suno Bgm

30-second stylised 3D animated short film. 19 hard cuts, average 1.6s per shot. NO on-screen text, NO subtitles, NO readable lettering anywhere — all signage is abstract glowing colour shapes only.

STYLE (every frame): Stylised feature-animation 3D CG. Faceted low-poly geometry with hand-chiselled planar cuts — fabric folds read as carved wedges, not cloth simulation. Exaggerated cartoon proportions: heavy shoulders, thick forearms, small hands, short legs, oversized head. Matte painterly surfaces, zero PBR gloss, fine canvas grain over the whole image. Skin has soft subsurface warmth and a hard wet rim light. Cel-adjacent shading with crisp terminator lines and soft ambient occlusion in creases. Wide-angle 18-24mm lens throughout with visible barrel distortion, shallow depth of field, heavy radial motion blur on backgrounds, volumetric shafts through steam and rain. Rain is faceted streaks, not particles. Cuts land hard on the beat.

CAST (locked, identical in every shot): KAVI — 27-year-old Tamil woman tea master. Compact and broad, low centre of gravity, thick forearms, short legs. Deep brown skin, broad flat nose, heavy straight brows, thin steel nose ring, pale old burn scar across the left forearm. Black hair oiled into a tight low bun with one white jasmine strand. Wardrobe: sun-bleached crimson work sari hitched short over black shorts, scorched grey thermal sleeves shoved to the elbow, black rubber apron, a stack of steel bangles on the right wrist only. Props: two dented brass tumblers.

PALETTE: monsoon night. Wet blue-black asphalt, cold slate rain, one sodium-orange stall lamp as the only key, magenta and cyan neon bleeding in from off-frame, brass and copper highlights, a single crimson accent, pale steam white.

STORY: The 9pm rush hits a rain-flooded street-food lane and Kavi outruns it on pure craft, ending alone in the steam.

BEATS:
0.0-1.4 Macro, static, rack focus: a raindrop bursts on the rim of a brass tumbler into faceted shards, sodium lamp flaring behind.
1.4-2.8 Puddle-height 18mm, low tracking dolly right: her rubber sandals stamp into standing water, sheets peeling sideways in solid slabs.
2.8-4.4 Low hero angle, slow crane up into a 4-frame snap zoom: she plants both hands on the counter as the lamp bangs on and steam blooms up her body.
4.4-5.8 Whip pan across a queue of blurred umbrella silhouettes, settling on her hands seizing two tumblers.
5.8-7.0 Fast dolly in on her face: jaw set, magenta on one cheek, orange on the other, rain beading on her brows.
7.0-8.6 Vertical crane down following the pour: she rips the tumblers a metre apart, an amber ribbon of tea stretched taut between them.
8.6-10.2 Full 360 orbit at waist height, background smearing to streaks as she pours again without looking.
10.2-11.4 Top-down bird's-eye snap: the tea hits the lower tumbler dead centre, crown splash held two frames then blurred.
11.4-13.0 Handheld push through a curtain of steam, her silhouette resolving out of pure white.
13.0-14.6 Whip pan right to a rival stall's neon guttering out, a cook staring; her hands keep working at frame edge.
14.6-16.0 Low wide, speed ramp: a scooter tears a puddle open, a wall of water slabbing up; she pivots and shields the tray with her back without losing rhythm.
16.0-17.8 Slow-motion macro arc around one tumbler tipping off the tray edge, bangles blurring past.
17.8-19.0 Snap to real time, whip tilt up: she catches it behind her back on two fingers.
19.0-20.6 Crash zoom into her eyes; one brow lifts a millimetre.
20.6-22.2 Fast lateral dolly along the counter as she slides seven full tumblers down it, one per hand-flick, steam trailing each.
22.2-23.6 Reverse low angle from behind the queue: hands reaching in from every side taking cups, her figure small and centred, lamp flaring.
23.6-25.4 Drone crane pull-up out of the lane: the stall is one hot orange dot in a grid of wet blue-black rooftops, rain thinning.
25.4-27.4 Cut to ground level, slow push in: the lane empty, the last umbrella turning a corner, puddles gone glass-still.
27.4-30.0 Static low hero: Kavi pours one last tumbler for herself, steam rising straight up as the rain stops, she exhales, the lamp flickers once, hold, slow fade.

AUDIO: No dialogue. Rain drumming on tin, kettle hiss, brass ringing on brass, the hard splash of the long pour, scooter doppler, crowd murmur, bangles clattering. Music: driving Tamil percussion — thavil and kanjira over a low sub-bass pulse, tempo climbing to a peak at 22.2s, everything dropping to rain and one held drone at 27.4s.

NEGATIVE: no text, no lettering, no watermark, no photorealism, no PBR gloss, no live action, no plastic skin, no extra fingers, no morphing faces, no character/wardrobe/palette drift, no daylight, no drifting camera, no crossfades, no bloom overload, no still frames.

She wears realistic outfits appropriate for each scene while remaining clearly the same person throughout. Cinematic, photorealistic, premium lifestyle commercial, 4K, natural color grading, shallow depth of field, smooth camera movement, authentic facial expressions. Every scene flows logically through seamless match cuts and continuous time progression.
Scene 1 (0–3s): Soft golden sunrise enters a cozy bedroom. A smartphone alarm rings on the bedside table. She slowly opens her eyes, stretches naturally under the blanket, smiles sleepily, and turns off the alarm.
Scene 2 (3–6s): She gets out of bed, opens the curtains, morning sunlight fills the room. Match cut to brushing her teeth, washing her face, then applying light skincare while looking into the mirror.
Scene 3 (6–9s): She changes into a smart office outfit. Quick elegant cuts of buttoning her blouse, fastening a watch, putting on earrings, grabbing her handbag, and checking herself in the mirror.
Scene 4 (9–12s): Bright modern kitchen. She prepares a healthy breakfast, pours coffee, takes a few bites while checking her phone, then picks up her bag and leaves.
Scene 5 (12–16s): Urban commute. Walking confidently through city streets toward a modern office building. Match cut to entering the office, greeting coworkers, typing on a laptop, participating in a meeting, smiling during productive work.
Scene 6 (16–19s): Lunch break at a stylish café with colleagues. Everyone laughs naturally while eating and chatting. Warm candid atmosphere, genuine interactions.
Scene 7 (19–22s): Late afternoon. She packs her laptop, says goodbye to coworkers, exits the office building into warm golden-hour light.
Scene 8 (22–26s): Evening rooftop café with close friends. They enjoy drinks, laugh together, take a quick selfie, city lights gradually illuminate behind them as blue hour begins.
Scene 9 (26–30s): Night. She returns home, gently places her keys on the table, changes into comfortable loungewear, sits by the bedroom window with a warm cup of tea while soft ambient lights glow. She exhales with a relaxed smile, curls up on the bed with a book, then turns off the bedside lamp. Fade to black.
Style & Camera:
Ultra-photorealistic cinematic lifestyle film.
Natural, believable acting with subtle expressions.
Smooth gimbal movement, gentle push-ins, tracking shots, and seamless match cuts.
Soft morning light → bright daytime → golden hour → blue hour → warm cozy night, creating a natural day-to-night progression.
Consistent facial identity and outfit continuity within each scene.
Realistic environments, premium production quality, no jump cuts, no teleportation, no duplicated people, no distorted hands, no warped objects, no identity drift, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
Emotional tone: calm, productive, joyful, and satisfying, a complete day in the life told through elegant visual storytelling.

prompts.prompt:
Reference binding: strictly lock the girl's face, age, black tied-back hairstyle, worn dark-gray work jacket, light inner shirt, body proportions, and photorealistic texture to Image 1. She remains the same character in the same outfit throughout. Use a Dunhuang wasteland civilization for the worldbuilding: its architectural language, sandstorm atmosphere, low-tech transport, rusted machinery, earth-tone palette, and sunset light. Do not replicate the reference image's exact composition or setting. A 30-second single take with no edits or jump cuts.

The girl is fleeing pursuers, traveling from a cliffside mural cave through a vertical wasteland city before finally soaring up to the highest city wall. The camera flies tightly around her like a high-speed FPV drone, continuously shifting between close pursuit, dives, ground-skimming passes, circling, barrel rolls, and dramatic upward pulls. Every location transition is naturally motivated by foreground occlusion from doorways, fabric, people, animals, smoke, dust, and architecture.

00:00-00:04 | Mural Cave
Begin in close-up on the girl's paint-stained fingers. The camera races along a damaged mural toward her face. She looks back alertly, immediately steps onto a stone table, crouches, and leaps through a narrow window opening. The camera follows her through the window as hanging canvas sweeps across the lens, creating the first foreground wipe.
00:04-00:08 | Cliff Dwellings
As the camera bursts from the cave, it suddenly opens into a vast wide shot: an entire city clings to an enormous wind-eroded cliff face, with layered cave homes, earthen towers, suspended walkways, wind sails, and rusted power pylons stretching into the distance. The girl lands on a narrow wooden beam and sprints forward. She wall-runs into a light sideways leap, her body crossing the deep gap between two cliffside dwellings. The camera first dives close to her feet, then rises rapidly from the ravine to her side.
00:08-00:12 | Camel Caravan Market
The girl drops from above into a crowded open-air market. The camera follows her downward trajectory, rolling half a turn, skimming low through camel legs, cart wheels, and beneath market stalls, then tilting back up to find her again. She vaults a cargo cart one-handed, side-flips over stacked pottery jars, lands and lowers her center of gravity to slide beneath a horizontal timber, then spins through the motion to sweep aside a bamboo rack blocking her path. Camels, residents, fluttering awnings, and rolling vessels continuously cross the foreground.

00:12-00:16 | Long Dyeing Alley
A full sheet of ochre-red dyed fabric covers the lens. The camera passes through the cloth and enters a narrow dye workshop alley. The girl alternates between both walls for continuous wall-kicks, rapidly gaining height. She grabs an overhead rope, swings over steaming dye vats, rotates in the air, and lands on a moving cargo cart. The camera snakes between hanging fabrics in FPV motion, briefly barrel-rolling as cloth strips, steam, and water droplets race past the lens.
00:16-00:20 | Mechanical Water Channel
The cargo cart rushes into a semi-underground mechanical water channel. Using its momentum, the girl jumps forward, tucks her knees and flips in the air, kicking off the edge of a rotating waterwheel. She then uses hand plants, side flips, and low slides to avoid pipes sweeping across her route. The camera enters the center of the waterwheel from beside her shoulder, then races downward with the current, skimming just above the water beneath a stone arch. Water splashes onto the edge of the lens without obscuring the subject.
00:20-00:24 | Wind Tower Shaft
The girl runs up an angled pipe, takes three consecutive wall steps, and bursts into a giant wind tower. The camera suddenly rises vertically from the water channel, spiraling around her inside the narrow shaft. She grabs the skeleton of a swinging wind sail and is lifted off the ground by the powerful wind. In midair, she performs a clearly controlled spin and hand switch, then swings toward the tower-top exit. Gears, ropes, and flying grains of sand streak rapidly through the foreground.

00:24-00:27 | Broken Sky Bridge
The camera and the girl burst from the tower top together, revealing the full scale of the city again. The sky bridge ahead is collapsing. She runs across falling planks and jumps just before the final board drops away. Two masked pursuers emerge behind her, but remain distant and never take focus from the girl. She performs a long qinggong leap above the abyss, her coat tails pulled straight by the wind. The camera flies backward beneath her, arcs to the front, then continues flipping upward.
00:27-00:30 | Sunset City Wall
As the girl approaches the opposite city wall, she steps on a long banner whipping in the wind and uses it to gain height again. In midair, she performs a clean, powerful spinning kick that knocks open the wooden mechanism above the sealed city gate. She lands on the highest point of the wall, touching down on one knee before quickly rising. The camera surges over her shoulder, pulls violently backward, and rises into the sky, finally revealing the entire Dunhuang wasteland city, distant salt-alkali desert, moving camel caravans, and monumental cliffside ruins lit by the sunset.
Camera movement:
The entire shot follows one continuous, traceable spatial route. The camera has the impact and velocity of high-speed FPV flight but always remains centered on the girl. Include at least one ground-skimming pass, one dive followed by a rapid climb, one narrow-space serpentine flight, one spiral ascent, and one large aerial pullback. Use environmental motion blur in high-speed moments while keeping her face and body movements clear. The camera never teleports; every change in speed and direction is motivated by her actions or the architecture along the route.

Action performance:
The girl is light, agile, and convincingly trained in martial arts. Qinggong is expressed through powerful footwork, brief suspension, and the ability to cross extraordinary distances, never through floating or weightless flight. Her actions include wall-running, vaulting, side flips, sliding, sweeping strikes, rope swings, aerial rotations, and flying kicks. Every movement connects naturally, with clear center of gravity, landing points, inertia, and cloth response. She is always actively reading the route, breathing hard, focused, and never looking into the camera.
Environment and foreground transitions:
Damaged murals, canvas, cliff dwellings, wooden beams, camel legs, cart wheels, pottery jars, dyed fabric, steam, waterwheels, stone arches, gears, wind-sail skeletons, long banners, and windblown sand enter the extreme foreground in sequence. Foreground elements may briefly obscure the frame, but the girl must quickly reappear. The city spaces connect logically and cannot feel like unrelated locations stitched together.
Visual style:
Photorealistic Eastern wasteland fantasy, blending Dunhuang earth-and-rock architecture with salvaged industrial machinery on the grand scale of a vertical city. Main colors: weathered sandy yellow, ochre, gray-brown, and rust, with the girl's dark-gray costume contrasting against golden sunset light. Strong side and backlight pierce through dusty haze; fine sand floats in the air. Realistic materials, restrained film grain, high-contrast cinematic photography. The mood is tense, expansive, and rugged.

prompts.prompt:
Overall description

[Character] A female protagonist. Her appearance, costume, and silhouette must strictly match the female protagonist reference. She is a dark new-Chinese-style xianxia swordswoman with long hair, wide-sleeved robes, and a broad flowing skirt. She is always backlit by a huge full moon, remaining a dark silhouette with no brightly lit frontal face. Do not change the costume color or silhouette.

[Setting] Moonlit celestial palace, dark wooden walkways, dark tiled rooftops, hanging white curtains, reflective ground, sea of clouds, deep night sky, and a huge full moon. The setting consists of ancient Chinese-style palace architecture, giant vermilion columns, golden dougong brackets, upturned eaves, and suspended white drapery. A deep-blue sea of clouds and starry sky are visible in the distance.

[Visual style] 24fps, 8K ultra-high-definition, photorealistic next-generation 3D CG rendering, PBR physical materials, Lumen global illumination, volumetric lighting, dynamic motion blur, natural depth of field, cinematic high-contrast lighting, clean image with no noise. Premium new-Chinese xianxia aesthetic, UE5 cinematic rendering, cool blue moonlit ambient light contrasted against warm golden sparks, golden dark patterns, and sword-energy particles. Large areas of shadow, minimalist negative space, expressive ink-wash texture, cinematic 2.39:1 widescreen frame. Epic, cold, solitary, ethereal, and intensely exhilarating.

[Core visual effects] Black ink, golden fire, cyan-white sword energy, golden ember particles, fluid ink trailing, circular energy trajectories, crescent-shaped sword energy, and ink shockwaves. The fluid light trails contain fine floating debris and star-like particles, with soft glowing edges. Their motion remains smooth, continuous, and free of broken trailing artifacts. All destruction follows physical feedback: curtains torn by sword energy produce irregular frayed edges and fragments; wooden planks crack and splinter; ink and water spread outward after impact.

[Most important camera rules] A 30-second single take with only one camera. Absolutely no cuts, hard cuts, white flashes, black frames, jump transitions, teleportation, or reframing. All changes in framing and camera angle are completed through continuous movement by the same camera. Foreground white drapery, ink, water, and high-speed particles may only act as occlusion transitions within the same shot. When the occlusion ends, the camera must remain in the same time, motion direction, and spatial position. Camera movement is silky and steady, with subtle realistic impact vibrations at each footstep, landing, sword swing, and strike point. No random shake or loss of visual control.

Storyboard prompt

Shot 1: Complete single-take xianxia sword dance, 0s-30s

0s-2.5s: Distant opening, slow push-in

A wide low-angle horizontal shot. The camera begins about 20 meters behind the female protagonist, slowly pushing forward along the centerline of a dark wooden walkway. She faces away from the camera beneath a huge full moon, tiny as a speck of dust, her dark silhouette sharply outlined by moonlight.

She begins walking forward very slowly, arms naturally at her sides, then gradually tightens her right hand around a longsword. Her long hair and wide sleeves blow backward in the night wind; her white skirt floats slowly in a slightly low-gravity atmosphere. Each step lands about 1.5 seconds apart. The camera has approximately two pixels of vertical bounce and an extremely slight side-to-side shift, creating a realistic handheld-following feeling.

The reflective ground beneath her mirrors the full moon, her silhouette, and blurred reflections of distant golden palace structures. White hanging curtains sway slowly in the distance. The space is quiet, with only wind, moving mist, and the sound of fabric rubbing.

2.5s-5s: Forward lean, rapid sprint to the right

The same continuous camera path smoothly shifts from directly behind her toward her right-front side while accelerating forward. She suddenly leans forward, lowers her center of gravity, and sprints at high speed toward the right side of the frame.

Her right foot strikes the ground hard, creating fine cracks and splinters in the wooden planks. Her blue-black robe, long hair, and wide sleeves are violently pulled backward by acceleration. Her white skirt leaves a long mixed trail of golden fire and black ink, skimming over the reflective ground and leaving a clear reflection.

The camera develops subtle dynamic vibration in response to her acceleration, while she remains sharp and the background architecture gains strong motion parallax.

5s-7.5s: High-speed sword swing, tearing the first white curtain

She charges toward a huge white hanging curtain in the right foreground. The camera stays at her right-front side, matching her speed in a side-front tracking shot, lowered slightly for a medium low-angle view.

Without stopping her sprint, she draws her sword and completes one broad horizontal slash from back to front. The sword cuts through the air and releases a cyan-white sword-energy arc edged with gold.

The sword energy strikes the white curtain. The fabric first dents inward, then tears outward from the point of impact. It produces irregular frayed edges, scattered threads, and many fragments. White fabric scraps are pulled toward the lens by the airflow, creating natural foreground occlusion. The camera does not cut and continues following her through the dispersing fragments.

7.5s-10s: Midair rotation, circular sword energy forms

After passing through the white fabric debris, the camera continues moving toward the right-front and performs a smooth, small-radius orbit around her without abruptly changing direction.

Using the momentum of her sprint, she leaps into the air. Both feet leave the walkway as her body spins rapidly around its vertical axis. She first pulls in her arms, then extends her wide sleeves with the rotation. Her black hair forms an elegant arc and her skirt blooms outward like ink-wash petals.

The sword continuously moves with her body, forming a huge circular energy trajectory in front of her, interwoven with gold-white and cyan light. Inside the ring are ink diffusion, golden sparks, fine floating particles, and soft glowing edges. The circular sword energy sweeps over the ground, creating a bright circular reflection on the reflective surface below.

10s-12.5s: Rising before the moon, continuous crescent sword-energy strikes

The camera naturally rises with her rotation, shifting from a medium shot into a wide low-angle view. She forms a dark silhouette before the huge full moon. Crisp rim light outlines her hair, sword blade, and skirt in cold blue moonlight.

Holding the sword with both hands, she performs three violent continuous sword swings in midair:

First, a horizontal slash releases a cyan-white crescent-shaped sword energy arc.

Second, an upward diagonal slash tears through mist with its rising energy trail.

Third, a turning backhand slash releases a larger gold-and-cyan interwoven sword arc.

There can be no pause between the attacks. Her body rotation, shoulder force, waist twist, sleeve delay, and sword-energy release must form one complete causal chain. The energy passes beside her body, carrying black ink and golden sparks.

12.5s-15s: Sword energy cuts through space, camera follows the attack path

The camera briefly locks onto the sword tip, then rapidly pushes forward along the direction of the sword energy while remaining spatially connected to her. The energy cuts through several white hanging curtains ahead, slicing them in sequence and creating a shattered corridor from foreground into the distance.

White fabric fragments, gray ink, golden sparks, and cyan-white sword energy fly across the lens in intersecting paths, creating strong radial motion blur. The image can be briefly occluded by fast-moving debris, but it must never become a black frame or a cut. The camera rediscovers her silhouette through openings in the debris.

15s-18s: Diving close, downward sword strike

She draws the sword back in midair to gather power, then rapidly flips downward. From directly in front and below her, the camera quickly rises toward her and then dives downward in sync with her falling path, creating a close diving push-in and small-radius orbit.

Holding the sword in both hands, its blade gathers intense blue-white flame. She completes one heavy downward strike. The air around the impact point compresses into visible circular shock patterns, while the full moon's rim light passes from behind her to create an extremely strong black silhouette.

The sword energy strikes the dark wooden walkway. Mist is instantly pushed away by the shockwave, forming a brief low-pressure vacuum while surrounding water vapor bursts outward.

18s-21s: Landing impact, eruption of ink and water

The camera continues descending with her, shifting slightly to the side just before she lands so both the character and impact point remain fully visible.

She lands heavily on the dark wooden walkway, bending one knee slightly, with the sword embedded in the ground or angled forward. The impact cracks the wooden planks outward from beneath her feet. Wood splinters, stone fragments, and droplets spray along the cracks.

At the same time, enormous white waves and black ink surge upward from both sides of her body, forming exaggerated arcing waves. The waves contain fragments of golden firelight and cyan sword-energy particles, curling outward on both sides while preserving her dark silhouette at the center.

The camera receives one short impact vibration, then immediately returns to smooth tracking. No freeze frame.

21s-23s: Ink occlusion transition, continuous entry into the second spatial layer

The water and ink rush toward the lens. White, gray, and black fluid gradually covers the frame. The camera maintains an upward tilt and slight backward movement, using this fluid occlusion to create a spatial transition within the same continuous shot.

During the occlusion, floating debris, star-like particles, and golden light flecks are visible inside the ink. The fluid edges have soft glowing halos. Do not use hard cuts, white flashes, or a full black screen. As the ink disperses upward, the camera reveals her back as she launches upward from the ground.

23s-25.5s: Rising again, passing through multiple white curtains

The camera naturally rises out of the ink into a medium low-angle view. She steps on the remaining ink shockwave and launches upward at a diagonal angle.

She drags intense golden fire and black ink trails behind her, passing continuously through several vertically hanging white curtains. At each crossing, the curtains are first pushed backward by airflow, then torn into irregular fragments by sword energy. Fabric pieces, threads, debris, and sparks scatter in the direction of her movement, creating believable layers of speed.

The camera performs a continuous upward tilt and slight half-orbit behind her, never changing its relationship to the subject.

25.5s-27.5s: Midair turn, continuous circular energy slashes

She turns lightly between the curtains, changing from diagonal upward flight to horizontal lateral motion. The camera follows her turn in a continuous circular orbit, keeping her centered in frame.

The sword draws several bright cyan circular energy trajectories in front of her. The rings overlap but never intersect unrealistically. Each sword swing produces a brief metallic sword resonance, compressed airflow, and scattered particles.

The full moon remains visible in the background. Her black silhouette contrasts sharply with the cyan-white sword energy, while black ink rotates around her body like ribbons.

27.5s-29s: Vertical dive, piercing through the rooftop space

The camera suddenly follows her downward dive without changing camera position through a cut. It drops from her rear-side to a diagonal lower position, surrounded by strong white and gray radial speed lines.

Holding the sword with both hands pointed downward, she falls vertically at extremely high speed. The sword tip leaves a cyan-white flaming trail. Surrounding ink and golden fire are pulled into long thin lines by the airflow. Dynamic motion blur intensifies, but her core silhouette and sword-tip direction remain clear.

29s-30s: Rooftop lateral move and continuous ending composition

In the final second, she pierces through ink and fabric debris, lands on a slanted dark tiled roof, and immediately slides at high speed toward the right. The camera tracks laterally to the right, maintaining a low-angle side view.

She completes a powerful but natural attack-ending pose: body leaning forward, sword extended to the right, black hair, wide sleeves, and skirt violently streaming behind her. The edge of her skirt continues to burn with golden fire.

The sword tip suddenly releases one final radial white ink shockwave that expands into the depth of the frame. Using the reaction force of the shockwave, the camera slowly pulls back and rises, returning to the opening wide composition: she becomes a dark silhouette before the full moon again, the sword tip flashes white, and her hair and skirt dissolve into black ink and golden-fire particles, leaving an extended reflection across the reflective ground.

Single-take continuity constraints

The entire 30 seconds consists of only one continuous camera movement, with no cuts.

All wide shots, medium shots, close-ups, top-down angles, low angles, orbits, push-ins, and pullbacks must be created by real movement from the same camera.

Her sprint, leap, rotation, sword swings, dive, landing, second ascent, and rooftop run must all connect through believable inertia.

White curtains, ink, water, and particles only serve as occlusion or spatial transitions within the same shot.

Before and after every occlusion, maintain the same time, spatial direction, character costume, and lighting relationship.

Do not use fast cuts, extremely short transition shots, instant freeze frames, sudden transformations, or instantaneous location changes that break the single-take illusion.

Brief motion blur and foreground occlusion are allowed, but they must never create black frames, white flashes, or hidden cuts.

Prohibit malformed limbs, extra arms, disappearing sword blades, cloth clipping, duplicated characters, deformed architecture, flat ink textures, image flicker, color overexposure, subtitles, watermarks, and circular energy fields.

prompts.prompt:
Create a 30-second photorealistic cinematic short film, 2.39:1, 35mm film aesthetic, natural human performances, realistic train station and carriage, soft winter daylight, subtle film grain, restrained camera movement, realistic skin and clothing, no subtitles, no narration.

CHARACTERS:
One woman in her 30s carrying a small black handbag.
One elderly man carrying a bouquet of white flowers.
LOCATION:
One nearly empty commuter train and one small rural station.
0–4s: The woman runs onto a train just before the doors close. She catches her breath.
4–7s: She looks at her ticket. Her expression changes.
She is on the wrong train.
7–11s: She looks around the nearly empty carriage.
An elderly man sits opposite her holding a bouquet.
11–14s: He notices her ticket.
“Wrong train?”
She nods.
14–17s: He looks at his flowers. “Me too.”
17–21s: Neither speaks.
The train moves through winter countryside.
21–24s: The train stops at a tiny rural station.
The old man stands.
24–27s: Before leaving, he gives her one white flower.
He steps off.
27–30s: The doors close.
The woman looks through the window.
She sees the station sign.
Her expression changes.
It is the name of her childhood hometown.
Cut to black.
SOUND:
Train wheels, carriage vibration, distant announcement, footsteps and doors. No music until the train reaches the countryside. Then soft piano and cello.
IMPORTANT:
Do not add additional passengers. The station name should be visible but not digitally overlaid. The final recognition must come from the woman's reaction and the physical station sign.

prompts.prompt:
生成一段30秒、实时速度、无剪辑的一镜到底冒险动作影片。中心主体是参考角色@1，她全程严格穿着参考服装@2，连续突破地下古代神殿的四个机关区域，最终从祭坛取得一瓶现代瓶装香水。真实古代遗迹环境，无观众、无主持人、无演播室。 [全局设定] 参考图职责锁定
仅作为人物参考：锁定同一名成年女性的脸部轮廓、五官比例、深棕色长卷发、红色唇妆、自然成熟气质、古铜色圆盘垂坠耳环和精致金色项链。禁止引用@1的白色背景、九宫格排版、拍摄角度和静态证件照姿势。
图片_20260515073725_190_1403(1)
仅作为服装参考：严格锁定白色缎面蕾丝连体服、立体蕾丝高领、胸前结构化蕾丝拼接、白色缎面腰带及正面蝴蝶结、半透明白色长袖披纱、拖曳式蕾丝纱摆、白色缎面长手套、白色蕾丝长筒袜与白色尖头高跟鞋。 禁止引用@2的大理石室内、暖色灯带、跪姿、无头人体展示方式。角色必须拥有@1的完整头部和身体，穿着@2的完整服装。 服装必须适合连续动作表现但不可擅自改款：披纱、腰结、长袜、高跟鞋始终存在。白色布料会逐渐沾染尘土和少量水渍，不能在不同阶段突然恢复洁白。 环境与质感 地下古代神殿内部：长满青苔的巨大石壁、龟裂石板、积水沟渠、半坍塌拱门、深渊石桥和雕刻祭坛。天顶缝隙漏下细窄的冷色光柱，壁面火把产生橙色暖光。空气中漂浮尘埃。石材磨损、青苔湿度、玻璃反光、缎面褶皱、蕾丝纤维、皮革划痕、汗水与灰尘均呈现极致写实的物理质感。 视觉风格 经典考古冒险电影实拍质感，电影级浅景深，暖橙火光与冷色天光混合照明，克制的胶片颗粒和自然运动模糊。不得呈现电子游戏、舞台表演、时装棚拍或香水广告片质感。 镜头语言 一个完整、不中断、实时速度的30秒斯坦尼康长镜头。摄影机必须通过实际移动完成所有角度变化：从3/4后方跟拍，降低至水面高度侧拍，沿回廊侧壁平移，再绕至低角度追逐，最后减速绕至3/4正面中近景。 禁止利用石柱遮挡、摆锤遮挡、黑暗、尘土、快速甩镜或披纱掠过镜头制造隐藏剪辑。角色绝不固定在画面中央，始终位于左右三分之一，行进方向前方保留空间。人物全程从画面左侧向右侧前进，不跳轴、不反向。 角色与道具 @1为唯一角色，穿完整@2服装。她右手持同一支燃烧火把，身体斜挎一只小型磨损棕色皮质探险包。火把、探险包、耳环、项链、腰结、高跟鞋和披纱全程保持一致。探险包用于最终收纳香水。 表演核心 机关触发时必须出现即时反射动作；通过复杂区域前先以眼神计算距离或节奏；急促呼吸和短暂回望表现真实压力。最终表情不是炫耀胜利，而是危险暂时解除后的安心、惊讶与兴奋各占一部分。 现代香水锁定 祭坛宝物是一瓶明确的现代香水：透明厚底切割玻璃方瓶，内部装有淡琥珀粉色液体，银色拉丝金属圆柱瓶盖，现代极简轮廓，无可读品牌文字。瓶体大小、形状、液体颜色和瓶盖必须稳定一致；禁止变成黄金神像、古代圣杯、宝石、魔法药水或其他器物。 [时间戳分镜] 0—5秒｜石门飞镖机关 @1穿着完整@2服装，右手举着火把穿过狭窄石门。摄影机从她的3/4后方贴身跟随，将她置于画面右侧三分之一；深棕色长卷发和白色半透明披纱在行走气流中自然摆动。 第二步落下时，白色尖头高跟鞋踩中一块松动石板。石板在鞋跟重量下发出清晰的“咔哒”声并突然下沉。她的视线瞬间向侧面移动，双肩收紧；左右墙壁孔洞紧接着连续射出飞镖，“嗖、嗖、嗖”交叉掠过。 她立即压低重心，左手撑地、下巴内收，将持火把的右臂向外上方伸开，完成一次沿肩背滚动的贴地前滚。高跟鞋短暂离地，腰间蝴蝶结、长发和蕾丝披纱顺着惯性翻卷，但没有脱落或缠住四肢。飞镖擦过披纱边缘，钉进身后的石壁。 **终态：**她单膝落地，左手撑住龟裂石板，右手火把仍在燃烧；白色手套和膝侧第一次沾上灰尘。她急促呼吸并短暂回头，身后数支飞镖仍在石壁上震动。 5—12秒｜地下水道踏石 承接单膝落地状态。她站起并继续向右，摄影机从后方沿连续弧线降低至水面高度，自然转为侧面轮廓平行跟拍。相机沿地下水道旁的狭窄石沿滑行，不穿墙、不跨越空间。 大厅地面在前方中断，一条黑色地下水道横亘其中，六块方形踏石以之字形排列。她位于画面左侧三分之一，前方留出完整的跳跃空间。 她的视线始终先锁定下一块踏石，然后才转移身体重心。每次起跳都控制在较低高度，以适应高跟鞋和拖曳披纱：前脚掌先落在石块干燥中心，膝盖弯曲吸收冲击，确认稳定后鞋跟才短暂落下。她随即蹬向下一块。 每块踏石承受重量后都会缓慢下沉，缝隙冒出气泡，水面发出低沉“咕噜”声。最后两次跳跃中，披纱末端扫过水面，留下少量湿痕；耳环、项链、腰结和探险包随动作产生真实惯性。 **终态：**她双脚落上对岸石台，前脚掌先接触、膝盖深度弯曲，左手短暂触地恢复平衡。最后一块踏石在她身后完全沉入黑水，披纱下缘沾有水迹，但服装结构完整。 12—18秒｜摆锤石刃回廊 她从落地姿势起身，直接进入与石台相连的狭窄回廊。摄影机绕过入口石柱后贴近同一侧墙壁，以侧面平移继续跟拍，保持一个连续镜头。 回廊天顶垂下三座巨大的半月形石制摆锤，交错摆动，发出沉重轴承摩擦和“嗖、嗖”的破风声。摆锤周期性横穿镜头前景，将她短暂遮挡后再次显露，但遮挡期间仍保持连续环境声和真实摄影机运动，绝不是隐藏转场。 她停一拍观察第一座摆锤的周期，目光在三座石刃之间迅速移动。第一道间隙出现，她提起前脚、身体前倾冲过；第二座摆锤返回时，她紧贴石墙停住，披纱和头发被气流吹向一侧；下一道间隙打开，她再次冲刺。 面对最后一座摆锤，她的后脚前掌牢牢压住石面，前膝弯曲，腰腹收紧，上半身迅速后仰。巨大石刃贴着她胸前和蕾丝领口上方掠过，风压掀起长发、耳环和半透明披纱。石刃没有接触身体，服装没有破裂。 **终态：**她恢复直立并踏出回廊，站在出口右侧三分之一，急促吸气；身后三座摆锤仍按原有节奏交错摆动。 18—24秒｜崩塌石桥冲刺 回廊出口直接连通一座横跨深渊的古老石桥。摄影机不中断地绕至她的3/4后方，并降低到接近膝盖高度；她位于画面右侧三分之一，左侧留给正在崩塌的桥体。 她的第一只高跟鞋踏上桥面，桥梁后端立即发出沉闷断裂声。石板从后方向前依次“轰隆、轰隆”塌落，碎石坠入黑暗。 她开始全力向右冲刺，但步幅保持短促而快速，主要以前脚掌触地，避免鞋跟卡进石缝。探险包撞击腰侧，披纱在身后形成连续拖曳轨迹。一次落脚时鞋跟擦过松动石块，她的身体向外偏斜；左臂立刻展开配重，右手抬高火把，重新找回轴线，继续冲刺。崩塌线始终紧追脚跟。 桥端最后一块石板开始倾斜，她用前脚掌奋力蹬出，向对岸完成一次低而远的跃出。双脚接触地面后膝盖压缩，她顺势侧肩翻滚卸力，避免高跟鞋承受垂直冲击。白色披纱和缎面服装卷起一层灰尘。 **终态：**她伏身停在对岸地面，火把仍握在右手；身后的石桥完全崩塌，只剩碎石落入深渊的回声。她的白色服装已经积尘，披纱下缘带有水渍，状态不重置。 24—30秒｜香水祭坛 她从伏身状态起身，继续向右进入与桥端直接相连的宝物室。摄影机随她升高并自然减速。正前方古老祭坛上，一道天顶冷色光柱照亮一瓶现代香水：透明厚底切割玻璃方瓶、淡琥珀粉色液体和银色拉丝圆柱瓶盖，在周围破败遗迹中形成明确但真实的时代反差。 香水仅受火把暖光与天顶冷光照亮，没有突然出现的摄影棚产品灯光。 她靠近祭坛，先将右手中的同一支火把插入祭坛侧面的空置铁环，确认火把稳定后才腾出双手。摄影机沿她肩后向侧前方移动，香水、双手和面部始终处于同一连续空间。 她戴着白色缎面长手套的双手从瓶体两侧靠近，手指避开瓶盖，稳稳托住厚重玻璃瓶底并将香水垂直捧起。瓶内液体因停止移动产生一次轻微晃动。 香水离开祭坛的瞬间，整座神殿发出低沉连续的“隆隆”震动。石台轻微摇晃，天顶开始落下尘埃。她立刻打开斜挎探险包，将香水保持直立放入包内，合上包盖并扣紧搭扣；香水不能复制、消失或留下一瓶在祭坛上。 摄影机继续沿短弧线来到她的3/4前侧。她转向镜头，却仍位于画面左侧三分之一。画面结束于中近景：火把暖光映亮@1沾着汗水和灰尘的侧脸，深色长发与古铜耳环轻微晃动。她在急促呼吸后露出一个克制的微笑——不是炫耀，而是安心、意外与兴奋各占一部分。背景冷色光柱中的尘埃持续落下。 **终态：**现代香水直立收纳在探险包中，包扣已经闭合；火把仍插在祭坛铁环内燃烧；@1穿着积尘但结构完整的@2服装，以3/4侧脸停留在画面左侧三分之一。 [一致性保持] 全程只能出现同一个@1成年女性角色，脸部、发型、妆容、身体比例和首饰不得改变。 全程严格穿着同一套@2服装；所有蕾丝结构、腰间蝴蝶结、披纱、手套、长袜和高跟鞋必须持续存在。 灰尘与水渍必须逐段累积：第一阶段手套和膝侧积尘；第二阶段披纱末端沾水；第四阶段整体积尘；禁止状态重置。 火把始终由她携带，直到第五阶段被明确插入祭坛铁环；禁止途中消失或自动换手。 探险包始终斜挎在身体同一侧；香水在24秒前位于祭坛，捧起后位于双手，最后唯一状态为直立收纳于包内。 香水始终保持同一透明切割玻璃方瓶、淡琥珀粉色液体和银色圆柱瓶盖，禁止变形、换色、复制或变成古代宝物。 行进方向始终为画面左→右。摄影机通过可见移动完成角度转换，保持同一行动轴线。 保持火把暖色光与天顶冷色光柱的照明逻辑，不出现来源不明的补光。 [音频] 仅使用真实环境声和动作音效：高跟鞋与石材接触声、急促呼吸、布料及蕾丝摩擦、火把燃烧、飞镖破风、石板下沉、水声、气泡、摆锤破风、石桥崩塌、玻璃瓶轻触手套、包扣闭合和神殿震动。 禁止BGM、旁白、人物台词、广告音效和胜利提示音。 [严格禁止] 禁止任何剪辑、蒙太奇、隐藏转场、时间跳跃、速度渐变、慢动作、镜头瞬移、穿墙、跳轴或无物理路径的角度变化；禁止利用石柱、黑暗、摆锤、尘土、披纱或甩镜掩盖剪辑。 禁止人物固定在画面中央、改变行进方向、换脸、发型变化、服装改款、布料无故恢复洁白、首饰消失、高跟鞋变成靴子、火把或探险包无故消失。
图片_20260515073725_190_1403(1)
禁止服装滑落、意外裸露、身体穿模、披纱穿过机关、头发穿过肩膀、鞋跟陷入脚部、关节扭曲、漂浮跳跃、失重动作和无冲击反馈的落地。 禁止香水瓶变成古代神器、黄金神像、宝石、酒瓶、药水或发光魔法物体；禁止香水复制、瓶盖漂浮、液体穿出瓶体、玻璃变软、标签乱码或出现可读品牌文字。 禁止字幕、标题、Logo、水印、UI、霓虹、摄影棚产品灯、香水广告转台、浮空包装文案、观众、主持人、演播室、游戏节目元素、现代家具、其他人物、怪物、血液、伤口和血腥内容。

prompts.prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic 3D character render, physically-based rendering with soft

realistic skin shading and subsurface scattering, crisp studio-grade key light mixed

with moody practical lounge lighting, realistic cloth drape and leather sheen, shallow

depth of field, filmic color grade. NOT flat 2D cartoon, NOT painterly illustration,

NOT anime style, NOT cel-shaded, NOT posterized color blocks — fully photoreal

rendering throughout, matching a high-end digital-human render.

WORLD: a dim neo-noir back-room lounge, deep burgundy velvet booths, a single shaft of

amber lamplight, rain streaking a window behind venetian blinds, city neon bleeding

through in blue and magenta, palette of burgundy, black and gold with cool neon spill,

cigarette smoke drifting through the light, layered depth of field.

CHARACTER: Vesper Noir @[Image1] — an extremely tall slim adult woman with warm olive skin, sleek

jet-black hair in a low chignon with a loose face-framing strand, dramatic winged

eyeliner, deep burgundy lips, a small beauty mark near her mouth, wearing a fitted

deep-plum plunging bodysuit, a thin black choker with a small skull charm, a massive

draped black coat slipped off both shoulders, thigh-high matte-black leather boots,

photoreal digital-human rendering with soft realistic skin shading.

CINEMATIC INTRO SHOT DESIGN (6 Filmic Cuts with Expressions):

- SHOT 1 (0–2s | Macro Detail): Extreme macro close-up of her fingers spinning a

gold-hilted dagger flat on the velvet tabletop, smoke curling past in amber light,

the blade catching a single glint.

- SHOT 2 (2–4s | Behavior): Medium shot of her tapping ash from a slender cigarette

holder against a crystal tray, unhurried, coat sliding slightly further off one

shoulder, completely unbothered.

- SHOT 3 (4–6s | Expression): Close-up on her face as her half-lidded gaze lifts

slowly to camera, a confident smirk forming as she exhales a slow curl of smoke.

- SHOT 4 (6–9s | Environment Reveal): Wide shot revealing the full lounge around her —

velvet booths, neon bleeding through the blinds, rain tracking down the window

glass, she sits centered in the one shaft of amber light.

- SHOT 5 (9–12s | Confident Movement): Tracking shot as she rises from the booth and

walks toward camera with unhurried confidence, coat trailing off her shoulders,

dagger held loose at her side, boots striking the floor in rhythm.

- SHOT 6 (12–15s | Hero Poster Frame): Low-angle hero shot, strong silhouette against

the rain-streaked, neon-lit window behind her, dagger held at her hip, faint smirk,

smoke still drifting past — the poster frame.

Weighty natural animation, coat and hair reacting to her movement, subtle facial

micro-expressions, filmic 24fps shutter, shallow depth of field.

NOT flat 2D cartoon, no painterly brushwork, no anime style, no cel-shading — fully

photoreal cinematic rendering only.

prompts.prompt:
Create a premium, modern high-fashion CHARACTER CONCEPT ART SHEET in a 16:9 widescreen
layout on a pure white background. THE ATTACHED REFERENCE IMAGE DEFINES THE ART STYLE —
treat it as a strict style bible and reproduce its exact rendering technique in every
figure on this sheet, with zero deviation and zero blending toward any other style.

[STYLE — MIRROR THE REFERENCE EXACTLY]: Replicate the reference image's rendering
verbatim — clean physically-based/photoreal 3D render, smooth realistic skin shading
with soft subsurface scattering, crisp studio lighting with a soft single key light and
gentle fill, realistic cloth and leather material response (matte knit bodysuit, soft
wool-blend coat drape, glossy leather boot sheen, brushed-metal dagger hilt), no
outlines, no cel-shading, no painterly brushwork, no posterized color blocks. Color
palette exactly as shown: deep burgundy, black and warm gold accent, neutral warm-white
studio background. Every figure — centerpiece, turnarounds, poses, expression heads,
detail crops — must look like it was rendered from the same 3D file, same lighting rig,
same material shaders as the reference image.

[STYLE PROHIBITIONS — ABSOLUTE]: Do not add outlines or lineart. Do not flatten into
cel-shading or posterized color blocks. Do not shift toward painterly/illustrated
brushwork. Do not darken, add contrast, or relight away from the soft even studio
lighting shown in the reference. If uncertain whether the reference shows a given
feature, leave it out rather than guess.

[PROPORTIONS]: Match the reference's realistic human proportions in every figure —
natural anatomy, true-to-life limb length and scale, not stylized or elongated. Do not
alter proportions in the smaller studies.

[SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION]: VESPER NOIR — Role: Underworld Information Broker. Core Mood:
Sultry, unhurried danger. Visual Signature: plunging bodysuit + draped opera coat off
one shoulder + gold dagger. Extremely tall adult woman in her mid-20s, mature sharp
jawline, warm olive skin, sleek jet-black hair in a low chignon with a loose
face-framing strand, dramatic winged eyeliner, deep burgundy lips, a small beauty mark
near her mouth, half-lidded sultry gaze, confident smirk. Wears a fitted deep-plum
bodysuit with a plunging neckline, a thin black choker with a small skull charm, worn
under a massive draped black coat slipped off both shoulders and gathered at the
forearms, thigh-high matte-black leather boots, an ornate gold-hilted dagger held
against her hip. Signature pose: weight shifted onto one hip, chin tilted down, sidelong
glance at camera.

Layout Composition (Organize strictly into these sections):

1. LEFT PANEL: METADATA & TURNAROUND
- Large, bold vertical typography "VESPER NOIR" in a clean, heavy sans-serif condensed
  font.
- Metadata Block: "ROLE: INFORMATION BROKER", "CORE MOOD: SULTRY, UNHURRIED DANGER",
  "VISUAL SIGNATURE: OPERA COAT + GOLD DAGGER".
- MINI TURNAROUND: 3 small vertical figures — neutral, back view, profile — rendered in
  the identical photoreal reference style.
- SILHOUETTE STUDY: 3 solid-black silhouettes matching the turnaround stances.
- EXPRESSION STUDY (bottom left): exactly 4 small close-up headshots with subtle
  expression shifts (smirk, sidelong glance, cold stare, faint smile), same
  reference-matched rendering.

2. CENTRAL PANEL: THE CENTERPIECE
- One giant, dominant full-body figure in the signature pose, maximum detail, perfect
  style-match to the reference image.

3. RIGHT PANEL: MULTI-POSE & THEMATIC STUDIES
- POSE STUDY: 4–5 small-to-medium figures in varied confident stances (leaning against
  an unseen doorway, seated with legs crossed, coat swirling mid-turn, dagger held low,
  arms crossed appraising something offscreen), each with a small handwritten-style
  label underneath.
- SPECIALTY STUDY: a vertical strip of 4–6 portrait variations, same reference-matched
  rendering.

4. BOTTOM RIGHT PANEL: DETAIL STUDY
- Exactly 5 small square close-up crops: the dagger hilt, the choker's skull charm, the
  coat's collar and lapel, the boots' leather texture, the chignon hairstyle. Each with a
  clean handwriting-style label underneath.

The entire sheet must read as one consistent studio-grade character design bible where
every element could be a crop from the reference image itself: same rendering
technique, same palette, same light values throughout.

prompts.prompt:
A morning walk. Woman, golden retriever, quiet suburban park. Nothing happens except a dog being a dog. And the beat that sells the whole thing is him not quite finishing the fetch.

Most people write vlog prompts where everything goes right. Real footage is full of small failures nobody edits out, and that's precisely what makes it read as real rather than staged.

Here's the full prompt:

CAMERA: Handheld DV 16mm daily vlog footage. The video MUST begin with her holding the camera at arm's length in selfie mode while stepping outside her apartment building with her dog. The first 20–30 seconds are entirely handheld. Later she occasionally places the camera on a park bench, low stone wall, picnic table, or the ground for wider shots. Keep subtle handheld shake, drifting composition, autofocus hunting, rushed reframing, uneven zooms, exposure breathing, brief accidental face cropping, and imperfect framing throughout. The camera itself is never visible.

LOOK: Warm analog tape texture with gentle film grain, slightly softened sharpness, subtle halation around sunlight, realistic skin tones, low contrast, tiny exposure shifts, and natural motion blur. Authentic footage from someone's everyday life rather than a polished commercial.

STYLE: A relaxed morning lifestyle vlog. Quiet, cozy, spontaneous. She occasionally laughs at her dog, pauses to look around, adjusts the leash, brushes hair away from her face, and speaks naturally in short sentences with comfortable pauses.

CHARACTER: EMMA, mid-20s. Long light brown hair in a messy ponytail, green eyes, minimal makeup, oversized gray hoodie, black biker shorts, white sneakers, small crossbody bag. Walking a happy golden retriever.

SETTING: A peaceful suburban neighborhood on a sunny morning. Tree-lined sidewalks, quiet residential streets, birds singing, a small park with benches, green grass, soft golden morning light. Very few people around.

SCENES: Opens in selfie mode, leaving the apartment building, dog pulling excitedly on the leash. "Good morning." Smiles. "Someone couldn't wait." The dog sniffs everything as they walk. Quiet laugh. "He has to inspect every single tree." Still handheld, into a small park. The dog stops and stares at a squirrel. "Oh... there we go." Small headshake. She sets the camera on a bench for a wider angle and throws a tennis ball. The dog chases it. "Worth waking up early." Picks the camera back up, walking slowly, looks up at the trees. "It's actually really peaceful out here." The dog returns with the ball but drops it halfway. She laughs. "Close enough." She sits on the bench, dog lying beside her, scratching behind his ears. "I think he's happier than I am." Stands, keeps walking, selfie mode heading home. "Coffee is definitely next." Smiles into the lens. "See you later." Small wave, ends the recording.

A few things worth noticing about why it's built this way:

The dog is the unpredictability engine. Stopping at a squirrel, dropping the ball halfway, inspecting every tree. An animal doing animal things gives the scene a randomness that a scripted human beat never would.

The camera gets put down and picked back up. Handheld, then propped on a bench for the wide, then handheld again. That rhythm is what an actual vlogger does, and it's why the wide shots don't feel like a different production.

Every line is four words or fewer. "Close enough." "Worth waking up early." Nobody narrates in full sentences while walking a dog.

And the camera block is a list of mistakes on purpose. Autofocus hunting, accidental face cropping, drifting composition. Every one is a flaw, and every one is doing the heavy lifting.

Seedance 2.5 handled it clean. The tech isn't the limiting factor anymore, asking it to look imperfect is.

Keep the visual world minimal, iconic and graphic while making every body movement physically believable and naturally timed. Open on a young woman shown as a pure black silhouette against an intense lime green background. She wears wired white earbuds connected to a compact glossy white music player held loosely near her hip. Her long hair moves with realistic inertia as she dances, shifting weight through her hips and shoulders, tossing her head and lifting one arm with spontaneous confidence. Keep the camera mostly locked in a medium full body composition with crisp silhouette edges and subtle natural motion in the earphone cable. At roughly two seconds cut sharply to a rich purple background and a second female silhouette with large curly hair. Use a tighter upper body framing. She leans backward with joyful energy, stretches one arm dramatically across the frame and lets her curls react naturally to every acceleration. Follow with a tight crop of her torso, hand, white music player and looping earphone cable. Around four seconds cut to a young male silhouette against vivid hot pink. Medium profile composition, relaxed rhythmic shoulder movement, understated head motion, white earbuds clearly visible and the cable dropping naturally toward the player on his chest or hand. At five seconds return abruptly to lime green with a wide full body view of the long haired woman. She bends deeply forward, then rises into an energetic hair toss while spreading one arm outward. Preserve accurate balance, joint movement, hair physics and cable physics. Continue alternating between pink male dance shots, purple closeups and lime green female dance shots every one to two seconds. Vary framing between full body, medium shot and extreme torso detail. Use hard editorial cuts rather than smooth transitions. No camera shake. No artificial cinematic depth of field. Backgrounds remain completely flat, seamless and shadowless. At nine seconds include a close purple shot of hands interacting naturally with the small white music player while the body keeps dancing. At ten seconds return to the long haired woman on green, then show the curly haired woman on purple performing a dramatic backward lean with arms extended. At twelve seconds cut to another close detail of the white player and curved cable. At thirteen seconds return to the male silhouette on hot pink. During the final second create a very brief intentional digital glitch transition. Place a smaller lime green dancing frame inside layered pink and green graphic fields, with horizontal signal distortion, slight image displacement and repeated silhouette echoes, then snap back toward the clean green dance image. Maintain perfectly consistent black silhouettes, bright white earphones and player, saturated lime green, purple and hot pink backgrounds, crisp edges, realistic human timing, convincing hair momentum, natural cable drag and authentic editorial rhythm. No text, no logos, no extra objects, no malformed hands, no duplicated limbs, no floating accessories. Music: energetic retro electronic pop instrumental around 110 BPM with punchy drums, tight bass, bright synth accents and rhythmic edit points synchronized precisely with the dancer movements and every color cut. Clean professional mix, no vocals.

prompts.prompt:
使用上面的图片，我继续将其作为参考，并且与GPT 5.6合作，生成了以下Prompt，并最终使用Seedance 2.5完成视频生成：
以参考图片为视觉基础，严格延续其中仓库的空间结构、TV堆叠方式、旧物质感与整体色调。画面具有真实电影摄影质感，节奏由缓慢克制逐渐转为流畅梦幻，通过镜头持续推进、屏幕匹配剪辑与无缝穿越，依次切换不同年代的电视机，并进入对应年代的影视风格影像。

0-5秒：昏暗、空旷的旧仓库，空气中漂浮着细小灰尘，远处堆满不同时期的老式电视机。冷灰色环境光从高窗斜射进来，地面略微潮湿并反射微弱荧光。镜头以低机位缓慢向TV堆推进，轻微手持呼吸感，仓库深处传来电流杂音和磁带运转声。大部分电视处于熄灭状态，偶尔有一两台闪过雪花与微弱亮点。

5-10秒：镜头继续稳定推进，一台1950—1960年代的黑白木壳圆角电视逐渐成为画面中心。屏幕突然亮起，出现高反差黑白影像：雨夜街道、撑伞行人、老式汽车从远处驶过，画面带有胶片颗粒、划痕、轻微跳帧和边缘暗角。镜头靠近屏幕，电视玻璃上的仓库倒影与黑白影像短暂叠化，随后镜头无缝穿入屏幕，进入黑白电影世界。

10-15秒：黑白雨夜中的汽车从镜头前横向经过，以车身遮挡完成匹配转场。汽车驶离后，场景变为1970年代暖褐色电影风格：夕阳下的公路、随风晃动的树影、复古服装人物的朦胧背影，色彩偏暖、低饱和，带明显16mm胶片颗粒与漏光。镜头缓慢向前滑行，人物回头的一瞬间，画面出现模拟电视信号扭曲和横向扫描线。

15-20秒：信号扭曲自然切换到1980年代的CRT电视画面。镜头仿佛从屏幕内部退回仓库，眼前是一台黑色塑料外壳电视，周围霓虹灯微微闪烁。屏幕播放80年代都市夜景：潮湿街道、红蓝霓虹、车灯拖影、录像带色偏、过曝高光与VHS噪点。镜头再次快速靠近屏幕，穿过一束迎面而来的车灯，利用强光完成无缝转场。

20-25秒：强光消退后进入1990年代家庭录像风格。画面是夏日下午的室内窗边，白色窗帘被风吹起，桌上散落旧照片与磁带，一道人物身影从走廊经过。画面采用4:3比例、柔和偏绿色调、DV噪点、时间感强烈的自然曝光和轻微失焦。人物经过镜头时形成前景遮挡，遮挡结束后切换到2000年代早期宽屏电视中的影像：城市天台、蓝调黄昏、快速掠过的云层，数码摄影质感逐渐变得清晰。

25-30秒：镜头从2000年代影像中平滑后退，重新回到参考图片中的仓库。此时不同年代的电视机同时亮起，每块屏幕分别播放刚才出现过的黑白雨夜、暖色公路、霓虹城市、家庭录像与蓝调天台，光线在灰尘和地面上交错闪烁。镜头继续缓慢后移，所有电视画面逐台熄灭，最后只剩中央一台电视发出柔和白光；电流声骤然安静，画面停留一秒，为后续片名或正片留出自然衔接空间。

整体要求：写实电影级画面，文艺、怀旧、克制、略带梦境感；所有年代转换必须保持空间与运动方向连续，优先使用推镜、遮挡转场、亮度匹配、形状匹配、信号故障与穿越屏幕实现无缝衔接；镜头运动流畅且具有真实惯性，避免生硬跳切。不同年代需准确呈现对应电视机外观、画幅比例、胶片或录像介质质感。统一仓库主空间与参考图片视觉特征，光影细腻，灰尘、屏幕反光、玻璃折射、CRT扫描线和电流闪烁真实自然。无台词、无字幕、无水印、无品牌标识，声音以仓库环境音、电流声、磁带机械声、雨声和低沉氛围音乐逐渐融合。

prompts.prompt:
CAMERA:
DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld aesthetic. A gorgeous glamorous European fitness influencer films herself directly by hand in selfie-cam and first-person style. Keep realistic hand shake, slightly crooked framing, delayed autofocus, awkward zoom-ins and zoom-outs, occasional motion blur, and small framing mistakes where part of her face briefly slips out of frame. Mix handheld selfie footage with a few fixed external shots. Important: never show her placing, adjusting, or setting up a camera. When switching from handheld footage to a fixed external angle, use a clean jump cut as if the camera had already been positioned before the shot began. The camera itself must never appear on screen.

LOOK:
Soft digital tape camcorder look with subtle vintage DV character. Slight blur, faint tape noise, mild highlight bloom under gym lighting, subtle auto-exposure flicker, muted contrast, realistic skin texture, believable indoor lighting, realistic skin tones.

STYLE:
A realistic late-night gym vlog with a sexy Instagram-model vibe. The tone is playful, confident, a little flirty, slightly breathless, and natural. She is clearly attractive and charismatic, but the video should still feel like a believable self-recorded vlog, not a polished commercial. Fast clean jump cuts, strong continuity, natural body language, no awkward dead moments.

CHARACTER:
An exceptionally beautiful glamorous European brunette woman in her mid-20s. She has a highly photogenic face, large almond-shaped brown eyes, long lashes, full glossy lips, sculpted cheekbones, a refined nose, flawless lightly tanned glowing skin, and long thick glossy dark-brown hair tied in a high ponytail. She looks like a high-end Instagram fitness and lifestyle influencer, not an ordinary gym visitor. She has a slim, feminine, athletic hourglass figure. She wears polished soft-glam makeup, a fitted stylish long-sleeve athletic crop top, high-waisted fitted leggings, clean white sneakers, and a towel around her neck or over one shoulder. No jewelry.

SETTING:
A quiet modern gym late at night. Mirror wall, dumbbell rack, flat bench, stretching mat, a water bottle on a bench, soft warm overhead lights, mostly empty space, calm atmosphere, no crowd, no trainer, no extra people.

IMPORTANT CONTINUITY RULES:
The same woman must remain fully consistent in every shot. No face changes, no hairstyle changes, no outfit changes, no body changes. No extra people appearing. No duplicated limbs. No broken hands. No disappearing water bottle. No broken gym equipment. No impossible movements. No camera visible. No camera setup shown. Keep her beautiful, polished, and photogenic in every shot.

STORYBOARD (30 seconds total, 10 cuts):

1. (~3s, arm’s-length selfie)
She walks slowly through the gym holding the camera herself, slightly out of breath but smiling confidently.
Dialogue: “Okay… late-night gym vlog.”

2. (~3s, handheld pan across the room and back to her)
The camera drifts across the dumbbell rack, mirror wall, and empty gym floor, then returns to her face.
Dialogue: “It’s basically empty in here.”

3. (~3s, mirror selfie angle)
She stops near the mirror, adjusts her ponytail, glances at herself, then smirks at the lens.
Dialogue: “I look tired, but we’re still doing this.”

4. (~3s, fixed external medium shot)
Jump cut to a fixed shot. She is already in position near the bench, picks up a pair of dumbbells, and gets ready. No camera setup shown. No dialogue.

5. (~3s, same fixed shot)
She performs a short controlled set of dumbbell shoulder presses or dumbbell chest presses with clean form, then lowers the weights and exhales with a smile.
Dialogue: “That woke me up fast.”

6. (~3s, handheld walking selfie)
She picks the vlog back up in selfie mode, towel over one shoulder, breathing a little harder as she walks a few steps.
Dialogue: “Upper body done… and I’m already dying.”

7. (~3s, tight handheld close-up)
She grabs the water bottle, takes a drink, lowers it, and exhales in relief.
Dialogue: “Best part of the workout.”

8. (~3s, fixed external wider shot facing the mirror)
Jump cut to a fixed shot. She does a quick playful stretch, a small mirror pose, then laughs softly at herself.
Dialogue: “A little stretch so I can pretend I’m disciplined.”

9. (~3s, handheld close selfie)
Her cheeks are slightly flushed, she brushes back a loose strand of hair, smiling in a tired but satisfied way.
Dialogue: “I always say quick workout… and then stay forever.”

10. (~3s, arm’s-length selfie ending)
She walks toward the exit, still filming herself, gives a tired little wave and a genuine smile.
Dialogue: “Okay, I’m done. Good night.”

FINAL INSTRUCTION:
The result must feel like a real self-recorded late-night gym vlog by a glamorous Instagram fitness influencer. Prioritize realistic handheld motion, strong continuity, believable pacing, natural breathing, attractive appearance, and subtle imperfection. Keep it sexy, polished, and realistic — not artificial, not stiff, not boring.

prompts.prompt:
15-second hyper-realistic live-action cinematic action sequence, 16:9 widescreen. Tomb Raider-inspired adventure atmosphere. A fearless athletic brunette adventurer with one long dark braid, olive-green fitted tank top, weathered brown shorts, rugged utility belt, fingerless gloves and worn leather combat boots rides a powerful realistic dirt bike at extreme speed through a sun-baked coastal canyon. Preserve exactly the same woman, face, hairstyle, clothes, body proportions, motorcycle and environment throughout every shot.

Absolute photographic live-action realism. Real human skin, pores, sweat, dust, fabric fibers, worn leather, scratched metal, real suspension movement, tire deformation, realistic weight, inertia, gravity and momentum. Natural Mediterranean sunlight, hard highlights, deep canyon shadows, airborne dust, wind violently moving her braid and clothes, strong sunlight glittering across the ocean. A large elegant white yacht is clearly visible offshore below the cliff, anchored on calm deep-blue water.

0.0–1.3s — SHOT 1 — EXTREME LOW FRONT THREE-QUARTER TRACKING SHOT.
Start immediately inside the action, camera only centimeters above the rocky trail, very wide 18mm perspective. The front tire violently enters frame and blasts past loose stones toward camera position, suspension compressing over uneven terrain. The rider attacks the canyon at full speed. Huge dust trail fills the background. Strong parallax from rocks whipping past the lens. Visceral natural camera vibration, believable motion blur, intense sense of speed.
1.3–2.8s — SHOT 2 — TIGHT SIDE PROFILE TELEPHOTO.
Hard cut to a compressed 100mm side tracking view framed tightly on the rider from waist to head. Canyon walls streak behind her. Her focused face remains razor sharp while her braid lashes horizontally in the wind. Dust particles catch direct sunlight. Her gloved hand twists the throttle and the bike surges forward. Extremely shallow depth of field with natural focus breathing.

2.8–4.2s — SHOT 3 — REAR WHEEL ACTION CLOSE-UP.
Ground-level 35mm shot positioned behind and beside the rear tire. The wheel tears through gravel, throwing real stones and dense dust backward. Camera rapidly tilts upward from the spinning tire to reveal the narrowing canyon opening ahead and the first brilliant glimpse of the sea beyond it.
4.2–6.1s — SHOT 4 — HIGH CLIFFSIDE WIDE REVEAL.
Hard cut to a spectacular stationary high-angle 24mm composition from the rocky canyon wall. The motorcycle races diagonally across frame toward the cliff edge. For the first time reveal the immense scale: canyon, cliff, sparkling Mediterranean sea far below and the white yacht anchored offshore. The rider remains clearly identifiable. Strong visual depth with foreground rock crossing close to lens.

6.1–7.5s — SHOT 5 — FRONTAL LONG-LENS COMPRESSION.
180mm frontal view from beyond the final straight section. The motorcycle charges directly toward frame with the ocean appearing visually compressed behind her. Heat shimmer over the ground, dust rolling around the wheels, sunlight flashing on metal. Her expression is determined. At the last instant the front suspension unloads as she reaches the natural stone lip of the cliff.
7.5–9.3s — SHOT 6 — CLIFF-EDGE LOW ANGLE HERO SHOT.
Cut to an ultra-low 21mm side angle exactly at cliff level. The motorcycle explodes naturally out of the dust cloud and leaves the ground. For a fraction of a second the wheels silhouette against the brilliant ocean horizon. Realistic ballistic trajectory, correct gravity, rotating wheels, realistic body posture and suspension extension. The enormous drop beneath her becomes immediately visible. The yacht remains far below in the background.

9.3–11.6s — SHOT 7 — PARALLEL MID-AIR TRACKING.
Spectacular 50mm lateral tracking composition moving parallel to the airborne motorcycle, open ocean filling the entire background. She deliberately pushes away from the motorcycle in mid-air: hands release the handlebars, boots separate cleanly from the bike, her body rotates away while the motorcycle continues independently along its own believable ballistic arc. Make the separation anatomically clear and physically continuous. Her braid and clothing whip violently in the airflow. Sunlight flashes across the water behind her.
11.6–13.1s — SHOT 8 — VERTICAL CLIFFSIDE PERSPECTIVE.
Hard cut to a dramatic steep downward 28mm view from the cliff face. The woman falls toward the ocean with arms extending into a controlled diving posture while the motorcycle falls several meters away on a clearly different trajectory. The white yacht creates an enormous scale reference below. Realistic acceleration from gravity, realistic wind interaction, no floating or slow-motion physics.

13.1–15.0s — SHOT 9 — WATER-LEVEL IMPACT FINALE.
Camera almost touching the ocean surface, long 70mm perspective aimed slightly upward toward the cliff. The adventurer enters frame rapidly from above and performs a clean head-first dive into the sea close to camera, producing a powerful physically accurate splash that briefly fills the lens with real water droplets. In deep background, the distant motorcycle hits the water separately. End on sunlight exploding through suspended droplets with the white yacht clearly visible behind the splash.
Editing rhythm is aggressive, premium theatrical action cinema: every cut changes angle, lens scale, depth and movement while preserving perfect spatial continuity. The viewer must always understand where the woman, motorcycle, cliff, ocean and yacht are relative to one another. Escalate visual scale continuously from intimate mechanical details to the enormous ocean reveal and final water impact.

Hyper-dynamic but never chaotic. Natural handheld micro-movement only when appropriate, precise subject tracking, foreground wipes from rocks and dust, realistic optical motion blur, subtle anamorphic lens characteristics, organic lens flare only when caused by the real sun, natural exposure shifts, cinematic highlight roll-off, rich but realistic color grading, detailed shadows, authentic atmospheric perspective.
Strict photoreal live-action aesthetic. Everything must appear captured physically on a real coastal location with a real human performer, real motorcycle, real canyon, real ocean and real yacht. No 3D, no CGI appearance, no VFX aesthetic, no digital environment, no fantasy, no supernatural physics, no game-engine look, no artificial plastic skin, no duplicated character, no deformed anatomy, no extra limbs, no changing clothes, no changing motorcycle, no impossible camera reflections, no visible drone, no visible camera, no visible filming equipment, no crew, no text, no logo, no watermark.
