prompts.prompt:
Create a complete 30-second vertical 9:16 cinematic 3D animated short titled “The Cloud That Followed One Sad Boy.”
Generate the entire story directly from text only. Do not rely on reference images, character sheets, storyboard images, existing characters, logos, brands, or copyrighted IP.
VISUAL STYLE LOCK:
Premium original stylized 3D animated short-film aesthetic with appealing rounded character designs, expressive faces, slightly exaggerated animation poses, soft handcrafted textures, colorful storybook architecture, lush vegetation, cinematic global illumination, gentle volumetric sunlight, soft depth of field, warm pastel colors, highly readable silhouettes, fluid character animation, believable cloth and rain physics, polished feature-animation quality.
The visual tone begins playful and slightly frustrating, becomes quiet and emotional in the middle, then ends warm, magical and heartwarming.
Maintain exactly the same visual style throughout the entire 30 seconds.
MAIN CHARACTER — NOAH:
Noah is an original 8-year-old boy.
Small child proportions, slim build, warm medium-brown skin, round expressive face, large dark-brown eyes, small nose, soft cheeks, messy short dark-brown curly hair.
Wardrobe must remain identical for the entire video:
bright mustard-yellow hooded jacket worn open,
soft turquoise T-shirt,
navy-blue knee-length shorts,
white ankle socks,
red canvas sneakers with white soles,
small faded green cross-body satchel.
His clothes become progressively damp because of the rain, but their design and colors never change.
Noah initially looks lonely and mildly frustrated rather than deeply distressed.
SECOND CHARACTER — PUFF:
Puff is a tiny magical cloud, roughly 60 cm wide, floating about 30–50 cm above Noah's head.
Puff has a soft rounded fluffy white body with pale blue-gray undersides, tiny rounded cloud puffs around its edges, two small expressive dark eyes and a tiny simple mouth.
Puff has no arms, no legs and no clothing.
Puff floats by gently bobbing through the air.
Its shape remains consistent throughout the film.
Puff can subtly squash, stretch and curl its edges to communicate emotion, but never transforms into another object or creature.
When happy, Puff becomes brighter and fluffier.
When sad, its underside becomes slightly grayer and it droops lower.
Only Puff produces the localized rain following Noah.
FLOWER:
One tiny wilted fantasy flower grows beside the cobblestone path.
It has a thin green stem, two drooping leaves and one closed pale-pink blossom.
After receiving water it naturally transforms into one large glowing peach-and-pink flower, roughly large enough to shelter Noah and Puff beneath its petals.
ENVIRONMENT LOCK:
A whimsical fantasy village on a beautiful sunny afternoon.
Cream stone cottages with curved terracotta roofs, colorful flower boxes, winding cobblestone streets, tiny market stalls, hanging fabric banners, distant green hills and a bright blue sky filled with soft white clouds.
Warm golden sunlight illuminates the village everywhere except directly underneath Puff.
There is no storm.
The unusual visual joke is that a miniature rain shower follows only Noah while everyone and everything around him remains sunny and dry.
Maintain consistent village architecture and geography between shots.
STORYTELLING RULE:
The audience must understand the premise visually within the first two seconds.
Use clean cinematic cuts between story beats.
Do not teleport characters between shots.
Every action must clearly cause the next action.
Keep acting large, charming and easily readable on a phone screen.
Never overcrowd the frame.
==================================================
0:00–0:04 — IMMEDIATE VIRAL HOOK
Open immediately on a medium-wide frontal tracking shot.
Noah walks slowly down the perfectly sunny village street looking gloomy.
Directly above him floats tiny Puff.
A ridiculous narrow column of rain pours only onto Noah.
The cobblestones immediately around Noah are wet while everything just one meter away is completely dry and glowing in sunshine.
Noah's curly hair and mustard-yellow jacket are damp.
He takes two annoyed steps.
Puff perfectly follows.
Noah suddenly stops.
Puff stops.
Noah steps sideways.
Puff glides sideways with him.
Noah looks straight upward with exhausted disbelief.
CAMERA:
Smooth backward tracking movement keeping Noah centered.
At the final second, gently tilt upward toward Puff.
DIALOGUE — NOAH, young natural child voice, frustrated but funny:
“Seriously? Again?”
AUDIO:
Bright whimsical pizzicato music begins immediately.
Tiny rain patter directly above Noah.
Light village ambience.
Birds chirping in the dry sunny background.
Soft wet sneaker footsteps.
==================================================
0:04–0:09 — COMEDY ESCALATION
Noah suddenly runs.
Cut to energetic side tracking.
He races past a fruit stand.
Puff accelerates effortlessly above him and the tiny rain shower continues following him perfectly.
Noah ducks beneath a striped market awning.
The rain stops hitting him for half a second.
Noah smiles triumphantly.
Puff calmly floats around the edge of the awning and lowers itself beside the opening.
Rain immediately splashes Noah again.
Noah's smile disappears.
A vendor in the distant background looks confused but does not become an important character.
Noah runs onward.
CAMERA:
Fast smooth side tracking with Noah.
Brief static comedic hold when Noah believes he has escaped.
Quick push-in on Noah's disappointed face when the rain returns.
AUDIO:
Fast playful percussion joins the music.
Running footsteps.
Little splashes.
Fabric awning flutter.
Tiny comedic musical “plink” when Puff finds him.
No dialogue.
==================================================
0:09–0:14 — CONFRONTATION
Cut to a quieter small cobblestone lane beside the village.
Noah stops abruptly.
Puff nearly floats past him, then gently drifts backward.
The rain continues.
Noah turns around, plants both feet, looks directly upward and points at Puff.
Camera moves into a medium close-up including Noah and Puff.
Noah says:
“Why are you following me?”
The music immediately softens.
Puff's rain stops.
Puff's fluffy edges droop.
Its pale underside becomes slightly gray.
Puff lowers several centimeters and gives one tiny apologetic cloudy whimper.
Noah's angry expression slowly changes into confusion.
CAMERA:
Begin medium shot.
Slow emotional push-in.
Hold long enough to clearly read Puff's sadness.
AUDIO:
Music reduces to soft piano and glockenspiel.
Rain fades naturally to silence.
Tiny airy “puff” whimper from Puff.
Distant village ambience remains.
==================================================
0:14–0:19 — DISCOVERY
Noah turns to leave.
Camera follows his movement.
He takes one step and notices the tiny wilted pale-pink flower beside the hot dry cobblestone path.
Cut to a close insert of the flower:
drooping stem,
dry soil,
curled leaves.
Noah looks from the flower...
to Puff...
back to the flower.
His eyes widen as he gets an idea.
His expression shifts from frustration to gentle excitement.
He crouches beside the flower and points toward it.
DIALOGUE — NOAH, quiet realization:
“Wait... you can help.”
Puff perks up slightly.
CAMERA:
Close-up flower insert.
Cut to Noah's face.
Then rack focus from Noah's pointing hand to Puff floating behind him.
AUDIO:
One hopeful musical note.
Soft magical bell texture begins underneath the score.
No rain yet.
==================================================
0:19–0:25 — MAGICAL PAYOFF
Noah carefully gestures for Puff to move over the wilted flower.
Puff hesitates for a fraction of a second, then happily floats directly above it.
One single sparkling raindrop forms underneath Puff.
Extreme close-up:
the drop falls in slow motion.
It lands in the dry soil.
Soft magical light travels through the soil into the stem.
Then Puff releases a gentle miniature shower.
The wilted flower straightens.
Leaves unfold.
The small closed blossom rapidly but organically blooms into a huge luminous peach-and-pink fantasy flower.
Its petals spiral outward above Noah like a beautiful umbrella.
Golden pollen sparkles drift through the sunlight.
Noah's mouth opens in amazement.
Puff's body becomes brighter and fluffier.
CAMERA:
Macro close-up of the first raindrop.
Follow the droplet downward.
Tilt upward with the growing flower.
Finish on a dramatic wide reveal showing Noah, Puff and the enormous flower.
AUDIO:
Clear single water-drop sound.
Growing magical shimmer.
Soft leaf unfurling sounds.
Music swells into warm strings and bells.
Gentle rain remains audible.
No dialogue during the transformation.
==================================================
0:25–0:30 — HEARTWARMING END + VISUAL CALLBACK
The huge flower now shelters Noah beneath its enormous curved petals.
Puff floats happily beside him.
Noah looks at Puff and smiles for the first time.
Puff gives one happy little bounce.
A few tiny raindrops begin falling again.
Noah notices.
Instead of getting annoyed, he laughs.
Noah opens a tiny folded red umbrella from his green satchel.
But instead of holding it over himself, Noah stretches his arm upward and carefully holds the miniature umbrella ABOVE PUFF.
The tiny cloud is now being protected from its own rain.
Puff freezes in surprise.
Its eyes widen.
Then Puff becomes bright, fluffy and extremely happy.
Noah smiles warmly.
DIALOGUE — NOAH, gentle and sincere:
“Okay. You can stay.”
Puff makes a tiny joyful chirp.
End on Noah walking toward the glowing village with Puff floating happily beside him while Noah continues absurdly holding the tiny umbrella over the cloud.
The huge flower glows behind them.
CAMERA:
Medium two-character shot for the dialogue.
Slow pull-back into a wider sunset composition as they walk away.
Hold the final readable silhouette for the last second.
AUDIO:
Warm emotional orchestral resolve.
Soft footsteps.
Very gentle rain.
Tiny joyful Puff chirp.
Birdsong returns.
Music ends with a delicate bell note.
==================================================
PERFORMANCE AND ANIMATION
Noah's body language must clearly evolve:
beginning:
slumped shoulders, slow walking, frustrated eyes.
comedy:
fast exaggerated running, annoyed reactions.
confrontation:
firm stance, pointing upward.
discovery:
curiosity, softened eyes.
payoff:
wonder and excitement.
ending:
relaxed shoulders, genuine smile and playful friendship.
Puff communicates entirely through:
eye expressions,
tiny mouth shapes,
floating height,
subtle squash and stretch,
edge curls,
brightness,
rain intensity,
and small airy vocalizations.
Puff does not speak human words.
Character motion should have clear anticipation, action, reaction and recovery.
Rain must obey gravity and interact naturally with Noah's clothing, hair, ground and flower.
==================================================
AUDIO MIX
Generate synchronized audio.
Dialogue must be clean, intelligible and naturally lip-synced to Noah.
No narrator.
No unnecessary dialogue.
No characters talking over each other.
No lyrics in the music.
Music progression:
0:00–0:09 playful whimsical comedy.
0:09–0:19 soft emotional piano and bells.
0:19–0:25 magical uplifting crescendo.
0:25–0:30 warm friendship resolution.
Prioritize dialogue above music.
Rain, footsteps, cloth movement, flower growth and Puff vocalizations should be clearly synchronized with visual actions.
==================================================
STRICT CONTINUITY
Only one Noah.
Only one Puff.
No duplicates.
No character redesign.
No face drift.
No age change.
No wardrobe change.
No unexplained accessories.
No random people suddenly entering close foreground.
No extra magical clouds.
Puff remains approximately 60 cm wide.
Puff always floats close to Noah until Noah deliberately directs it toward the flower.
Rain originates only beneath Puff.
The rest of the village remains sunny and dry.
No random weather change.
The flower exists in the same physical location before and after blooming.
No teleporting.
No object morphing except the explicitly described flower blooming.
Maintain Noah's exact mustard-yellow jacket, turquoise T-shirt, navy shorts, white socks, red sneakers and faded green satchel in every shot.
Maintain Noah's exact medium-brown skin, dark-brown curly hair and dark-brown eyes in every shot.
Maintain Puff's exact white fluffy body, pale blue-gray underside, two dark eyes and tiny mouth in every shot.
No subtitles.
No captions.
No written text.
No logos.
No watermark.
No UI.
No split screen.
No panel borders.
No photorealism.
No horror.
No violence.
No sad ending.
Create one coherent, charming, funny and emotionally satisfying 30-second animated short whose visual story remains understandable even with the sound muted.

prompts.prompt:
【风格】真实骑行 vlog（Authentic Cycling Vlog），运动相机 + 手机前摄 + 伴随车跟拍混剪，4K 真实摄影（Photorealistic），阴天柔光，皮肤有汗光与真实毛孔，无美颜无磨皮，竖屏 9:16

【时长】30秒

【场景】雨后山区盘山公路，路面湿滑泛着一层亮光，路侧金属护栏，远处山峦挂着流动的云雾，路边草木上挂着水珠

【角色】骑行者（女性，白色公路头盔，蓝色镜面骑行眼镜，深灰色短袖骑行服（胸前城市街景印花、拉链到底、领口下方夹着黑色运动相机遥控器）、酒红色骑行短裤（侧缝两道白色缝线）、粉色运动手表，黑色碳纤维公路车、黑色刀圈轮组）

【眼镜规则】只有全速骑行的镜头（镜头2、镜头5、镜头6）戴着眼镜；停车和自拍的镜头（镜头1、镜头3、镜头4、镜头7、镜头8）眼镜一律架在头盔前额上，整张脸和眼睛完全露出

【全局约束】全程同一套骑行服与头盔，不换装；汗量随时间递增，不可倒退；行进中双手必须都在车把或手机上，不出现第三只手；不出现其他骑行者抢镜

[00:00-00:04] 镜头1：低角度起步（Ground-level Low Angle）

贴地极低机位，画面下缘是湿漉漉的沥青路面。她单脚撑地停在路边，眼镜架在头盔前额，脸完全露出来，低头看了眼镜头笑了一下。

动作：她双手抬起把眼镜拉到眼睛上戴好，随后双手落回车把，脚扣"咔"地扣进踏板，曲柄转动，链条上链，前轮碾过一小片积水，水线甩向镜头两侧。

镜头随车轮向前轻微跟移，湿路面被轮胎压出一道深色湿痕。

音效：脚扣扣合的咔哒声、链条上链、轮胎压水的沙沙声。

[00:04-00:08] 镜头2：侧面伴随跟拍（Car-to-car Side Tracking）

正侧方伴随机位与她等速并行，全身入画。她压低上半身双手握下把，背部拉平，膝盖上下抽动，蓝色镜面眼镜戴在眼睛上。

背景的护栏和云雾山体在她身后横向快速拉过，形成速度线。

细节：额角渗出第一层汗，骑行服背部中缝出现一小块深色汗渍。

[00:08-00:12] 镜头3：路边停车自拍（Front Camera Selfie POV）

手机前置摄像头视角，画面轻微广角畸变。她已经停在路边单脚撑地，先用双手把眼镜推回头盔前额，露出整张脸和眼睛，再拿起手机举在斜前方。

动作：她冲镜头咧嘴笑，喘着气对镜头说了句什么，说话时肩膀随呼吸起伏，另一只手扶着车把稳住车，接着用举手机的那只手把镜头转向前方，扫过弯道和云雾山景，再转回自己脸上。

细节：额头和鼻尖有明显汗光，眼睛清晰可见，鬓角碎发被汗黏在脸上，风把耳边的碎发往后吹。画面有真实手持抖动和风噪爆音。

[00:12-00:16] 镜头4：360全景环绕（360 Action Cam / Invisible Selfie Stick）

模仿360全景运动相机效果，轻微鱼眼畸变，自拍杆被完全抹除。她仍在路边停着，双脚撑地跨在车上，眼镜架在头盔前额。镜头悬在她斜上方约一米处，围着她和车缓慢转一整圈。

画面依次转过：她的正脸和头盔顶、身后的湿路面和护栏、车尾和后轮、路侧的云雾山谷、再回到正脸。

动作：转到正脸时她抬头看镜头，笑着抬手做了个"往前走"的手势，另一只手扶着车把。

细节：手臂皮肤上有细密汗珠，手表带内侧一圈汗渍。

[00:16-00:20] 镜头5：爬坡喘息特写（Handheld Close-up / Uphill）

侧面近景，只拍她的脸和肩膀，背景是缓慢后退的山体和护栏。坡度明显，她重新戴上了眼镜，踩踏频率变慢变重。

动作：她咬着牙站起来摇车，双手死死握住车把，上半身左右摆动，嘴张开大口吸气，颈侧血管随呼吸起伏。一滴汗从太阳穴滑到下颌，被风甩飞。

细节：整件骑行服前胸和后背已经湿透变成深色，紧贴身体，头盔带上有一圈汗渍，镜面眼镜下缘起了一层薄雾。

[00:20-00:23] 镜头6：下坡第一视角（Handlebar POV / First-person）

车把固定机位，第一人称视角。画面能看到黑色车把、缠着的把带、码表屏幕和她握把的双手。

动作：车头快速冲下弯道，视线随身体压弯向左倾斜，路侧护栏和树木在画面两侧飞速掠过，前轮压过一小段积水溅起水花。她的手指按下刹车把，速度略降后再次放开。

风噪骤然放大，画面因高速产生轻微抖动和边缘模糊。

[00:23-00:27] 镜头7：终点擦汗（Static Medium Shot）

固定机位中景。她把车靠在护栏上，跨下车，摘下头盔单手拎着，眼镜随头盔一起摘下来挂在手指上，另一只手把汗湿的刘海往后一捋，头发湿成一缕缕黏在额头上。

动作：她放下头盔，双手拿起水壶仰头灌了一大口，水从嘴角流下脖子，用手背抹了一下下巴，然后长长呼出一口气，肩膀垮下来。

细节：脱头盔后头顶有明显压痕，脸颊通红发亮，眼睛周围有被眼镜压出的浅印，颈侧和锁骨有汗流下来的亮线。

[00:27-00:30] 镜头8：收尾比耶（Low Angle Pull-back）

低角度仰拍，她重新戴回头盔，眼镜架在头盔前额，整张脸露出来。她站在车旁，一只手扶着车座，另一只手举到脸侧比耶，冲镜头笑，还带着喘。身后是整片流动的云雾山谷和湿亮的盘山公路。

镜头缓缓向后下方拉远，人和车缩到画面下三分之一，山雾在她身后慢慢向上翻涌。

音效：全程链条声、变速器咔哒声、轮胎压水声、真实的粗重呼吸声与风噪，背景无音乐，最后两秒只留下风声和喘息声。

prompts.prompt:
【风格】日本大型综艺水上闯关特别节目（Japanese TV Game Show，Live-Action Broadcast），多机位实时转播，4K真实摄影（Photorealistic），高饱和夏日色彩，全片实时无慢动作

【时长】30秒

【场景】晴天户外大型休闲泳池闯关赛道，五关从左到右一字排开。第一关：5米高木制起跳台，头顶缆绳挂带滑轮的泰山绳。第二关：水面上一块直径3米的红黄配色圆形浮盘，装在水下轴上持续匀速自转，表面湿滑。第三关：四块间距不等的方形跳板浮块，随水波上下起伏。第四关：一面倾斜的蓝色湿滑爬坡墙，顶端垂下几根抓绳。第五关：横架在水面上的巨大黄色圆柱管道，湿润反光的乙烯基表面印红色火焰纹，靠电机持续匀速自转，粗细刚好能被手臂和双腿环抱，右端连着小型终点台，正下方是清澈泳池、无安全垫。背景棕榈树、大型水滑梯、灯架、解说席、坐满观众的临时观众席。全片推进方向一律从左到右。

【角色】挑战者（成年日本女性，结实健康的运动体型，穿衣服）

【固定项】五关的位置尺寸颜色与连接关系全片不变；画面中始终只有一名挑战者；开场头发和衣服是干的，只有落水后才自然湿透；圆形浮盘和黄色管道在出现的所有镜头中都必须是持续转动的

[00:00-00:03] 镜头1：泰山绳蹬出（Eye-level Medium → Wide Pull-back，ENG Camera）

画面：她双手握住绳子站在5米高台边缘，脚趾扣住台沿。

台词：「絶対クリアします！」（我一定要通关！）

动作：蜂鸣器一响，她用力向前蹬出，滑轮沿缆绳向右滑行，身体在水面上方划出钟摆轨迹，头发被风向后带起。

解说：「まずはターザンロープ！」（首先是泰山绳！）

音效：起跳蜂鸣器、滑轮滑行声、全场欢呼。

[00:03-00:07] 镜头2：转盘落地（Fixed Side Shot）

镜头：浮盘侧面固定机位，人、绳、转盘同框。

画面：红黄配色的圆形浮盘正在水面上持续匀速自转，湿滑表面反光。

动作：她松开绳子落上转盘，双脚一沾就被转盘带着向侧后方滑开，她张开双臂原地小碎步反向蹬踏抵消转速，膝盖弯曲重心压低，晃了两下站住。

表情：眉毛猛地扬起，牙关咬紧，随即咧嘴笑。

解说：「回転盤だ！耐えた！」（是转盘！撑住了！）

音效：转盘轴的低频嗡嗡声、鞋底摩擦声、爆发的欢呼。

[00:07-00:12] 镜头3：跳板连跳（Dolly Track L→R）

镜头：轨道摄像机与前进方向平行，从左向右跟移。

画面：四块方形浮块随水波上下起伏，间距不等。

动作：她从转盘边缘起跳，连续四次单脚点跳跨过浮块。第二块踩偏，浮块猛地下沉，她上身前扑双臂大幅画圈找平衡，右脚在水面拍出一片水花后勉强蹬上第三块，最后一跳双脚落上第四块。

台词：「危なっ……！」（好险……！）

解说：「二枚目で崩れた！でも繋いだ！」（第二块踩崩了！但接住了！）

音效：浮块入水的闷响、水花声、观众此起彼伏的惊呼。

[00:12-00:17] 镜头4：湿滑爬坡墙（Front 3/4 Medium Shot）

镜头：正面斜前方中景，人、坡墙、顶端抓绳同框。

画面：蓝色倾斜坡墙表面淌着水，反着光。

动作：她助跑冲上坡墙，跑了三步鞋底打滑往下溜了一截，她立刻扑倒身体双手扒住墙面，指尖抠住表面纹路，再次蹬腿爬升，右手抓到顶端垂下的抓绳，双臂发力把自己拽上顶端。

表情：脖子绷出线条，额头挤出横纹，大口喘气。

台词：「よいしょ、よいしょ……！」（嘿咻、嘿咻……！）

解说：「滑る壁！腕だけで登った！」（打滑的墙！全靠手臂爬上去了！）

音效：湿墙面的摩擦声、绳子绷紧声、全场掌声。

[00:17-00:21] 镜头5：抱上转动的柱子（Rear Side Fixed Shot）

镜头：稍靠后的固定侧机位，能看清管道正在转。

画面：黄色圆柱管道靠电机持续匀速自转，湿润的乙烯基表面上有一层水膜，红色火焰纹随转动不断卷过画面。

动作：她从坡顶跳下俯身跨上管道根部，胸腹、双臂、双腿同时箍住。管道的自转立刻把她整个人往右侧带过去，她跟着管道的转向反向调整重心，交替小幅挪动手臂和双腿往终点蹭。

台词：「えっ、回ってる！？」（诶，它在转！？）

解说：「回転丸太だ！これが最難関！」（是转动的圆木！这是最难的一关！）

音效：电机低频转动声、湿乙烯基的摩擦声。

[00:21-00:26] 镜头6：被转翻·终点前极限（Front Close-up → Medium Pull-back）

镜头：终点侧正面特写缓慢拉到中景，机位轴线不变。

动作：管道持续转动，把她的身体一点点往右侧带翻，她的重心越过管道最高点后再也压不回来。右腿先脱开在空中扑腾一下，接着右手也脱开朝终点台伸出，全身重量吊在左臂和左腿上，随管道继续向右转。

表情：太阳穴青筋鼓起，手臂肌肉发抖，眼睛瞪圆。

台词：「もうダメ、待って……！」（不行了，等等……！）

解说：「回転に負けた！あと少し！」（被转动打败了！就差一点！）

承接：右手指尖距终点台约20厘米，左手仍贴着仍在转动的管道。

[00:26-00:28] 镜头7：终点前落水（Fixed Side Shot）

镜头：管道侧面固定机位，管道、伸出的右手、终点台、正下方水面同框。

动作：管道再转过一点，支撑的左手被转到管道下侧后滑脱，她身体保持侧向顺重力直坠入泳池，砸起大片水花。管道在她落下后仍在原位持续自转。

台词：「あーっ！」（啊——！）

解说：「落ちた！丸太に回されたー！」（掉下去了！被圆木转翻了！）

音效：豪爽的入水声、观众的惊呼。

[00:28-00:30] 镜头8：水面反应收尾（Water-level Close-up，Static）

镜头：水面高度正面特写，机位静止，优先表现脸部。

动作：她从水里探出脸和肩膀，湿发一缕缕贴在脸颊上，抹了一把脸，看向终点方向皱起眉，双手拍了一下水面。

台词：「悔しい！」（好懊恼！）

动作：视线转回镜头，皱着的眉松开，转成害羞的笑，肩膀缩了一下。背景里黄色管道仍在慢慢转。

音效：全场大欢呼和掌声推到最高点。

【音响】

全片薄铺一层日本大型综艺特别节目风格的快节奏游戏秀BGM。观众欢呼、掌声、笑声、起跳蜂鸣器、滑轮滑行声、转盘和电机的低频转动声、浮块入水声、湿墙面摩擦声、湿乙烯基摩擦声、水滴声、入水声，各自与对应动作同步。解说和挑战者说自然清晰的日语，除指定说话者外不让任何人出声，台词与口型同步。台词期间BGM和欢呼自然压低，不盖过人声，不加多余旁白。

【机位与剪辑】

自然多机位电视转播，只用硬切。混用ENG摄像机、钢丝摄像机、轨道摄像机、水面高度摄像机、长焦画角，每个区间只用指定的那一种机位运动。转盘和管道所在的镜头必须选用能明确看出转动方向的构图。维持180度轴线规则和从左到右的推进方向。禁止超高速运镜、剧烈旋转、冲击变焦、过度变焦、无人机式急转弯，禁止慢动作、重播、定格、时间跳跃。

【全片禁止】

全片保持脸部、发型、体型、服装、肤色、体格、左右手脚数量一致。手脚与各关卡的接触和脱离严格按时间线顺序发生，真实表现重力、惯性、打滑、自转、水花。转动的道具不得出现静止帧或忽然停转。不出现瞬移、位置倒退、空中静止、身体变形、手脚增减、物体增殖、穿透道具、背景替换。以健康清爽的运动综艺风格呈现，服装不脱落、不破损、不透明、不过度位移。不出现真实存在的节目名、电视台名、企业名、赞助商名、商标，不出现字幕、节目logo、台标、水印、无意义文字、乱码。

Just finished testing Seedance 2.5 on a multi-scene short story workflow and… yeah, this hits different. 🔥

Same character. Different locations. Fast cuts. Complex camera moves.

2.5 kept her face, outfit details, and lighting consistent across every shot while the motion felt way more natural and cinematic.

Biggest upgrades I noticed:

• Stronger identity lock even with quick scene changes
• Cleaner transitions between shots
• Better prompt following on camera directions
• Up to 30-second generations without falling apart

If you’re into short-form storytelling or micro-films, this one is worth trying.

prompts.prompt:
Ultra-realistic behind-the-scenes film set footage, slightly high vantage point, shot like a real making-of video on a professional handheld camera from the side of a soundstage. The set is dressed like a dense Amazon jungle location: wet muddy ground, artificial trees and vines, haze in the air, hanging rigging, practical lights, camera tracks, crew members standing off to the side, and a giant hyper-realistic animatronic anaconda dominating the set. The snake looks absolutely massive, with detailed scales, wet reflections, huge fangs, and mechanical realism.

The clip begins with the director shouting, “Action!” A female actor in adventure-film costume stands in front of the giant snake, backing away nervously as if in a creature movie scene. The snake suddenly lifts its head, opens its mouth wide, and gives a loud threatening hiss. The woman starts stepping backward and says “No, no, no!” in character. The snake lunges, coils upward, lifts her, throws her into the air so she spins once in a full 360, then catches her cleanly in its mouth and appears to swallow her whole. Everyone watching is stunned for a beat.  Then immediately someone off camera yells “Cut! Cut! Cut!” The illusion breaks. The animatronic snake lowers its head and its mouth section is mechanically opened downward by the crew.

The actress casually climbs back out of the snake’s mouth, laughing and dusting herself off. She smiles and says, “I think that was a good shot.” Hair and makeup artists and crew members quickly walk in around her, checking on her and resetting the scene. The tone becomes playful and clearly behind-the-scenes. Keep it fast, clear, believable, and very realistic — like a real BTS clip from a big-budget Titanoboa-style jungle creature film. No fantasy look, no cartoon look, only grounded practical-movie-set realism.

prompts.prompt:
15s | 16:9 | 24fps | Olympic 100m final, night. One sprinter in lane 4 —
the tallest man in the field — starts level with the pack, then unfolds and
runs away from them, winning in 9.4 seconds roughly four meters clear.
Photoreal broadcast cinematography, heat-soaked stadium air, explosive crowd
energy.

=== GLOBAL SETUP ===

ENVIRONMENT & TEXTURE
Night. Olympic stadium, 80,000-seat bowl packed to the roof. Humid summer
air. Heat haze shimmering off the blue mondo track. Emphasize extremely
realistic physical texture: sweat beading and running, muscle fiber shifting
under skin, spike plates biting into the rubber, grit kicking up behind the
blocks.

VISUAL STYLE
Photoreal live sports broadcast. Shallow depth of field on close shots, deep
focus on wides. Hard key from stadium floodlights overhead. Strong rim light
separating the runners from the dark crowd. Thousands of camera flashes
popping across the stands as a moving field of white specks.

CAMERA LANGUAGE
Broadcast telephoto and trackside rail cameras. Exactly ONE camera move per
time slice. Never combine moves.

RUNNERS
Lane 4 (hero): 26-year-old African-American male sprinter, 192cm tall —
visibly the tallest man on the track, a clear head above the shortest runner
in the field. Deep brown skin with a wet sheen under the floodlights — keep
the real fine pores and natural skin texture. Long neck, broad flat
shoulders, very long legs, narrow hips, deep chest, long muscle bellies
rather than bulk. Sharp cheekbones, jaw clenched at the start, eyes locked
dead ahead on the finish line, never glancing sideways. Short cropped hair
with a close fade. Yellow-and-green singlet, bib number 4. Veins raised on
the forearms.
  Stride signature — this must be readable on screen: he takes FEWER strides
  than anyone else, about 41 to their 45. Each stride is visibly longer and
  covers more ground per contact. Because of his height he needs more
  distance to reach full upright posture, so he is NOT ahead early.
Chasing pack: seven other sprinters, treated as ONE group. Never featured
individually, never in focus. Shorter, more compact builds. Higher stride
frequency, choppier. Mixed dark and light singlets.
Crowd: an undifferentiated mass, out of focus, rising to their feet in a wave.

PERFORMANCE CORE
The story is the delay and the release. He is level with the field for the
first third, then unfolds and eats the gap alive. Show dominance through
stride length and empty track, not through slow-motion tricks.

FORBIDDEN
No subtitles. No captions. No on-screen graphics, scoreboard, timer, or any
legible text or numbers. No commentator voice. No dialogue of any kind. No
background music. No runners appearing or vanishing — exactly eight on the
track for the entire 15 seconds. Hero's face, hair, height, and singlet must
not change between shots. No flickering limbs, no duplicated arms or legs,
no warped feet.

=== TIMESTAMPS ===

0-2s / Frame 0-48 — THE STILLNESS
Action: Eight sprinters in the set position, hips high, fingertips on the
  line. Hero in lane 4, center frame — even folded into the blocks he is
  obviously the longest body in the row, knees stacked higher than anyone
  else's. A single bead of sweat crawls down his temple and hangs at his jaw.
  Absolute stillness. Crowd noise drops to a low hum.
Intent: Compress the energy. The stiller this is, the more violent the start
  reads.
Camera: Low-angle trackside rail, side-on. LOCKED OFF, no movement.
Sound: Low crowd hum, one distant whistle, the hero's held breath.
Negative: no subtitles, no music.

Frame 48 (2.0s) — THE GUN
The starter's pistol cracks. The report slaps off the stadium bowl and comes
back as an echo.

2-5s — LEVEL (0-30m)
Action: All eight fire out of the blocks. Footplates kick backward. Spikes
  tear at the track. The seven shorter runners snap upright fast, legs
  churning at high frequency. The hero stays low and long, still folded
  forward, unwinding one huge stride at a time. Through 30 meters he is dead
  level with the field — for a beat he even looks a fraction behind.
Intent: Hold the audience. Make them doubt him.
Camera: Side tracking rail matching race speed. ONE lateral move, left to
  right.
Sound: Crowd roar detonating, spikes ripping rubber, explosive breathing.
Negative: no subtitles, no music, no commentator.

5-8s — THE UNFOLDING (30-60m)
Action: He finally comes to full upright posture, later than everyone else —
  and the stride opens to its full length. Each contact now swallows the
  ground the others need two steps for. At 45 meters he draws level and goes
  past. Sweat flies off his shoulders in visible droplets, catching the
  floodlights. By 60 meters he is two body lengths clear.
Intent: The moment the race stops being a race.
Camera: Long telephoto, head-on from the finish line. ONE slow push in.
  Compressed perspective stacks the pack behind him.
Sound: Sustained roar building, a rolling wall of sound.
Negative: no subtitles, no music.

8-11.4s — ALONE (60-100m)
Action: His face settles into the top-end sprint mask — jaw loose, cheeks
  vibrating with each footstrike. Enormous, unhurried strides. Behind him the
  pack is contorted, straining, taking far more steps to cover the same
  ground. Clean empty track between him and the nearest rival, about four
  meters. Heat haze distorting the air in that gap.
Intent: Let the empty track do the work.
Camera: Low tracking rail alongside the hero. ONE steady lateral move.
Sound: Crowd at a continuous peak, breathing, spikes.
Negative: no subtitles, no music.

Frame 274 (11.4s) — THE LINE
Action: Chest hits the line. Torso dips hard. Long arms flung back. The
  timing beam breaks.
Camera: Side-on at the finish. Drop to slow motion for a beat, then return
  to real time.
Sound: The roar cresting into a single detonation.

11.4-13s — THE REST ARRIVE
Action: The chasing pack crosses roughly four-tenths of a second later,
  strung out, gasping, hands on heads. The hero is already past them in the
  frame, decelerating, towering over them as they slow around him.
Camera: Wide, ONE slow pull back to reveal the full straight.
Sound: Roar, then a ragged edge of disbelief in it.

13-15s — ECSTASY
Action: He wheels around, both long arms flung wide, mouth open in a roar
  that is swallowed by the crowd. Camera flashes storm across the stands in
  waves. He drops to his knees on the track, head tipped back, chest heaving.
Intent: Release everything the first two seconds held down.
Camera: Handheld, tight, moving with him. ONE move, following.
Sound: Crowd at maximum. A solid wall of sound with no gaps in it.
Negative: no subtitles, no music, no commentator voice.

=== CLOSING ===
Throughout all 15 seconds: night stadium under floodlights, humid heat haze,
telephoto broadcast look. Hero in lane 4 always weighted toward frame center,
always the tallest figure on the track, always taking longer strides than
anyone around him. Keep his face, hair, build, and yellow-and-green singlet
identical in every shot. Keep exactly eight runners on the track the entire
time. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text or numbers, no commentator
voice, no dialogue, no background music. Sound is crowd, spikes, breathing,
and the starter's pistol only.

prompts.prompt:
60秒垂直短劇，9:16，韓國古裝劇（Sageuk）風格（帶輕喜劇元素），說中文。

場景：朝鮮中宗時期（16世紀），宮中御膳房與中宗寢殿，木造結構、紙窗、傳統灶台與陶器。

角色設定：
徐長今（Seo Jang-geum）<<<Image4>>> ：25歲，醫女兼御廚天才。臉孔甜美卻帶妖豔魅力——杏眼含情、櫻桃小嘴、鼻樑秀挺，笑容時甜美純淨，側臉或低頭時又透著誘人風情，皮膚白皙如玉。黑長直髮以粉色布條鬆鬆束起，幾縷細碎髮絲自然垂落臉側與頸間。穿典型朝鮮時代淡粉色韓服（Chima-jeogori），上衣短小貼身，突出腰身曲線，裙擺寬大素雅；袖口微微捲起。個性聰慧堅強、善良細心、廚藝精湛但面對感情時會害羞。

中宗（King Jungjong）
<<<Image2>>> ：45歲，朝鮮第11代國王。臉容清瘦憔悴（因重病），蓄著整齊短鬍，眉宇間帶帝王威嚴與疲憊，眼神銳利。黑髮束起戴翼善冠，穿黃色龍袍（病中稍顯寬鬆）。個性嚴苛但內心孤獨。

閔政浩（Min Jeong-ho）
<<<Image3>>> ：28歲，宮中武官/長今的愛慕者。斯文小白臉憂鬱帥哥類型——五官精緻柔和，劍眉細長、丹鳳眼帶有淡淡憂鬱，鼻樑高挺，嘴唇薄而優雅，皮膚白皙，氣質溫潤如玉卻隱藏堅毅。黑髮以冠帽整齊束起，穿深藍色官服（官員常服），腰配長劍。個性忠義勇敢、溫柔深情，對長今有強烈保護欲。

拍攝風格：典型韓國古裝劇質感，使用Arri Alexa與Cooke S4鏡頭拍攝，暖黃懷舊色調（大量暖光與木質紋理），輕微膠片顆粒，強調紙窗透光與燭火氛圍，後半段加入輕喜劇效果。

分鏡腳本：
0-3s：中宗臥床，臉色疲憊，咳嗽一聲然後嚴厲地說中文：「長今，限你一小時做出年糕，否則關入大牢！」
3-6s：徐長今跪地領命，表情堅定卻帶緊張，快速起身奔向御膳房。
6-9s：徐長今在灶台前忙碌，快速料理蒙太奇：切年糕、炒辣醬、燉高湯，動作熟練快速，裙襬隨動作輕晃。
9-12s：徐長今試味道，微微出汗，甜美妖豔的臉龐帶著專注，碎髮貼在臉側。
12-15s：時間緊迫，徐長今加快翻炒，辣炒年糕色澤紅亮香氣四溢。
15-18s：閔政浩因擔心快步跑進御膳房，焦急尋找徐長今。
18-21s：他從拿著長木筷正在攪拌辣炒年糕的徐長今身後輕輕抱住她，低聲：「長今，別怕，我陪妳。」
21-24s：徐長今受驚，舉起沾了紅色辣醬的長木筷想反擊，轉身時被政浩壁咚壓在紙窗邊。
24-27s：紙窗透光映照兩人身影，政浩憂鬱深情的丹鳳眼注視徐長今。
27-30s：政浩低頭曖昧親吻徐長今，徐長今先驚訝，隨後慢慢閉眼。

30-33s：在紙窗邊，兩人深情擁吻，政浩一手扶她腰，背景鍋中辣炒年糕繼續冒熱氣。
33-36s：長今輕推政浩，喘息說中文道：「大人……現在不是時候……」
36-39s：政浩微笑幫她整理碎髮，長今迅速完成擺盤。
39-42s：長今端著辣炒年糕與政浩快步前往中宗寢殿。
42-45s：中宗用筷子夾起辣炒年糕試吃一口後，突然露出滿意表情，身體輪廓微微發亮，頭旁邊飄出各種可愛emojis，搭配「WOW～」搞笑音效。
45-48秒：長今與政浩低頭謙卑並肩站立聽訓，中宗說中文誇獎道：「果然好吃！朕決定赦免你今日之罪。」
48-51秒：中宗繼續說：「長今，妳果然是宮中第一奇女子。」
51-54秒：身後，政浩偷偷抓住長今一隻手緊握，長今突然害羞低頭微笑，甜美妖豔的臉頰微紅。
54-57秒：周邊皇宮老臣們看到這一幕，也竊竊私語、掩嘴偷笑。

prompts.prompt:
Create a 60-second premium cinematic short film titled “THE PAPER BOAT.”

STYLE:
Photorealistic live-action cinematic realism, emotionally restrained, award-winning short-film cinematography, premium theatrical production quality, natural performances, physically accurate environments, realistic water simulation, authentic atmospheric perspective, subtle film grain, natural HDR, realistic lens behavior, no artificial CGI appearance.
CORE CONCEPT:
The entire film follows one ordinary handmade paper boat on an impossible journey. There is exactly ONE impossible element in the world: this small paper boat can travel wherever connected water flows, no matter how far. Everything else obeys real-world physics.

The audience should initially believe they are watching an ordinary child's paper boat experiment. Only gradually should the journey become extraordinary.
CHARACTER 1:
A quiet 9-year-old South Asian boy with warm medium-brown skin, expressive dark eyes, slightly messy short black hair, slim build, wearing a faded mustard-yellow T-shirt, worn blue shorts and simple sandals. His appearance, clothing, hairstyle, proportions and facial identity remain perfectly consistent whenever he appears.

CHARACTER 2:
An elderly South Asian man around 70 years old, weathered expressive face, silver hair, simple cream shirt, dark trousers and worn sandals. Natural elderly movement, subtle expressions, realistic skin and hair.

THE PAPER BOAT:
One tiny handmade white paper boat folded from slightly creased school notebook paper. Imperfect folds, tiny graphite pencil marks and one faint blue crayon line on one side. It is ordinary paper, not magical-looking. No glow, no symbols, no supernatural appearance. The exact same boat must remain visually recognizable throughout the entire film, becoming slightly damp and worn during its journey.
STORY AND CAMERA:

0–5 SECONDS — THE HOOK
Extreme macro close-up with an 85mm macro lens.

A tiny handmade paper boat floats perfectly still inside a shallow rain puddle after a monsoon shower.
Raindrops strike the water around it.

One large raindrop lands directly inside the boat.

The boat rocks dangerously.

For a moment it looks like it will sink.

Instead, it rights itself.

Rack focus from the rippling water to the boy's reflection in the puddle.

The boy is crouched beside it, silently watching.

Natural breathing, blinking and tiny eye movement.

5–10 SECONDS

Low 35mm tracking shot beside the boy.

He gently pushes the boat forward with one fingertip.

He gives a tiny, genuine smile and quietly whispers:

“Ja... dekhte hain kahan jaati hai.”

Natural child delivery, soft voice, tiny pause between words, no theatrical acting.

The boat begins drifting through a thin stream of rainwater running along the street.

The boy follows it.

His sandals splash naturally through shallow water.

His shirt moves with his running.

Small droplets strike the camera lens.

10–18 SECONDS

The camera drops almost to water level and begins following the paper boat.

The boat enters a narrow concrete drainage channel.

The boy runs alongside it for a few seconds before stopping.

His expression changes from excitement to concern as the boat disappears into the channel.

The camera does NOT cut.

It continues following the boat through the drainage channel.

The narrow concrete environment gradually becomes a larger natural stream.

Use foreground leaves, flowing water and a curtain of dripping vegetation to create a seamless hidden transition.

No teleportation.

No magical transformation.

18–26 SECONDS

The stream becomes a wide river.

The camera slowly rises from water level into a graceful crane movement.

Reveal an enormous realistic river surrounded by countryside.

The tiny paper boat remains the visual anchor.

Warm sunlight begins breaking through clouds.

Wet vegetation glistens.

Birds move naturally through the distant sky.

The boy is now barely visible far behind on the riverbank.

The boat is carried faster by the current.

26–34 SECONDS

The river becomes progressively wider.

The camera remains physically connected to the boat, tracking its movement naturally.

The landscape gradually changes as the river approaches the coast.

The boat enters increasingly turbulent water.

Realistic ripples, foam, reflections and paper deformation.

The camera passes behind a large foreground tree trunk, creating a natural dark-frame transition.

When the camera emerges, the river has reached the ocean.

Reveal a vast open sea.

The tiny boat floats into the enormous expanse.

34–42 SECONDS

The camera tracks directly behind the paper boat at water level.

Ocean waves gently lift and lower it.

The boat is now slightly damp and softened but remains intact and recognizable.

Subtle environmental progression communicates distance and time:

changing cloud formations,
changing sunlight,
changing ocean conditions,
different coastlines appearing and disappearing in the distance.

Use wave spray and foreground water to conceal seamless environmental transitions.

No artificial time-lapse.

No teleportation.

Everything remains physically believable except the boat's impossible ability to continue traveling.

Seabirds occasionally cross the frame.
One bird briefly skims the ocean surface near the boat.
42–48 SECONDS
The ocean gradually approaches a quiet rocky coastline.

The camera moves from behind the boat into a graceful side profile.

A gentle wave carries the boat toward a narrow natural channel leading into a peaceful inland lake.

The soundscape becomes quieter.

The boat enters the lake.

Late-afternoon sunlight now creates warm natural reflections across the water.

Reveal the elderly South Asian man sitting alone beside the lake, sketching quietly in a small notebook.

He hears the water.

He looks up.

48–54 SECONDS

50mm medium close-up.

The elderly man notices the tiny paper boat approaching the shore.

He doesn't react dramatically.

First curiosity.

Then confusion.

Then recognition.

His breathing pauses for a moment.

His eyes soften.

He slowly stands.

The boat gently touches his sandal.

He bends down and carefully picks it up using both hands.

He examines the tiny graphite marks and faint blue crayon line.

A quiet emotional smile appears.

No dialogue.

The emotion must be communicated entirely through micro-expression, eye movement, breathing and body language.

54–60 SECONDS — EMOTIONAL CALLBACK

The elderly man takes a fresh sheet of paper from his notebook.

He begins folding a new paper boat.

Close-up on his hands.

His fingers make the first fold.

MATCH CUT:

The exact same hand movement becomes the 9-year-old boy's hands from the opening scene.

The boy is back beside the original rain puddle.

He places another handmade paper boat onto the water.

The new boat begins drifting.

The camera slowly pulls backward.

The puddle reflects the sky.

The reflection gradually fills the frame.

The reflection visually resembles the enormous lake where the elderly man was sitting.

Hold for one quiet beat.

CUT TO BLACK.

CINEMATOGRAPHY:
Professional theatrical cinematography throughout. 35mm and 50mm cinema lenses for narrative shots, 85mm macro for intimate details, natural depth of field, subtle lens breathing, realistic focus pulls, physically motivated camera movement, restrained handheld micro-movement around the child, smooth stabilized tracking around the boat, gradual crane and aerial reveals only when motivated by geography.

The camera must always feel physically present in the environment.

No impossible camera movement.

No random drone shots.

Every camera movement must reveal geography, emotion or scale.

LIGHTING:
Begin with cool, soft post-rain daylight.

Gradually transition into warm sunlight as the boat reaches the river.

Move naturally toward late-afternoon golden light when the elderly man discovers the boat.

Maintain physically consistent shadows, reflections and exposure throughout.
ENVIRONMENTAL REALISM:
Wet concrete, puddles, water droplets, muddy edges, paper fibers, damp clothing, realistic reflections, atmospheric haze, leaves reacting to wind, grass bending naturally, birds responding to the environment, subtle dust and moisture in sunlight, realistic ocean spray, accurate water interaction, natural cloth movement and hair movement.

AUDIO:
Primarily natural diegetic sound.

Rain droplets.
Flowing water.
Footsteps.
Child's breathing.
Distant traffic.
Birds.
Wind.
River current.
Ocean waves.
Paper folding.

Use a restrained cinematic score that gradually builds as the journey expands, then becomes almost silent when the elderly man discovers the boat.

No dialogue after the boy's single sentence.

EMOTIONAL ARC:
Curiosity → excitement → uncertainty → wonder → vastness → quiet discovery → emotional connection → circular beginning.
The film must NOT explain who the elderly man is or why the boat reached him.

Let the audience interpret the connection.

VISUAL RULE:
Everything in the film must look completely real except for the single impossible rule governing the paper boat.

NO:
dragons,
magic particles,
glowing objects,
portals,
fantasy environments,
cyberpunk,
giant objects,
supernatural effects,
text,
subtitles,
logos,
watermarks,
exaggerated acting,
cartoon physics,
unmotivated camera movement,
teleportation,
morphing characters,
duplicate boats,
changing boat design,
character inconsistency,
artificial-looking CGI.

FINAL FEELING:
The film should feel like a real cinematic short that quietly contains one impossible event.
The viewer should finish with the feeling:

“Wait... how did that paper boat get there?”

Then the final image should make them want to watch the entire journey again.

VISUAL PRIORITY:
Photorealism > spectacle.
Emotion > exposition.
Physics > VFX.
Story > technical demonstration.
Subtlety > exaggeration.
Make every frame feel intentionally photographed by a world-class cinematographer rather than generated by an AI model.

Do not use the runway background. @Image2 defines Nadja — brunette hair, face, and black satin gown. Do not use the runway background. ONE-SENTENCE SUMMARY: Two rival supermodels-turned-wrestlers battle inside a spotlit WWE-style ring, trading clotheslines, rope-assisted strikes, and flashy signature finishers, shot in dynamic ACTION-style sports-spectacle camerawork. DETAILED PLOT: 0s-3s (HOOK): Already mid-impact — @image1  (Vesper) whips off the ropes and connects a running clothesline across @image2 (Nadja)'s chest and shoulder. Nadja's body flips backward off her feet, crashing flat onto the mat, the impact shaking the ring ropes. Camera: low tracking shot following the clothesline's arc, crash zoom on the landing. SFX: crowd roar, ring mat slam, rope twang. 3s-7s (ESCALATION): Nadja kips up fast, eyes blazing, and charges — right hook connects to Vesper's jaw; Vesper's head snaps sideways, hair spraying with the turn, she stumbles into the ropes. Nadja follows with a body shot to the ribs — Vesper's torso crunches inward, one arm clamping to her side, grunting. Camera: handheld, tight on the exchange, whip-panning with each strike. 7s-12s: Vesper recovers, shoves off the ropes and irish-whips Nadja across the ring into the far turnbuckle — Nadja's back slams the corner pads, arching involuntarily, both hands gripping the top rope to stay upright. Vesper charges in for a corner splash; Nadja rolls clear at the last second and Vesper's shoulder drives hard into the turnbuckle instead, recoiling with a pained grimace. Camera: wide ring shot capturing the full corner spot, then push-in on Vesper's reaction. 12s-16s (POWER SHIFT): Nadja seizes the opening — grabs Vesper by the arm, whips her into the ropes. As Vesper rebounds, Nadja springs into a spinning powerslam, catching Vesper across the shoulders and driving her down flat onto the canvas with a heavy thud, both women's hair fanning out on impact. Camera: locked low angle for the slam, holding on Vesper's stunned reaction. 16s-22s (CLIMAX BUILD): Vesper rolls to the ropes, uses them to haul herself upright, blood-in-her-eyes determined. She climbs the turnbuckle, balancing on the top rope. Nadja turns, sees her too late — Vesper launches into her signature springboard clothesline, arm fully extended, connecting across Nadja's chest mid-air; Nadja is launched backward off her feet, crashing into the opposite ropes before rebounding face-first onto the mat. Camera: dramatic low-to-high crane following Vesper's leap, then whip down to the landing. 22s-27s (CLIMAX): Both women are on their knees, exhausted, throwing weak exchanges — Nadja lands a desperate elbow to Vesper's cheek, head snapping sideways; Vesper answers with a forearm smash across Nadja's jaw, staggering her. They grab each other by the shoulders, straining, both refusing to fall, the crowd roaring louder. Camera: tight symmetrical two-shot, slow push-in on the stalemate. 27s-30s (PAYOFF): Vesper breaks the clinch, ducks low, and hoists Nadja onto her shoulders in one explosive motion — driving her down in a final slam. Nadja's body hits flat, arms splayed, defeated. Vesper stands over her, chest heaving, arms raised in triumph as the crowd noise peaks. Camera: pulls back and rises into a wide victory shot, holding on Vesper's raised arms. ADDITIONAL NOTES: Setting: WWE-style wrestling ring — bright arena spotlights, ropes, turnbuckles, crowd silhouettes and flashing lights in the background, held constant for the full 30s. Both women's black satin gowns progressively rumple and shift through the fight but never tear away — track this consistently. Hair remains loose and dynamic through every impact. Crowd noise swells and dips with the action; a hard 200ms audio dip before the two signature moves (spinning powerslam, springboard clothesline), then full crowd-roar release on impact. No dialogue, no subtitles. [Strictly exclude] Blood, weapons, extreme gore, any additional wrestlers or referees unless stated.

SEEDANCE 2.5 PROMPTER AND COMPARISON

Anne Boleyn’s final walk.
For this test, I recreated the moment Anne is led toward the scaffold —building the emotion through performance, blocking, camera direction, atmosphere, and sound rather than showing graphic violence.

What makes Seedance 2.5 feel like a real upgrade is control: more characters, videos, and audios references in the same generation, supports up to 30 seconds in a single pass, and is designed for continuous storytelling rather than isolated shots. That means more room to preserve identity, emotional progression and spatial continuity.

But more capability also means more decisions. A vague prompt can still produce a beautiful clip with the wrong character, the wrong action order, or a broken transition. That’s why I created the Seedance 2.5 Prompter: it turns a scene idea into the right Seedance workflow—mapping every reference, defining what must stay consistent, structuring the action, and writing the camera and audio direction clearly.

The Seedance 2.5 PROMPTER turns your scripts and ideas into flawless, copy-ready video prompts — built on the official guide, not outdated templates.

Less guessing. Fewer wasted generations. More intentional storytelling. 🎬

Midjoruney: anime girl --ar 2:3 --profile geutxpd x2o8dm8

GPT Image 2 Character Sheet Prompt:

Create a 2:1 premium cinematic CHARACTER IDENTITY BOARD using Image A as the sole character and style reference.

Name: Kira - Cyberpunk outfit.

Match Image A exactly: same identity, proportions, hairstyle, outfit, colors, visual medium, linework, shading and texture. Do not redesign or reinterpret. Correct obvious anatomy or generation errors like hands without changing the intended design. without sword and yellow dots.

REFERENCE LOOK LOCK
First analyze Image A and establish a strict visual identity lock from all observable character traits, proportions, design details and stylistic rules. Apply this locked identity consistently across every angle, pose and expression. Nothing may drift, relocate, disappear, duplicate or be invented; only perspective-dependent visibility may change.

COMPOSITION
Use a clean minimal background color chosen to contrast clearly and elegantly with the character’s palette. Avoid grids, blueprints and standard turnaround-sheet design. Never overlap or crop the studies.

RIGHT 25% — HERO PORTRAIT
The rightmost 25% must be a full-height, edge-to-edge close-up portrait completely filling that area with no margins or empty space. Match Image A’s identity, art style, lighting, colors and background treatment exactly. Keep the face and defining head silhouette clearly readable. Place no text or other studies over it.

LEFT 10% — NAME AND EXPRESSIONS
Reserve the leftmost 10% for the character name and exactly four expression portraits.

Place the provided character name at the top of this section as a single, clean editorial title. Place the four clearly separated expression portraits vertically beneath it.

Give each portrait a strong, distinctly different emotion and head direction: front-facing, left three-quarter, right three-quarter and side profile. The gaze should naturally follow each head angle. Do not repeat the same angle or expression. Preserve the exact same facial identity, proportions, features and art style in all four portraits.

CENTER 65% — BODY STUDIES
Use the central 65% for:

- one large off-center hero full-body pose, facing directly toward the viewer with the head straight, eyes clearly visible and the face sharp, unobstructed and easy to recognize
- back full-body view in a different pose
- side full-body view in a different pose
- one top-down body angle
- one low-angle body angle

Keep all views fully visible, clearly separated and consistent with the locked reference identity.

No text except the character name. No arrows, labels, handwritten notes, annotation marks, silhouettes, detail studies, seated poses, leaning poses, crouching poses, environments, extra characters, alternate costumes, logos, watermarks, style drift, malformed anatomy, inconsistent features, duplicated details, obscured faces or overlapping figures.

---

Midjourney v8.2 prompt for environment:

masterpiece, best quality, expansive cyberpunk landscape, a sea of glowing clouds stretching to the horizon, multiple floating islands connected by luminous energy bridges, futuristic celestial temples and pagodas with holographic details, hanging gardens with neon accents, floating torii gates near illuminated cliffs, waterfalls of light pouring into the clouds below, ethereal morning sky, intricate architecture, no humans, no characters --chaos 20 --ar 16:9 --raw --profile 1g1jpvq tneq7a5 --stylize 250

Seedance 2.5 Prompt:

[Source Roles]
@[character ref] defines the Fighter’s complete appearance; ignore its background. Preserve all identity and accessory details.
@[environment ref] defines the architecture, lighting, color, and atmosphere; ignore people and panoramic composition. Reframe it as one connected rooftop temple district.

[Goal and Treatment]
Create a 30-second battle within this district. The Fighter faces one black-metal Cyber-Oni Sentinel with a horned mask, built-in claws, and plasma vents; it actively attacks and counters. High-end painterly anime realism, aggressive sakuga motion, ancient shrine magic rebuilt as cybernetic technology.
Her red-orange magic fires from her hands as bolts, blasts, spinning discs, shock pulses, and luminous rings. Cast only with open palms, broad arm circles, wrist turns, and forceful two-hand projections. No hand seals, finger signs, mudras, ninjutsu gestures, martial-arts spell poses, filaments, or thread-like effects. Each effect has a visible hand origin, path, impact, and quick decay.
[Sequence]
0–4s — Low 24mm tracking races beside her as the Sentinel’s claw shatters a suspended platform. She folds beneath the sweep, pivots through flying tiles, opens one palm, and fires a bolt into its shoulder, forcing it backward as she crosses the gap. End with rings glowing around both palms.

4–9s — Brief 85mm inserts of her eyes and open hands cut into a fast orbit. The Sentinel fires plasma; she sweeps one arm in a circle and a ring expands from her palm, deflecting the blast into a nearby support and exposing its steel core. It shields against fragments, then charges. Keep this cracked support visible.
9–15s — Cut on its charge to a low 24mm push moving with her into the attack. She plants, drives forward, and unleashes a rapid alternating barrage from both open palms; compact bolts pass through spinning wrist rings and hammer its chest, left shoulder, and mask. The Sentinel raises its forearms and advances under fire, but repeated hits split its chest armor, blast away the left shoulder plate, and force one knee into the roof. She steps closer with every volley and finishes with a two-palm ring blast that hurls it onto the torii platform aligned with the cracked support. End with its chest broken and left arm sparking as it forces itself upright.

15–21s — Cut on its counterattack to an overhead dive. Using its intact right claw, the Sentinel hurls a roof slab at her. She thrusts both palms forward; a broad spell ring pulverizes the slab and hits the Sentinel behind it, throwing both fighters and debris across the gap. End with both airborne as it twists to attack again.

21–26.5s — The camera drops beside them without exposing the skyline. She fires bolts through staggered rings that accelerate each shot. The Sentinel bats two aside with its intact claw, shields with debris, then lunges through the barrage. She opens a larger ring across its vector, bending it through the torii corridor and onto the damaged platform. Both land and slide apart. End with it rising beside the cracked support and charging.
26.5–30s — Stay at rooftop level. The Sentinel drives its intact claw at her. A low lateral track follows her slipping outside the strike and planting her feet; she sweeps both arms outward, forms three concentric rings around her wrists and palms, then drives both hands forward. The rings fire one focused blast that carries it through the neon torii frame and into the cracked support. Its steel core buckles around the Sentinel as a compact shock ring blasts dust, sparks, tiles, and fading glyphs past the lens. Hold through recoil. End in a tight low two-shot: she stands foreground with lowered glowing palms; the damaged Sentinel strains while pinned behind her. No city reveal.

[Camera, Motion, Audio, Continuity]
Use compressed anticipation, explosive travel, readable contact, one micro hit-stop, recoil, overshoot, and immediate re-entry. Couple camera movement to each attack; cut on contact, vector change, counter-initiative, or causal handoff. Preserve screen direction and local geography. Use 24–35mm for action and 85mm only for inserts; strong foreshortening, parallax, foreground streaks, and controlled impact smears, never random shake. Use close-ups, medium shots, and local wides; never pull back to a city panorama. Hair, jewelry, debris, and magic follow body impulse; hair never hides her face.

No BGM or score. Use local ambience, breath, footfalls, servos, ring resonance, magic blasts, impacts, debris, and the final shockwave.

Keep exactly one Fighter and one Sentinel. Preserve her referenced appearance, accessories, anatomy, and hands. Preserve the district, action axis, cracked support, broken chest armor, missing left shoulder plate, and sparking left arm through the ending. Keep ring design consistent. No duplicates, costume changes, added weapons, transformations, or location resets.

Prompt
Highly cinematic 30-second wide-shot commercial video of a young nerdy parkour athlete with short messy black hair, thin rectangular eyeglasses, and slim athletic build, wearing an oversized black hoodie and cargo pants. He performs intense parkour on a massive brutalist concrete building complex under a dramatic overcast sky.

0-3s: Epic wide establishing drone shot from high above, slowly descending. Character sprints from the left side of the frame across a wide concrete rooftop, glasses reflecting the sky.

3-6s: Smooth side-tracking shot at medium height following him as he vaults over a thick geometric concrete barrier with a clean kong vault.

6-10s: Dynamic low-angle tracking shot looking upward as he wall-runs up a tall vertical brutalist wall, then pushes off into a precision jump onto a narrow ledge. Dust kicks up dramatically.

10-14s: Sweeping orbit camera circling around him while he runs along the edge, does a quick tic-tac off a concrete pillar, then launches into a big gap jump with a mid-air twist.

prompts.prompt:
时长：30秒
画幅：16:9
语言：自然美式英语
声音：演员现场原声，精准口型同步；无旁白、无字幕、无背景音乐
影像：高端欧美现实主义爱情电影质感，克制、冷峻、浅景深，真实皮肤纹理，摄影机运动极轻微
人物均为原创虚构角色，不参考任何演员、名人或影视作品。
【人物设定】
男方 NOAH：28岁，英俊、身材挺拔，深棕色短发，白衬衫袖口卷起。他怀疑女友爱上了一个更富有的男人。表面愤怒，实际害怕自己不值得被爱。
女方 CLAIRE：26岁，漂亮、气质冷静，金棕色长发，黑色简约连衣裙。她确实曾被另一个男人吸引，但真正动摇她的不是金钱，而是长期被男友忽视。
全程保持两人脸部、发型、服装、声线和空间位置一致。
【核心情绪曲线】
怀疑压制 → 讽刺防御 → 直接逼问 → 短暂坦白 → 男方受伤 → 女方说出关系早已结束的真相。
两个人不是从第一秒就大吼。真正的情绪峰值出现在女方说出：
“No. But I wanted to.”
最终一刀则是：
“We just kept calling it love.”
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【镜头一｜0.0—7.0秒】
双人中近景。NOAH站在前景，CLAIRE站在几步之外。摄影机缓慢向两人靠近。
0.0—2.4秒
NOAH的目的：逼她主动承认。
他先盯着她沉默半秒，嘴唇压紧，下颌轻微咬住。眉毛向内下压，眼睑收紧，但音量保持克制，不要立刻咆哮。
他缓慢说道：
“Tell me the truth. Is it him?”
“truth”略微加重；说到“him”时才抬起眼睛直视她。
说完后保持静止，不提前流泪，不移开视线。
2.4—4.4秒
CLAIRE的目的：用讽刺挡住羞耻。
她没有立即回答。鼻腔短促呼气，嘴角出现不足一秒的苦涩微笑，目光扫过他的衬衫，然后重新看回他的眼睛。
她轻声反问：
“You mean the man with the car?”
“car”没有炫耀意味，而是故意刺中他的自卑。
说完后笑意立刻消失。身体没有后退。
4.4—7.0秒
NOAH被刺中，眉间压力增强，向前走半步，但不触碰她。
声音第一次抬高：
“Don’t make this a joke. I saw you leave with him.”
“saw”短促加重；最后的“him”压低声音，像在努力控制失态。
CLAIRE听他说话时不翻白眼、不抢话。她的眼神短暂变软，随后重新封闭。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【镜头二｜7.0—20.0秒】
切到CLAIRE肩后拍NOAH，再缓慢转为两人的交替近景。
7.0—9.3秒
CLAIRE的目的：让他明白“离开”和“背叛”不是同一件事。
她停顿半秒，平静说道：
“And I came home.”
语速慢，音量低。“home”说得很轻，像提醒他自己曾经选择回来。
她说完后等待他的反应，不继续解释。
9.3—12.0秒
NOAH的愤怒开始失去保护作用。
他的嘴唇张开，却有半秒没有声音。目光从她的眼睛移到嘴唇，又迅速回到眼睛。胸口出现一次明显但受控的吸气。
他问：
“Did you kiss him?”
不要吼叫。声音比前面更轻、更不稳定，像他真正害怕听见答案。
12.0—16.0秒
CLAIRE先保持眼神接触一秒。
她回答第一个词：
“No.”
停顿约0.8秒。她的目光第一次落下，嘴角轻微绷紧；再次抬眼时，攻击性完全消失。
随后坦白：
“But I wanted to.”
“wanted”说得很轻，不能喊。声音尾部出现轻微气息断裂，但不哭。
这是全片最重要的转折。NOAH听到“wanted”后才出现反应：眼睑轻微抬起，下颌松开，身体像失去支撑一样后移半步。反应不能提前。
16.0—20.0秒
NOAH试图用金钱解释这一切，重新保护自尊。
他短促吸气，眉毛向内收紧，声音突然抬高一次：
“Because he can give you everything?”
“everything”达到男方全片最高音量，随后立即降下来。
说完后他闭紧嘴唇，眼神已经不再愤怒，而是在等待一次能够拯救自己的否认。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【镜头三｜20.0—30.0秒】
CLAIRE面部特写，随后轻微转焦到她身后的NOAH。摄影机保持克制，不环绕、不快速推进。
20.0—23.2秒
CLAIRE终于说出真正原因。
她的眉毛内侧轻微抬起，眼眶开始湿润，但眼泪不能落下。下巴轻微绷紧，呼吸变浅。
她直视他说：
“Because he listened when I spoke.”
“listened”轻微加重；“spoke”几乎成为耳语。
这句话不是报复，而是她已经疲惫到不想再争辩。
23.2—25.0秒
NOAH所有攻击性消失。
肩膀下降，目光短暂离开她。他想说更多，却只能低声问：
“So that’s it?”
“it”尾音轻微发虚。不要哭，不要做夸张痛苦表情。
25.0—30.0秒
CLAIRE轻轻摇头一次。
她先说：
“No.”
停顿0.6秒，像是在决定是否还要给这段关系留下体面。
随后平静说道：
“It ended months ago. We just kept calling it love.”
“ended”保持冷静；说到“love”时声音第一次轻微破裂。
最后一个词结束后，她仍然直视他约1秒。眼泪停留在下眼睑，不落下来。随后她缓慢移开目光。
NOAH站在失焦背景中，没有追上去，也没有说话。
结尾保持两人之间的静止和距离至少1秒，不恢复中性表情，不增加额外对白。
【表演限制】
- 不要从第一秒开始吼叫或哭泣。
- CLAIRE在20秒前眼眶不能明显湿润，全程不连续流泪。
- NOAH的核心不是暴怒，而是用愤怒掩盖自卑和恐惧。
- CLAIRE不是冷酷反派，她是在承认一段关系早已被忽视耗尽。
- 所有停顿都有心理行动，避免机械停顿。
- 手势克制，不摔东西、不推搡、不发生身体冲突。
- 保留准确英文对白、角色分配、自然呼吸和精准口型。
NEGATIVE:
subtitles, captions, logos, watermarks, background music, theatrical overacting,
constant shouting, premature tears, instant emotional switch, random gestures,
physical violence, frozen listener, robotic delivery, lip-sync drift, double mouth,
warped face, extra fingers, identity drift, wardrobe drift, abrupt camera movement

CAMERA: Handheld DV 16mm **vertical 9:16** daily vlog footage optimized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. The video MUST begin with her holding the camera at arm's length in selfie mode, speaking directly to the lens while casually walking through the gym. The framing stays vertical throughout, with natural selfie composition, occasional head cropping, imperfect framing, and realistic phone-like movement. The first 20–30 seconds are entirely handheld. Only later does she occasionally place the camera on a dumbbell rack, adjustable bench, stretching mat, gym bag, or water bottle for wider vertical shots. Keep subtle handheld shake, drifting composition, autofocus hunting, rushed reframing, uneven zooms, exposure breathing, brief accidental face cropping, and imperfect framing throughout. The camera itself is never visible.

LOOK: Warm analog tape texture with gentle film grain, slightly softened sharpness, subtle halation around overhead lights, realistic skin tones, low contrast, tiny exposure shifts, and natural motion blur. The footage should feel authentic and completely unstaged, like a real creator documenting her workout on her phone.

STYLE: An intimate daily fitness vlog filmed in a mostly empty boutique gym. Casual, relaxed, and conversational. Small laughs, pauses, fixing her ponytail, wiping sweat with her towel, catching her breath, looking away while thinking, and talking naturally to the audience instead of delivering lines. She speaks in short, natural sentences with frequent pauses. Never rush dialogue. Leave quiet moments between lines.

CHARACTER: A beautiful white blonde fitness creator in her early 20s. Long blonde hair tied into a loose ponytail, blue eyes, glowing skin, and a slim athletic figure. She wears a fitted black long-sleeve workout top, high-waisted black leggings, white socks, white sneakers, and a white towel loosely resting around her neck.

SETTING: A modern boutique gym late in the evening. Dumbbell racks, kettlebells, medicine balls, mirrors, benches, stretching mats, resistance bands, a gym bag, shaker bottle, and warm overhead lighting. The gym is almost empty with only one or two people blurred in the distant background.

SCENES:

The vlog opens in selfie mode. She is holding the camera at arm's length while slowly walking through the dumbbell area, smiling naturally.
"...okay."
"I definitely earned dinner."
She laughs quietly and adjusts the towel around her neck.
"I almost skipped today."
She briefly turns the camera toward the nearly empty gym before pointing it back at herself.
"Glad I came."
Still holding the camera, she walks toward the stretching area.
"My legs are done."
She places the camera on a nearby bench for a wider vertical angle and sits down on a stretching mat.
She stretches one leg and takes a deep breath.
"I really need to stretch more."
She smiles to herself.
She switches sides and rolls one shoulder.
"Tomorrow's gonna hurt."
She picks the camera back up and walks toward her gym bag.
She kneels beside it, pulls out a protein shake, and takes a sip.
"...that's actually good."
She laughs.
The camera sits on top of the gym bag while she packs away her towel, headphones, and lifting straps.
"Worth it."
She throws the bag over one shoulder and picks the camera back up.
Walking toward the exit in selfie mode, she smiles into the lens.
"See you next workout."
She gives the camera a small wave before ending the recording.

prompts.prompt:
you can make this with one prompt using seedance 2.5:

POV handheld video, continuous first-person shot worn on the chest of a Korean high school girl, seventeen, walking to school on an ordinary weekday morning. Soft overcast morning light, no harsh shadows, the kind of flat even daylight typical of a school-day sky. Her hands enter frame naturally throughout, as a body-mounted camera would catch them; her face is never seen except as a faint reflection in glass or a shop window.

0:00-0:03 — POV walking down a residential street toward school, navy uniform, backpack strap in one hand, other students in the same uniform walking the same direction, morning traffic passing.

0:03-0:06 — POV passes through the school gate among a stream of students, greeting a passing classmate with a small wave: {classmate, Korean: "안녕!"} She waves back without breaking stride.

0:06-0:09 — POV walks down a crowded hallway, lockers on both sides, chatter and footsteps overlapping, students weaving toward classrooms.

0:09-0:12 — POV enters the classroom. Two friends at a shared desk cluster wave her over: {friend, Korean: "야, 여기!"} She crosses the room and drops into the seat beside them.

0:12-0:15 — She sets her bag down, exchanges a quick high-five, light morning classroom chatter all around, chairs scraping, bags unzipping.

0:15-0:18 — Near the front of the room, two boys' voices rise over the chatter. One jabs a finger toward the other's chest: {boy A, Korean: "야, 방금 뭐라고 했어?"} The room's noise dips as heads turn.

0:18-0:21 — The second boy stands up fast, chair scraping loud, jabbing his own finger back: {boy B, Korean: "다시 말해봐, 인마!"} Students nearby lean back, a couple pull out phones.

0:21-0:24 — Boy A shoves boy B's shoulder with an open hand. Boy B stumbles, grabs a fistful of Boy A's collar. A short scuffle — one wild swing that mostly misses, desks scraping as students scramble back.

0:24-0:27 — A teacher's voice cuts through from the doorway: {teacher, Korean, sharp: "야! 그만해!"} Two boys nearby grab the fighters by the arms and pull them apart. The room goes half-silent, frozen mid-reaction.

0:27-0:30 — POV turns toward her friend beside her, both wide-eyed. Her friend mouths, stunned: {friend, Korean, quiet: "미쳤나 봐..."} Normal classroom noise creeps back in as the two boys are walked to opposite corners. POV holds on the settling room, non-empty closing frame.

Scene: Korean public high school, an ordinary weekday morning, overcast even daylight. Residential street outside with low buildings and morning foot traffic. School gate and hallway lined with grey lockers, notice boards, scuffed tile floor. Classroom: rows of paired desks, a whiteboard at the front, backpacks hanging off chairs, windows along one wall letting in flat grey-white daylight. No dramatic lighting anywhere — deliberately ordinary school light, so the one disruptive moment stands out against it.

Style: shot like real action-camera footage, not a cinema rig — the realism of a chest-mounted POV camera, the honesty of school-day vlog footage. Ultra-realistic, unstaged: constant micro-shake synced to footsteps and head turns, natural motion blur when she turns quickly toward the commotion, believable overlapping crowd noise and movement. Pore-level realism on every visible face and hand — uneven skin tones, real posture, teenage body language. The fight beat is brief and clumsy, not choreographed — a shove, a stumble, one missed swing, quickly broken up, never gratuitous or drawn out.

Camera: continuous first-person POV for all thirty seconds, chest-height mount, no cuts to any external angle. Wide field of view, roughly 84 degrees, mild edge softness and barrel character of a real action camera — an honest wide lens, not a fisheye. Steady walking sway for the first half, sharper head-turns and slight camera-shake during the confrontation as she reacts along with the room. Hands enter frame from below or the sides when performing an action, never floating in from nowhere.

Sound: all spoken dialogue in Korean, no English audio anywhere, no music, ambient sound only. <morning street traffic, distant scooter, footsteps on pavement> <school gate chatter, overlapping voices, backpack zippers> {classmate, Korean: "안녕!"} <hallway noise, lockers clanging, overlapping footsteps> {friend, Korean: "야, 여기!"} <chair scraping, bag unzipping, classroom morning murmur> {boy A, Korean: "야, 방금 뭐라고 했어?"} <room noise dipping, chairs creaking as heads turn> {boy B, Korean: "다시 말해봐, 인마!"} <chair scraping loudly, fabric grabbing, scuffle of shoes on tile, gasps> {teacher, Korean, sharp: "야! 그만해!"} <bodies pulled apart, room half-silent> {friend, Korean, quiet: "미쳤나 봐..."} <classroom noise returning, chairs settling, distant hallway bell>.

prompts.prompt:
A strong and disciplined young woman stands inside an ancient Chinese martial arts academy nestled high in the misty mountains. The grand wooden training hall is built in authentic ancient Chinese style, featuring towering red pillars, intricately carved dragon beams, elegant silk banners with traditional calligraphy, bronze incense burners, antique weapon racks, polished wooden floors, and rows of glowing lanterns. At the far end of the hall stands a magnificent stone statue of the legendary Grandmaster who founded the martial arts school. The statue radiates wisdom, discipline, and unwavering strength.

The woman has an athletic yet graceful physique and wears a traditional black and deep-red Chinese martial arts uniform with a flowing sash, cloth wrist wraps, leather boots, and long black hair tied neatly behind her. Her expression is calm, focused, and filled with respect.

She slowly walks toward the Grandmaster's statue, stops several steps before it, places her right fist into her left open palm in the traditional Bao Quan Li martial arts salute, lowers her head respectfully, and bows toward the statue. She silently pays tribute to the master before turning with controlled, deliberate movements and walking to the center of the training hall.

She takes a deep breath, settles into a perfectly balanced horse stance, and begins demonstrating a master-level traditional martial arts form.

Every movement is executed with absolute precision, perfect timing, and complete body control. She transitions seamlessly through deep horse stances, bow stances, cat stances, and low drop stances before exploding into lightning-fast chain punches, powerful palm strikes, spear-hand thrusts, tiger claw techniques, elbow strikes, knee strikes, spinning back kicks, tornado kicks, butterfly kicks, sweeping leg attacks, jumping crescent kicks, and perfectly controlled aerial rotations.

She performs rapid combinations without hesitation, flowing effortlessly from attack to defense. Her breathing remains calm and synchronized with every movement. Each strike stops with pinpoint accuracy, demonstrating exceptional control rather than unnecessary force. Her footwork is fluid, her balance never falters, and every technique reflects decades of disciplined training.

The camera captures the performance with sweeping cinematic movements—slow circular tracking shots, dramatic low-angle angles emphasizing powerful stances, overhead shots showcasing intricate footwork, close-ups of her focused eyes and controlled breathing, and wide shots revealing the majestic scale of the academy. Her uniform, sash, and hair move naturally with every technique while fine dust rises gently from the polished wooden floor beneath her feet.

As the demonstration reaches its climax, she performs an extraordinary sequence of master-level techniques: a rapid series of spinning strikes, an aerial butterfly twist, a perfectly controlled tornado kick, a seamless landing into a deep horse stance, followed immediately by explosive palm strikes, tiger claw combinations, and a final powerful straight punch that stops precisely at full extension.

She slowly exhales and returns to a composed ready stance.

Without turning her back on the Grandmaster, she carefully steps backward several paces while continuing to face the statue. She once again performs the traditional Bao Quan Li salute, lowers her head respectfully, and bows deeply toward the Grandmaster's statue, honoring the legacy and teachings before standing silently in complete discipline.

The camera slowly pulls back, revealing the majestic academy, the towering statue of the Grandmaster, and the lone martial artist standing respectfully before the master whose teachings continue to live through her.

Style

A black off-road SUV speeds through a rugged mountain valley during a heavy rainstorm. The narrow muddy road runs alongside a fast-flowing river, surrounded by towering cliffs, wet rocks, and dense pine forests. Rain pours relentlessly as puddles splash beneath the tires. The driver appears anxious and is driving much faster than the dangerous road allows.

The camera follows the SUV from multiple cinematic angles—low tracking shots beside the wheels, aerial drone views of the winding valley, and interior shots showing the driver's tense expression gripping the steering wheel.

As the SUV races around a sharp bend, its front right tire violently strikes a large hidden rock protruding from the muddy road. The impact throws the vehicle off balance. The suspension compresses, the SUV bounces into the air, skids sideways uncontrollably, and rolls multiple times down the steep embankment toward the river.

The vehicle crashes into the river with an enormous splash, sending water high into the air. It quickly begins sinking beneath the turbulent water as bubbles rush upward. Inside, water rapidly floods the cabin. The driver struggles to stay calm, removes the seatbelt, and repeatedly kicks the driver's side window until the tempered glass shatters outward.

The driver squeezes through the broken window, escaping just before the SUV disappears beneath the surface. Holding their breath, they swim desperately through the cold rushing water toward the riverbank, fighting against the strong current. Finally, exhausted but alive, they pull themselves onto the muddy shore while the submerged SUV disappears into the depths behind them.

Style

Create an exactly 15-second photorealistic shopping vlog in 16:9: extremely sharp 4K compact-camera detail, natural HDR, accurate skin, realistic motion and perfect identity continuity. No VHS, grain, subtitles, logos, watermarks or graphics.

SUBJECT: A 21-year-old American woman with long wavy chestnut hair, light everyday makeup and an expressive, approachable face. Fitted black long-sleeve top, light-blue straight jeans, sneakers and a small black shoulder bag. Keep her face, hair, outfit, bag and jewellery identical through every cut. She talks like a normal friend, never a presenter.

STORE: A large modern high-street womenswear shop resembling an upscale European fast-fashion retailer without real branding. Cream walls, black fixtures, mirrors, warm-neutral spotlights, polished floor, fitting rooms, folded denim and dense racks of blazers, tops, dresses, knitwear and trousers. Adult shoppers browse independently. No readable brands, signs, price tags or labels.

CAMERA: The same compact camera stays in her hand throughout. Every frame is one-handed arm’s-length selfie, her mirror reflection holding it, or her rotating it outward to show clothes. Never place it down, prop it up, pass it to anyone or use an external angle. Sharp 20–24mm-equivalent wide lens, mild barrel distortion, deep focus, reliable eye autofocus and true 24fps with 1/48-second blur. Stabilization controls impacts but retains footstep bob, wrist sway, breathing, grip shifts, late pans and imperfect reframing. Preserve pores, flyaways, teeth, fabric and accurate reflections without beauty filtering or fake bokeh. Exposure stays face-priority but shifts subtly between mirrored aisles and the fitting-room corridor. Fast wrist turns show slight rolling-shutter skew and natural background blur while her face and garments remain sharply resolved.

EDITING IS CRITICAL: Use 12 clips and 11 hard jump cuts. Most cuts remain in the same aisle or beside the same rack, with only a small jump in pose, expression, camera distance, garment position or sentence. Remove mundane pauses and bits of walking. Cut mid-gesture, during camera turns and inside sentences for the fast rhythm of an edited social vlog. Geography and identity stay coherent despite time compression. No fades, transitions, whip effects or cinematic montage. Cuts are not beat-synced; some happen for no narrative reason and simply skip a fraction of an ordinary action.

CLIP 1 — 0.0–1.2:

Walking into the store in loose selfie framing:

“Okay, I’m literally just getting—”

CLIP 2 — 1.2–2.3:

Jump cut a few steps inside, nearly the same angle but her hair and bag have shifted:

“—one top. That’s it.”

CLIP 3 — 2.3–3.4:

She rotates the camera toward a crowded rack and slides hangers with her free hand. Hangers clack; no dialogue.

CLIP 4 — 3.4–4.6:

Jump cut beside the same rack. In selfie view she holds a dark-red top against herself:

“Wait, this is cute.”

CLIP 5 — 4.6–5.5:

Cut to a nearby mirror, camera visible in her hand. She checks the top. Her female friend, mostly off-camera, says, “No.” She turns: “Really?”

CLIP 6 — 5.5–6.4:

Close selfie micro-cut in the same spot. She laughs:

“Okay, rude.”

CLIP 7 — 6.4–7.6:

She rotates toward a blazer rail and pulls out a charcoal jacket. Focus briefly transfers from mirror to fabric.

CLIP 8 — 7.6–8.8:

Jump cut in the same aisle. The top and jacket now rest over her free arm. Looking down:

“Why do I already have four things?”

CLIP 9 — 8.8–9.8:

Near-identical angle after another micro-cut. Friend: “Because you picked them up.” She smiles: “Fair.”

CLIP 10 — 9.8–11.2:

Cut to her walking past another rack. She pans across dresses, passes the item she wants, then corrects back. No dialogue.

CLIP 11 — 11.2–13.2:

Mirror near the fitting rooms. Holding the jacket against herself:

“Do I need this?”

Friend: “No.” She smiles, ignoring the answer.

CLIP 12 — 13.2–15.0:

Close walking selfie approaching the fitting rooms, garments over her free arm:

“Okay, I’m trying it on.”

CAMERA: Handheld DV 16mm daily vlog footage. The video MUST begin with her holding the camera at arm's length in selfie mode while stepping outside her apartment building with her dog. The first 20–30 seconds are entirely handheld. Later she occasionally places the camera on a park bench, low stone wall, picnic table, or the ground for wider shots. Keep subtle handheld shake, drifting composition, autofocus hunting, rushed reframing, uneven zooms, exposure breathing, brief accidental face cropping, and imperfect framing throughout. The camera itself is never visible.

LOOK: Warm analog tape texture with gentle film grain, slightly softened sharpness, subtle halation around sunlight, realistic skin tones, low contrast, tiny exposure shifts, and natural motion blur. It should feel like authentic footage from someone's everyday life rather than a polished commercial.

STYLE: A relaxed morning lifestyle vlog. Quiet, cozy, and spontaneous. She occasionally laughs at her dog, pauses to look around, adjusts the leash, brushes hair away from her face, and speaks naturally in short sentences with comfortable pauses.

CHARACTER: EMMA — a beautiful white woman in her mid-20s. Long light brown hair in a messy ponytail, green eyes, minimal makeup, oversized gray hoodie, black biker shorts, white sneakers, and a small crossbody bag. She is walking a happy golden retriever.

SETTING: A peaceful suburban neighborhood on a sunny morning. Tree-lined sidewalks, quiet residential streets, birds singing, a small park with benches, green grass, and soft golden morning light. Very few people are around.

SCENES:

The vlog opens in selfie mode. Emma holds the camera while leaving her apartment building with the golden retriever excitedly pulling on the leash.
"Good morning."
She smiles.
"Someone couldn't wait."
The dog eagerly sniffs everything as they walk down the sidewalk.
She laughs quietly.
"He has to inspect every single tree."
Still holding the camera, she walks into a small neighborhood park.
The dog suddenly stops and stares at a squirrel.
"Oh... there we go."
She smiles and gently shakes her head.
She places the camera on a nearby bench for a wider angle while throwing a tennis ball.
The dog happily chases after it.
"Worth waking up early."
She picks the camera back up.
Walking slowly through the park, she looks up at the trees for a moment.
"It's actually really peaceful out here."
The dog returns with the ball but drops it halfway.
She laughs.
"Close enough."
She sits on the bench while the dog lies beside her.
She scratches behind his ears.
"I think he's happier than I am."
She stands up and continues walking.
The camera stays in selfie mode as they head toward home.
"Coffee is definitely next."
She smiles into the lens.
"See you later."
She gives a small wave and ends the recording.
