prompts.prompt:
Hyper-detailed cinematic 30-second luxury car commercial. Clean modern white minimalist garage: seamless white walls, polished light-gray concrete floor with soft reflections, large grid of bright square LED ceiling panels giving even high-key studio lighting and clean specular highlights. Pure controlled environment, commercial-grade polish.

Character lock: A young handsome man in @/image1, mid-20s, dark messy hair, well groomed beard wearing stylish sunglasses, calm confident expression that softens into quiet pride. Crisp off-white short-sleeve button-up shirt (collar slightly open), beige chinos, black-and-white Nike Dunk-style sneakers, black smartwatch on left wrist. Natural skin and fabric texture.

Car lock: Exact Rosso Corsa red Ferrari Portofino convertible. Glossy mirror paint, black soft-top, dual central chrome exhausts, yellow calipers, multi-spoke alloys, prancing-horse badges, black grille, red mirrors. Dubai plate “DUBAI EE 67554”. Large elegant purple satin gift bow with long ribbons centered on the hood (appears after initial reveal). Perfect ceiling-grid reflections on every panel.

Shot-by-shot timeline:

0.0–2.5s  
Wide slightly low-angle establishing. The red Ferrari sits fully under a black car wrap/cover on the left side of the empty white garage. Man enters from the right, back to camera, walks slowly and confidently toward the car. As he approaches, the black wrap begins to slide and peel off the car in a slow, elegant motion, gradually revealing the glossy red body underneath. Soft footsteps. Camera dollies forward and tracks left with him. Ceiling lights create geometric floor reflections.

2.5–5.0s  
Medium tracking. He reaches driver’s side, turns, looks at the car with a subtle almost-smile, places right hand gently on roof/A-pillar and slides it along the body. Low-angle close-up of face and hand on glossy red paint. Soft overhead key + gentle rim light.

5.0–7.5s  
Medium-wide. Purple satin bow now perfectly on hood. Man walks around the front from right to left, hands in pockets, stops at driver’s door and opens it smoothly. Camera slowly orbits front three-quarter as door opens.

7.5–12.5s  
Intimate interior sequence.  
Low angle from passenger side as he steps in. Settles into red leather driver’s seat, grips red Ferrari steering wheel with both hands, adjusts slightly, looks down then forward with quiet intensity. Realistic body weight shift. Red interior, black soft-top above, ceiling grid visible through windshield. Camera stays inside, gentle push-in toward face and hands.

12.5–15.5s  
Dramatic low front close-up of aggressive fascia, headlights and purple bow. Slow subtle push-in. Perfect light reflections on paint.

15.5–17.5s  
Low rear three-quarter tracking of dual exhausts and circular taillights. Camera slowly rises and orbits left, revealing more side profile.

17.5–20.5s  
Elevated wide shot. Man outside again, leaning forward carefully wiping front hood badge with his finger. Stands, walks around front toward passenger side, hands in pockets, calm and proud. Smooth cinematic orbit following him.

20.5–23.0s  
Medium of him beside open driver’s door looking at the car, then clean close-up of Ferrari prancing-horse badge on front fender with glossy red paint and ceiling reflections.

23.0–26.0s  
Wide side profile. Black soft-top retracts automatically — rear deck opens, roof folds and disappears into rear compartment. Man already seated inside looking toward camera. Camera slowly arcs around driver’s side as top fully opens.

26.0–28.0s  
Intimate medium close-up through open driver’s side. Man sits in red leather seat, one hand on wheel, looks directly at camera with composed, slightly proud expression. Soft light on face, red body framing him.

28.0–30.0s  
Final hero wide. Man stands casually leaning against driver’s side of fully open-top Ferrari, left hand in pocket, looking toward camera with quiet confidence. Purple bow still on hood. Perfect composition in bright white garage. Slow gentle push-in. Hold final beat.

Style & technical: Photorealistic cinematic commercial, 24fps filmic motion, shallow-to-medium DOF, ultra-clean high-end grade (rich reds, pure whites, soft neutrals). Perfect material response: mirror paint, soft satin bow, realistic leather and cotton. Smooth professional moves only (dollies, orbits, gentle push-ins). Exact character and car consistency every shot. Emotional tone: quiet luxury, personal achievement, understated joy of a dream gift.

Negative: blurry faces, deformed hands, extra people, text, watermarks, low quality, cartoon proportions, oversaturated colors, dark lighting, shaky cam.

prompts.prompt:
卓球・オリンピック決勝 × カンフー映画の高速バトル

【SUMMARY】
10 seconds, 16:9. The final point of an Olympic table tennis final, shot like a Hong Kong
kung fu duel. Two players, one ball, a dark arena, one column of light on the table.
Real time on every impact, deep slow motion between, one burst of pure hyper-speed.

【SET】
A packed arena, the crowd sunk into near-blackness — silhouettes and tiny out-of-focus
highlights. A hard column of white light falls onto a dark blue table with crisp white
lines. Fine dust drifts inside the beams. Extremely realistic physical texture: paddle
rubber, sweat-soaked fabric, the matte ball. High contrast, deep shadow, hard rim light
from above and behind, shallow depth of field around f/2.0.
A physical LED scoreboard hangs in the darkness behind the table, orange digits reading
10 - 10, sharp and correctly formed, never changing. It is the only lettering in the film.

【PLAYERS — two people, never more】
RED: a 24-year-old East Asian man, lean, heavy shoulders and forearms. Cropped black hair
soaked to his forehead. Sharp narrow eyes, high cheekbones, hard jaw. Cool-toned skin with
real pores, wet with sweat. Plain solid red sleeveless shirt, plain black shorts, no logo
or number. The aggressor.
BLUE: a 26-year-old East Asian man, taller and rangier. Longer black hair pushed back,
dripping. Thick brows, square jaw, steady unblinking stare. Warm-toned skin with real
pores. Plain solid blue sleeveless shirt, plain black shorts, no logo or number. The
counter-puncher.
Neither shows fear: two masters at the end of a long duel, calm and spent. The violence is
in the ball, not their faces.

【TIMELINE】

0.0-2.5s SERVE — deep slow motion.
RED tosses the ball straight up. It climbs through the light, turning slowly, dust around
it. He exhales, drops his shoulder, loads his arm. At 2.2s he strikes: real time snaps in
and the ball tears out of frame.
Camera: low angle just above the table surface, looking up past the net. Locked off.
Audio: near silence — his breath, shoes creaking, a low hush. Then one sharp crack.

2.5-4.3s HYPER-SPEED RALLY — no slow motion at all, the fastest passage in the film.
Fourteen exchanges in under two seconds, faster than any real rally. The ball stops
reading as an object and becomes a white streak cutting a line through the dust. Paddle
arms blur into afterimages, shoulders whip, feet smear. Sweat is thrown off both men in
sheets. The table shudders.
Camera: side-on at net height, one smooth horizontal slide along the table — the camera
stays calm while everything inside the frame is violent.
Audio: the cracks run together into a hard stutter like a drum roll, over squealing shoes
and a rising crowd.

4.3-5.5s THE BREATH — the speed drops out.
One exchange stretched into deep slow motion. RED drives the ball low across the net,
sweat lifting off his forearm and floating, dust turning around the ball. BLUE's eyes
track it. At 5.4s his paddle meets it and real time cracks back in.
Camera: the same side-on slide, now crawling.
Audio: everything falls to a muffled rumble and one long breath, then the crack.

5.5-8.0s THE ANSWER — the deepest slow motion in the film.
BLUE pushes off the floor and leaps sideways, body fully extended, back arched, paddle arm
cocked behind his head. He hangs there. Sweat droplets float around him. Dust turns in the
beam. His eyes lock on the ball. At 7.8s the paddle connects and real time slams back with
the loudest crack yet.
Camera: low angle, looking steeply up at him against the black arena roof. Locked off.
Audio: sound drops muffled and distant while he hangs, then the crack at full volume.

8.0-10.0s THE POINT — real time.
The ball skips off the far corner and away into the dark. RED is caught frozen mid-reach,
unable to follow it. BLUE lands hard, skids on one foot, and roars, head back, fists
clenched. Behind them the crowd erupts, thousands of silhouettes rising at once.
Camera: wide on the table and both men, pushing in 5% at most. Hold to the last frame.
Audio: the crowd explodes, his roar cutting through it, the ball still bouncing underneath.

【RECAP — all 10 seconds】
Dark arena, one hard column of light on the dark blue table, drifting dust, a near-black
crowd of silhouettes.
Only two people in frame. Their faces, hair and clothing stay identical in every shot,
every garment a single solid colour with no logo, number or pattern.
One camera movement per shot, never two. Hard clean cuts on impact. The ball stays inside
the frame at all times.
Real time on every impact, deep slow motion between, switching instantly, with one
sustained hyper-speed burst where the ball is a streak.
The scoreboard reads 10 - 10 and never changes, and it is the only lettering.
The sound is the ball, the shoes, the breathing and the crowd — keep the mix free of music
and commentary.

OPERATION: Officer responds first to a small roadside brush fire before firefighters arrive, secures the area, and assists with evacuation of nearby pedestrians.
RESPONDING OFFICER: Male, late 30s. Standard patrol uniform. Chest-mounted body camera. Calm under pressure. Clear verbal commands.
RECORDING WINDOW: 7:10 PM. Warm evening. Streetlights beginning to illuminate.
SCENE LOCATION: Roadside walking trail beside suburban homes. Dry grass. Small trees. Parked vehicles. Fire hydrant nearby.
BODYCAM CHARACTERISTICS: Ultra-wide chest-mounted bodycam. Faster walking and occasional short jog. Noticeable breathing. Frequent head turns scanning surroundings. Hands visible directing pedestrians. No cinematic framing.
INCIDENT FLOW (≈30 Seconds)
Arrival (0–5s)
Officer arrives to find a small patch of dry grass burning with light smoke drifting across the sidewalk.
Safety Response (5–12s)
Officer quickly guides pedestrians away from the smoke, blocks access using patrol vehicle lights, and radios fire department updates.
Activity (12–20s)
Officer checks nearby bushes for fire spread while a resident uses a garden hose to slow the flames from a safe distance.
Fire Department Arrival (20–27s)
Fire engine arrives. Firefighters immediately deploy a hose line and extinguish the remaining flames within seconds.
Departure (27–30s)
Officer confirms the area is secure, thanks nearby residents for staying clear, and returns to patrol duties.
SOUND PROFILE: Radio dispatch, crackling fire, footsteps, distant traffic, sirens approaching, firefighters communicating, hose spraying water.
AUTHENTICITY PROTOCOL: Realistic emergency response. No explosions. No exaggerated heroics. Continuous chest-mounted bodycam perspective with natural movement and authentic scene progression.

，身材和穿着严格参考
HO2iXF9a4AAZsco
。 她神态放松，右手拿着一个传统竹制发声玩具“竹知了”。竹知了由短竹筒、细绳和小竹片组成。她一边经过停车场，一边漫不经心地转动竹知了。 竹知了发出连续、滑稽而响亮的“呜哇、呜哇”鸣叫声。 她并不是超级英雄，没有盔甲，不发生身体变形，始终保持普通成年女性的真实外貌。 关键车辆 停车场中央只有一辆紫色智界R7发生变形。 prompts.prompt: Create one 30-second 9:16 photorealistic live-action dramatic scene with five deliberate shots and native synchronized dialogue. Original characters: LENA: a 38-year-old South Asian woman, tired expressive eyes, dark wavy hair in a loose low bun, charcoal coat over a cream blouse. MOTHER: a 72-year-old South Asian woman with delicate features, silver hair in a loose braid and a pale-blue knitted cardigan. She has early dementia but remains emotionally perceptive. Setting: a quiet memory-care bedroom on a winter morning. Soft gray daylight enters from frame left; a warm bedside lamp provides gentle fill. Two chairs face each other beside the window. Subtle radiator ticks and distant corridor room tone. No music. Shot 1 — 0–6 seconds: Stable medium two-shot, natural 50mm perspective. Mother studies Lena politely without recognition and says warmly, “You’re very kind, nurse.” Lena hides the pain behind a small reassuring smile and answers, “I’m not a nurse, Mum. It’s Lena.” Shot 2 — 6–13 seconds: Cut to Mother’s close-up. Her eyes brighten at the memory of a child, not the woman before her. She says, “My Lena is eleven. She hates peas and lies badly.” Lena answers softly from offscreen, “She still does.” Mother’s smile disappears. She asks, genuinely wounded, “Then why doesn’t she come?” Shot 3 — 13–20 seconds: Cut to Lena’s close-up. Hold the frame. Her practiced smile fails; her lower lip tightens and her eyes begin filling, but she does not sob. After one difficult breath she says, “I come every Sunday. You just… keep losing me.” Shot 4 — 20–25 seconds: Cut back to Mother. She becomes briefly lucid. Her eyes remain fixed on Lena; one tear gathers without falling. In a quiet, fragile voice she says, “I don’t forget you. I just can’t find the way back.” Shot 5 — 25–30 seconds: Tighter two-shot. Lena leans slightly closer without touching her. Crying silently now, she smiles and says, “Then I’ll keep coming to find you.” Mother searches Lena’s face. Recognition slowly arrives through the eyes rather than a large expression. She takes a tiny breath and whispers, “Lena?” Hold their eye contact in complete silence for the final half-second. Performance: restrained natural acting. Begin emotionally guarded and let the pain accumulate. Tears must develop gradually, never appear at the beginning. Use breath catches, small eye movements, tightening facial muscles and pauses. No theatrical sobbing, head bobbing, repeated nodding or generic hand gestures. Only the assigned speaker’s lips move. The listener keeps their mouth closed and reacts through breathing, blinking and gaze. Preserve both identities, wardrobe, positions, eyelines, lighting and tear progression across every cut. Clear dry dialogue with realistic room perspective. No narration, subtitles, text, music, extra people, beauty filtering or skin smoothing.

prompts.prompt:
Duration: 10s | 9:16 | 24fps

[SUMMARY]
Five beautiful women in five countries greet the viewer on the same morning.
Each looks into the camera at selfie distance, says good morning in her native
language, then covers the lens with her palm — and the next country appears as
it pulls away.

[GLOBAL SETTINGS]
Early morning everywhere, soft low natural sunlight, warm and fresh.
Photorealistic, candid. 35mm, shallow depth of field, selfie distance, natural
film grain. No studio polish, no beauty filter, no skin smoothing.
Camera: chest-up close-up, locked off, eye level, one setup per beat — the
only movement is the woman and her hand.
Each woman is genuinely beautiful in the way her own country reads as
beautiful, but real: keep true fine pores and real skin texture, light natural
makeup or none. Genuine unforced brightness, not a posed smile. Every face
completely different from the other four.

[TRANSITION]
MASK TRANSITION at every cut: the palm advances toward the lens, fills and
blackens the frame, then pulls away to reveal the next woman already in place.
Prohibit hard cuts. Prohibit objects appearing out of thin air. Keep the
camera's breathing and timing in harmony, leaving enough time for each switch.

[TIMESTAMP STORYBOARD]

0-2s | JAPAN
25-year-old Japanese woman, elegant classical beauty. Cool-toned fair skin,
translucent, true fine pores. Slender double-eyelid almond eyes, cool clear
gaze, small straight nose, delicate jawline. Glossy jet-black hair past the
shoulders, curled softly inward, wispy see-through fringe. Cream ribbed knit
top. Slim shoulders, quiet grace.
By a bright bedroom window in Tokyo, white curtains behind her.
Her reserved face opens into a bright smile: 「おはよう！」
Then her right hand rises and her palm covers the lens.

2-4s | UNITED STATES
25-year-old American woman, healthy open all-American beauty. Warm sun-kissed
skin with real freckles across nose and cheeks, true pores. Large round hazel
eyes creasing at the outer corners, high cheekbones, wide unguarded smile.
Voluminous honey-blonde beach waves gathered over one shoulder. Grey marl
sweatshirt slipping off one shoulder.
In a sunlit kitchen, a coffee mug on the counter behind her.
Brightly in English: "Good morning!"
Then her right hand rises and her palm covers the lens.

4-6s | BRAZIL
25-year-old Brazilian woman, radiant sunlit beauty. Warm deep-brown skin with
a natural sheen, true pores. Large dark almond eyes, long thick lashes, high
cheekbones, full lips, broad open-mouthed smile. Abundant voluminous curls,
dark brown with caramel and honey highlights, wide around her shoulders. Small
gold hoops. Marigold-yellow strappy top.
On a balcony, tropical plants and morning haze behind her.
Brightly in Brazilian Portuguese: "Bom dia!"
Then her right hand rises and her palm covers the lens.

6-8s | SPAIN
25-year-old Spanish woman, striking dark-eyed Mediterranean beauty. Olive
skin, warm and matte, true fine pores. Deep dark almond eyes under strong
brows, straight defined nose, sharp cheekbones, clean jawline, calm confident
half-smile that opens as she speaks. Long centre-parted deep-chestnut hair
with reddish warmth, thick and slightly wavy. Fine gold hoops. Crisp white
linen shirt, top button open. Upright poised posture.
In a whitewashed courtyard, terracotta pots and hard morning sun behind her.
Brightly in Spanish: "¡Buenos días!"
Then her right hand rises and her palm covers the lens.

8-10s | INDONESIA
25-year-old Indonesian woman, warm sweet-featured beauty. Golden-brown skin,
smooth and luminous, true fine pores. Large round dark eyes, gentle open gaze,
softly rounded cheeks, small nose, wide easy smile that reaches her eyes.
Glossy very dark brown hair in a sharp chin-length blunt bob. Small gold
pendant. Sky-blue collared blouse. Petite, friendly.
On a wooden terrace, broad tropical leaves and soft morning light behind her.
Brightly in Indonesian: "Selamat pagi!"
She holds her smile and the frame ends on her face — she does NOT cover the
lens. The film finishes here.

[GLOBAL CLOSING]
Throughout: same chest-up framing, same eye-level camera height, same fresh
morning light, same warm mood in all five countries. Every woman looks
straight into the lens the whole time.
Five different faces, five different skin tones, five different hair colours
and lengths — jet-black long, honey-blonde waves, caramel curls, deep-chestnut
long, dark-brown bob. Never repeat a look, never blend two faces.
Each greeting is spoken clearly and completely within its two seconds, with
accurate native pronunciation and matching lip movement.
Pure video. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text, no BGM, no
watermark. Only the five voices and quiet morning room tone.
Prohibit: a sixth person, two people in one frame, the same face twice,
plastic or airbrushed skin, doll-like faces, hard cuts, objects appearing from
nothing, the hand entering before the greeting is finished, mixed camera
moves, jitter, flicker.

→ (3s, propped medium shot) Places camera on the table, lays out a few fresh flowers. "Pressing some flowers today."
→ (3s, overhead shot) Arranges petals flat between two sheets of plain paper.
→ (3s, close-up) Uses tweezers to gently position a delicate petal.
→ (3s, handheld shot) Closes the paper carefully over the flowers. "Just need to keep them flat."
→ (3s, detail shot) Places the paper between the pages of a heavy book. No dialogue.
→ (3s, medium shot) Stacks a few more books on top for weight. "That should do it."
→ (3s, macro shot) A previously pressed flower being lifted out, delicate and flat.
→ (3s, propped shot) Arranges the pressed flowers onto a small card.
→ (3s, warm ending shot) Admires the finished arrangement, soft smile. "So delicate and pretty."
→ (5s, final shot) Sets the card on the windowsill, reaches toward camera. "See you next batch." Hand covers lens as recording ends.
AUDIO NOTES: Natural ambience — petals rustling, paper turning, book settling should be clearly audible. Dialogue quiet and casual.
REALISM NOTES: Authentic body language, natural blinking, genuine soft smiles, occasional gentle pauses, imperfect framing, focus breathing, bright daylight shifts. No copyrighted characters, logos, brand names, or recognizable public figures anywhere in frame. Fully original personal vlog content, not AI-generated or commercial in style.

prompts.prompt: A cinematic 30-second tropical travel vlog montage featuring a beautiful 20-year-old East Asian woman with dark hair exploring Hawaii during a dreamy summer vacation. Shot like an authentic luxury travel diary with handheld camera movement, candid moments, soft golden-hour sunlight, dreamy 35mm film aesthetics, warm vintage color grading, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, atmospheric lighting, and cinematic storytelling. Maintain the same woman throughout every scene: dark hair, youthful appearance, natural makeup, elegant summer outfits, relaxed happy expression. Format: 4K cinematic video, 24fps, 35mm film grain, realistic handheld camera, soft focus, warm color palette, travel documentary style. Scene 1 (0-4s) — Arrival & City Walk: A beautiful Hawaiian morning. The woman walks through a bright tropical city street wearing a flowing floral summer dress and sunglasses. Palm trees line the sidewalk, sunlight reflects off colorful buildings, people walk casually in the background. Camera follows from behind, then transitions into a close-up of her smiling face as wind moves through her hair. Scene 2 (4-8s) — Beach Discovery: She steps onto a wide sandy beach with crystal blue ocean waves behind her. She walks barefoot along the shoreline, holding her dress slightly as waves touch her feet. Low-angle cinematic shots of footsteps in wet sand, ocean reflections, distant volcanic mountains under a clear sky. Scene 3 (8-12s) — Tropical Nature Moments: A cinematic worm's-eye view looking upward through towering palm trees. Golden sunlight streams between the leaves with beautiful lens flares. Cut to a close-up of her standing near a rocky ocean cliff, wind blowing through her hair while she looks peacefully toward the sea. Scene 4 (12-16s) — Beachfront Cafe & Slow Living: She sits alone at a cozy beachfront cafe near the window, drinking a tropical drink while watching waves outside. Soft sunlight enters through the glass. Close-up shots of her hands, coffee cup, ocean view, and thoughtful expression create an intimate travel diary feeling. Scene 5 (16-20s) — Ocean Adventure: She floats peacefully on a surfboard in calm turquoise ocean water. Camera moves around her from water level, showing gentle waves, sunlight sparkling on the sea surface, tropical coastline and mountains in the distance. She laughs naturally while looking toward the camera. Scene 6 (20-24s) — Night Market Exploration: A vibrant Hawaiian night market filled with warm lights, food stalls, and colorful decorations. She walks through the crowd, trying tropical fruit skewers and local street food. Cinematic close-ups of her reaction, glowing lanterns, neon bokeh, and bustling atmosphere. Scene 7 (24-27s) — Golden Sunset Ending: Wide cinematic silhouette shot of her standing on the ocean shore during sunset. Orange and pink skies reflect on the water. Waves gently move around her feet as she watches the sun disappear behind the horizon. Emotional travel film ending. Scene 8 (27-30s) — Hotel Night Reflection: Nighttime high-rise hotel balcony overlooking sparkling tropical city lights. She wears a simple white dress, leaning against the balcony while a warm breeze moves the curtains behind her. Final intimate close-up of her lying on the hotel bed, looking warmly into the camera lens with a peaceful smile. Camera Style: Authentic travel vlog cinematography, handheld camera shake, smooth cinematic transitions, slow push-ins, natural movement, occasional POV shots, realistic autofocus adjustments, subtle motion blur. Visual Style: Dreamy Hawaii vacation film, luxury travel advertisement aesthetic, soft golden sunlight, realistic skin texture, cinematic depth of field, nostalgic 35mm film look, warm atmospheric colors, natural expressions, emotional storytelling. Avoid: cartoon style, CGI look, plastic skin, unrealistic face, inconsistent character appearance, changing hairstyle, extra fingers, distorted body, artificial lighting, oversaturated colors, blurry face, unnatural movements, duplicate people.

prompts.prompt:
（元はThreadsのdopamin.wxyさんを参考にしています）

【Seedance 2.5／15秒／9:16】

参照画像を唯一のキャラクター参照として使用する。15秒、9:16縦型、ワンカット、固定カメラ。開始から終了までカメラは完全固定。ズーム、パン、チルト、回転、手持ち、カット、トランジション、リフレーム、スロー、静止演出は禁止。

【構図・立ち位置】

画面左側45％に実写のBBQグリルと骨付き肉を配置する。画面右側30％に2Dキャラクターを配置する。中央にはトングと肉を移動させるための空間を20％程度確保する。

キャラクターは右側の砂浜に立ち、頭から黒いビーチサンダルまで全身を常に表示する。キャラクターをグリルの前、グリル脚の上、テーブルの上には置かない。キャラクターとグリルの間には明確な空間を残し、開始から終了まで立ち位置を維持する。

グリル、肉、人の手、トング、コチュジャンボトルをキャラクターの身体と重ねない。キャラクターが肉やグリルを隠さない。人の手やトングがキャラクターの顔や身体を不自然に横切らない。物体同士の奥行きと前後関係を正確に維持する。

【映像スタイル】

真夏の美しい海辺で行われる実写BBQ映像と、平面2Dアニメーションステッカーキャラクターを組み合わせたコミカルな映像。

青い海、白い波、明るい青空、黄金色の砂浜、遠景の海岸線、風に揺れるヤシの葉を描く。明るい昼の自然光。海風によってヤシの葉、グリルの煙、キャラクターの白いシャツの裾が自然に揺れる。

背景、海、砂、グリル、炭火、煙、炎、骨付き肉、脂、肉汁、コチュジャン、ボトル、人の手、金属トングはすべて高品質な実写表現。白飛び、過度なブルーム、霞、露出のちらつきは禁止。

キャラクターだけは最後まで平面2Dアニメーションステッカーとして維持する。実写化、半実写化、3D化、CGフィギュア化、ゲームモデル化、Pixar風、クレイアニメ風は禁止。鮮明な線画、セル塗り、平面的な陰影、細い白フチを維持する。

【キャラクター固定】

参照画像の男性キャラクターをそのまま使用する。柔らかなアッシュシルバーのウェーブヘア、前髪の形、髪の長さと毛量、灰青色の瞳、若く整った顔、細身で長い手足の体型を固定する。

白いノースリーブインナー、透け感のある白い半袖オープンシャツ、白いドローコード、黒いペイズリー柄ショートパンツ、黒いビーチサンダル、シルバーネックレス、ピアス、ブレスレット、リングを固定する。

顔、髪型、体型、衣装、柄、色、靴、アクセサリーを変更しない。帽子、サングラス、エプロン、手袋、新しい小物を追加しない。キャラクターを複製しない。別の2Dキャラクターを追加しない。

キャラクターは冷たい無表情ではなく、非常に可愛く表情豊かに動く。大きく輝く目、頬の赤み、嬉しそうな笑顔、首を傾げる仕草、肩を小さく揺らす動き、頬を膨らませた拗ね顔、涙目、慌てて手を振る動きを明確に見せる。棒立ち禁止。

【BBQと骨付き肉】

画面左側の実写BBQグリルで、大きな骨付きトマホークステーキを焼く。長い骨が肉に物理的につながったまま明確に見える。肉は十分に焼けており、濃い焼き目、香ばしい焦げ目、艶のある肉汁、溶けた脂、軽い湯気を描く。

肉を生肉、黒焦げ、骨なし肉、変形した肉にしない。肉や骨を複製しない。骨を途中で消さない。

実写の成人女性の手が画面左端から入る。ピンク色のネイルアート、細いシルバーリング、正常な5本指を維持する。金属製BBQトングで肉を返し、持ち上げる。手、指、リング、トング、肉、グリルを融合させない。

【コチュジャン】

ラベル、文字、ブランドロゴのない透明なスクイーズボトルを使用する。中身は濃厚で艶のある深い赤茶色のコチュジャン。ケチャップのような明るい赤色や水っぽい液体にはしない。

コチュジャンはボトルのノズルから太く連続して流れ、肉の表面に直接落ちる。ソースを空中から突然出現させない。ボトルの底や側面から漏らさない。

【00:00–00:03】

固定されたワイド構図で開始する。左側では骨付きトマホークステーキが大きな音を立てて焼けている。女性の実写の手が金属トングで肉を一度ゆっくり返す。脂が炭に落ち、小さな炎が一瞬だけ上がる。薄い煙が海風に流れる。

右側の2Dキャラクターは肉を見つめ、目を大きくキラキラ輝かせる。両手を顎の下で合わせ、肩を上げ、膝を少し曲げて小さく2回弾む。口元に小さな2Dのよだれが一滴だけ現れて消える。

【00:03–00:05】

キャラクターがコチュジャンボトルを見つける。目を輝かせ、首を傾げ、片手でボトルを指さす。嬉しそうにボトルを両手で持ち、胸の前で一瞬だけ抱き締める。

その後、片目を閉じたイタズラっぽい笑顔になり、ノズルを左側の肉へ向ける。キャラクター自身は右側の立ち位置から移動しない。

【00:05–00:07】

キャラクターがボトルを強く絞り、骨付き肉の上へコチュジャンを大量にかける。濃い赤茶色の太いソースがノズルから肉まで連続して伸び、肉の表面に大量のジグザグ模様を作る。

ソースは熱で軽く泡立ち、肉汁と混ざって艶を出す。肉全体を完全に隠さず、骨と焼き目は見える状態を維持する。

キャラクターは得意げに笑い、舌先を少し出し、肩を可愛く左右に揺らしながらボトルを絞る。女性の手はトングを持ったまま驚いて止まる。

【00:07–00:09】

女性の手がトングでコチュジャンボトルを素早く取り上げ、左側へ戻す。その直後、閉じたトングの先端でキャラクターの頭頂部を軽く一度だけ「こん！」と叩く。

トングの先端がキャラクターの髪へ明確に軽く接触する。接触と同時に、頭の上へ小さな黄色い2Dの星形衝撃エフェクトを出す。強く殴らない。痛々しくしない。完全に可愛いカートゥーン式のツッコミにする。

叩かれた瞬間、キャラクターの頭が右へ傾き、銀髪が弾み、肩と胴体が左、右へ大きく揺れる。膝が曲がり、両腕を広げてバランスを取る。足は砂浜から離れず、グリル側へ移動しない。

頬を膨らませ、目をぎゅっと閉じ、小さな涙を一滴だけ出す。頭だけではなく、全身が可愛く揺れる動きを約1秒間はっきり見せる。

【00:09–00:11】

女性の手がトングをグリルへ戻し、コチュジャンの付いた焼き肉を一口サイズに持ち上げる。持ち上げた肉には焼き目、肉汁、繊維、濃いコチュジャンが見える。

トングは中央の空間を通り、肉をキャラクターの口の前まで運ぶ。キャラクターは頭を叩かれたことに拗ね、腕を組んで顔を横へ向け、頬を膨らませる。

すぐに目だけで肉をちらっと見る。目が再び輝き、腕をほどき、両手を背中へ回し、上半身を少し前へ傾ける。口を大きく開け、肉へ近づく。

【00:11–00:12】

キャラクターが肉を明確に一口食べる。開いた口をトングで持った肉へ近づけ、肉を口で挟み、頭を後ろへ引いて一口分を噛み取る。

トングに残った肉には、はっきりした一口分の欠けた跡を残す。肉を見るだけ、匂いを嗅ぐだけ、舐めるだけは禁止。

キャラクターは2回はっきり噛む。頬を少し膨らませ、最初は非常に幸せそうな表情になる。目を閉じ、両手を頬へ当て、片足のかかとを上げて嬉しそうに小さく揺れる。

【00:12–00:13.2】

突然、激辛に気づく。噛む動きを止め、目を大きな丸に見開き、瞳孔を小さくする。顔全体が頬から額まで急速に赤くなる。頭の周囲に小さな汗マークを複数出す。

両手で口元を高速にあおぎ、左右の足を交互に小さく上げて慌てる。膝、肩、胴体を細かく震わせ、両目に大きな可愛い涙をためる。右側の立ち位置から出ない。

【00:13.2–00:14.4】

キャラクターが上半身を少し前へ倒し、口を大きく開ける。口の中から、明確な平面2Dコミック炎を一度だけ勢いよく吹き出す。

炎はキャラクターの口から始まり、画面右上の何もない空間へ向かう。炎をグリル、肉、人の手、トング、ボトルへ向けない。

炎は黄色い中心、オレンジ色の本体、赤い輪郭を持つ平面2Dイラスト。炎の中に小さな赤唐辛子マークを数個混ぜる。実写の危険な炎にはしない。物を燃やさない。爆発させない。

キャラクターは涙を流しながら両腕を慌てて振り、炎の反動で上半身だけ少し後ろへ揺れる。足は砂浜の同じ位置を維持する。

【00:14.4–00:15】

2Dの炎が小さく縮み、可愛い白い煙の「ぷすっ」という一粒のエフェクトに変わる。

キャラクターは最後に全身を一度だけ左右へふらつかせる。膝が震え、肩が落ち、髪が一度弾む。両手で口を押さえ、真っ赤な頬、涙目、腫れたような小さな唇、恥ずかしそうな表情になる。

頭の上を小さな赤唐辛子アイコンが回転する。女性の手は左側で、一口分が欠けた肉をトングで持ったまま困惑して停止する。

キャラクター全身は右側、グリルと肉は左側に明確に分離した状態で終了する。フェードアウト禁止。タイトル表示禁止。

【音】

海の波音、海風、ヤシの葉の揺れる音、遠くの鳥の声、炭火の音、肉の強い焼ける音、脂が落ちる小さな炎の音、コチュジャンを絞る音、軽いコミカル音、頭を叩く明確な「こん！」という音、全身が揺れる弾む音、一口噛む音、2回の咀嚼音、激辛に気づく上昇音、可愛いコミック炎の「ボワッ」という音、最後の小さな「ぷすっ」という煙の音。

明るく可愛いテンポのBGMを小さく流す。台詞、ナレーション、歌声、字幕、テロップ、歌詞、画面内文字は禁止。

【禁止事項】

キャラクターとグリルの重なり禁止。キャラクターをグリル脚の上へ立たせない。肉をキャラクターで隠さない。人の手やボトルでキャラクターを隠さない。トングをキャラクターの身体へ貫通させない。前後関係の崩壊禁止。

頭を叩く動作の省略禁止。全身が揺れる動作の省略禁止。一口食べる動作の省略禁止。肉の一口跡の省略禁止。咀嚼の省略禁止。激辛リアクションの省略禁止。口から炎を吹く動作の省略禁止。

カメラ移動禁止。カット禁止。画面転換禁止。スロー禁止。静止画化禁止。キャラクターの棒立ち禁止。キャラクター複製禁止。顔変化禁止。髪型変化禁止。衣装変化禁止。足の消失禁止。全身のクロップ禁止。実写化禁止。3D化禁止。

手の変形、指の増減、トングとの融合、物体の浮遊、ボトルの消失、ソースの空中発生、ケチャップ化、生肉化、骨なし肉化、骨の分離、肉の複製、危険な実写炎、火傷、爆発、ブランド、ロゴ、字幕、白飛び、ちらつきを禁止する。

A 30-second photorealistic smartphone travel vlog featuring Michikusa Zasuko, a real Japanese woman, based on the attached multi-panel character reference sheet.

REFERENCE ROLE: Use the attached image only as the identity, face, hairstyle, blue-purple glasses, white flower hair clip, pastel summer yukata, green obi, purple bow detail, and green sandals reference. Do not reproduce the reference sheet layout, panels, labels, text, or color swatches. Keep Zasuko's appearance consistent in every shot.

Zasuko is the only featured person and looks directly into the phone during selfie moments.

TIMELINE:
00-04s: Front-facing selfie introduction while walking into a lantern-lit traditional Japanese summer festival. She smiles naturally and briefly shows her pastel yukata.
04-10s: Over-the-shoulder and selfie cutaways of lanterns, food stalls, and festival visitors; she turns the phone back to herself with a small excited reaction.

Generate authentic footsteps, festival crowd murmur, distant festival music, takoyaki cooking sounds, game stall sounds, and fireworks. Do not generate background music over the dialogue. No subtitles, no captions, no logos, no watermark, no readable invented text.

CONTINUITY LOCK: same face, glasses, bob haircut with green streaks, white flower clip, pastel yukata, green obi, proportions, and accessories across all shots. prompts.prompt:
CAMERA:
DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. POV of CHASE holding the camera herself throughout each location, occasionally propped briefly for hands-free moments. Hand shake, misaligned framing, delayed focus pulls, clumsy zooms, occasional face cut-off framing, imperfect shots. Camcorder never appears on screen.
LOOK:
Soft, slightly blurry tape quality, faint tape noise, bloomed highlights, flickering auto-exposure, muted contrast, realistic skin tones — lighting shifts per location (clinical soft light at physio → warm home light for stretching → soft steamy bathroom light → dim cozy bedroom light).
STYLE:
Slow, gentle montage feel — calmer and more tender than her usual bubbly vlogs. Quiet reflective voiceover narration plays over the visuals instead of synced dialogue. Mood stays soft and caring throughout, centered on rest and self-care.
Character
CHASE — Korean idol, 20s. Long straight black hair, natural and softly tied back, dewy glass skin, minimal to no makeup, tired but peaceful expression. Wearing a modest robe or oversized loungewear throughout — fully covering arms, torso, and legs at all times, including during the bath/shower segment (framed only from shoulders up or via steam/robe coverage, nothing revealing shown).
Setting Progression
Physio/massage clinic (afternoon) → her room, stretching mat (early evening) → bathroom, steamy warm light (night) → bedroom (late night).
Storyboard (20s, 6 cuts)
(~3.5s, physio clinic, propped camera, medium shot) She lies on a treatment table as a therapist's hands (off-camera) work on her shoulder, wincing slightly then relaxing. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Some days, taking care of myself has to come first."
(~3s, physio clinic, close handheld) She sits up slowly afterward, rolling her shoulder, small relieved exhale. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "That already feels so much better."
(~3.5s, home, stretching mat, medium propped shot) She stretches gently on a mat in her room, slow and unhurried, soft evening light. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "A little more stretching never hurts."
(~3s, bathroom, steamy soft light, framed modestly — shoulders up only, robe visible) She sits wrapped in a robe near a warm bath or shower, steam softly filling the frame, eyes closed peacefully. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "And then... just letting the day melt away."
(~3s, bathroom, macro insert) Close-up on water droplets and steam, soft warm light, no exposed skin beyond hands/face. No narration — ambient water sound only.
(~4s, bedroom, dim cozy light, closing shot) She climbs into bed early, pulling the blanket up, eyes already heavy, a small content smile before the screen fades. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Some nights, the earlier the better."

prompts.prompt:
16:9, 30-second photoreal live-action fantasy battle in clear daylight, crisp high-resolution cinema detail, natural textures, clean HDR contrast, one wide lens and one uninterrupted controlled handheld pursuit shot.

The elf princess is tall and slender, with fair freckled skin, blue-gray eyes, long wavy platinum-blonde hair, pointed ears, a silver branch circlet, and a flowing silver battle gown with a scale-textured mantle. Keep one identical princess throughout. She holds one silver longsword in her right hand.

Exactly 36 distinct armored green-skinned orcs enter over time, each with a different weapon, helmet, armor, or silhouette; orc 36 is a heavy captain with a cleaver. Never reuse an orc. Every stroke hits exactly one target. Show 36 separate contacts, green-fluid releases, and individual defeats. No multi-target cut; shockwaves move dust only. Each next orc actively attacks, guards, evades, or intercepts.

Rotate Zornhau, Zwerchhau, Unterhau, Krumphau, Scheitelhau, straight thrust, moulinet reverse cut, draw cut, and pivoting back cut without adjacent repetition. Every relocation uses this rhythm: clean micro-anticipation; a white-silver flash fully hides the princess and she vanishes; the camera continues its normal physical follow with the environment visible; a second local flash reveals her beside the next target in a fully formed attack pose. Show no transit body movement and no whip pan.

The camera stays close, following with smooth handheld sidesteps, retreats, arcs, drops, rises, and pivots. It travels toward each flash destination without snapping, resetting, teleporting, or hiding a cut. Keep princess, orcs, background, debris, hair, cloth, fluid, and particles sharply resolved. No motion blur anywhere.

SEQUENCE: ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT

Beat 1 / 0-3s: Rear 3/4 WS, follow behind the princess into a sunlit battle already in progress. The orcs occupy successive depth pockets, not one flat crowd; only nearby attackers are readable. Orc 1 charges while she forms the opening anticipation pose.

Beat 2 / 3-10s: CONTINUE SAME SHOT through orcs 1-9. Follow attacks from alternating sides with physical sidesteps and arcs. Perform nine fast but separate vanish, follow, reappear, single-target cycles using different techniques. Preserve each crisp contact, green-fluid release, recoil, and fall before the next attack. End with nine defeated as orc 10 attacks from behind.

Beat 3 / 10-17s: CONTINUE SAME SHOT through orcs 10-18. Pivot around the princess to catch the rear attack, move ahead, backpedal while leading, then arc around as threats enter from different directions. Show nine more individual attacks and one-orc cuts in a changed order. She appears only in sharp anticipation, contact, and finishing poses. End with eighteen defeated and orc 19 intercepting.

Beat 4 / 17-24s: CONTINUE SAME SHOT through orcs 19-27. Drop beside timber, rise around a shield, pass behind an axe raider, then turn toward an attacker descending from rubble. Increase tempo across nine distinct parries, evasions, lunges, guards, and single-target finishes. Each relocation uses two local flashes with continuous environment between them. End with twenty-seven defeated as the final nine surround her.

Beat 5 / 24-30s: CONTINUE SAME SHOT through orcs 28-36. Enter a tight controlled pursuit orbit, changing proximity and height along one physical path. Orcs 28-35 each receive a separate technique, contact, green-fluid release, and fall. The captain attacks last; sidestep his cleaver as one flash hides the princess and the next reveals her beyond him in a sharp Scheitelhau finish. His delayed impact affects only him. End with all 36 individually defeated.

SOUND: No dialogue or subtitles. Daylight battle ambience, sword transients, 36 distinct contact accents, individual orc reactions, dry flash cracks, and accelerating percussion.

VFX: Local white-silver flashes cover only the princess during vanish and reveal. Green fluid begins only at sword contact. Render every effect with crisp edges and zero motion blur.

EXCLUDE: Motion blur anywhere, whip pans, cuts, hidden cuts, lens changes, camera resets or teleports, visible transit, morphing, stretched limbs, extra or smeared anatomy, duplicates, multi-target strikes, low resolution, soft focus, haze, grain, compression artifacts, and night lighting.

prompts.prompt: Create a ten second cinematic live action illusion in a sixteen by nine frame at thirty frames per second. Begin inside a faithfully recreated late nineteen nineties desktop paint program. Use a cool gray window frame, navy title bar, simple menus, chunky pixel tool icons on the left, scroll bars, and small color swatches along the bottom. The canvas shows a saturated blue sky with soft white clouds and a vivid green grassy hill, nostalgic but photographed with realistic depth, subtle cloud movement, and light atmospheric haze. 0 to 1.2 seconds. Hold a locked frontal camera on the full paint window. The empty landscape fills the canvas. A slim young adult man rises smoothly from the bottom center with his back to camera. He wears a red athletic shirt with white collar and sleeve stripes, a backward royal blue cap, a thin silver chain, and black ink forearm tattoos. Give his movement real body weight, natural shoulder motion, and slight cloth drag. 1.2 to 2.5 seconds. He lifts his tattooed right arm toward the upper left of the canvas as though touching an invisible drawing tool. Keep the interface perfectly stable and sharp. He turns clockwise toward camera, lowers his hand, and settles into a relaxed waist up pose at center. Use soft frontal daylight, a gentle key from camera left, believable skin texture, clear eyes, fine facial hair, and a faint contact shadow. 2.5 to 6.2 seconds. He looks into camera with a playful calm expression, raises one index finger, and draws in midair. A warm ivory line appears exactly at the fingertip and follows every gesture without delay. It looks like a real textured paint stroke with slight thickness variation, dry brush edges, and a soft glow. He draws one continuous five point star around his body. Make the tall upper point above his cap, the right point beside his shoulder, the lower left point across his torso, the lower right point, then close the shape near his raised hand. Preserve correct hand anatomy, stable identity, perfect line continuity, and natural reactions from his free hand. 6.2 to 7.4 seconds. When the star closes, perform a smooth optical push into the canvas until the interface edges slide beyond the frame. The move should feel like a real camera passing through a monitor, with subtle lens breathing and no cut. He smiles softly and lifts both palms in a small satisfied reveal while the completed ivory star floats around him. 7.4 to 10 seconds. He glances right and walks naturally out of frame. Keep the camera locked on the empty hill and sky. The star remains suspended, slowly loses brightness, and becomes slightly transparent without vanishing. End with one cloud drifting through its center. Maintain one continuous shot, realistic motion blur, natural blinking, stable clothing and tattoos, accurate perspective, clean edges, no warped limbs, no duplicate fingers, no facial changes, no flicker, no random objects, no extra people, and no artificial plastic skin. Make it feel like a practical live action performance composited into an authentic retro computer interface. Audio. Add an original playful retro electronic instrumental at about one hundred and five beats per minute with a warm drum machine groove, soft bass, bright synth plucks, and subtle digital ambience. Sync a light mouse click to the first hand gesture, delicate paint stroke swishes to the fingertip, a sparkling chime when the star closes, and a soft whoosh during the push into the canvas. No vocals and no dialogue.

prompts.prompt:
CAMERA / LOOK: Handheld mini DV camcorder footage filmed by the subject herself. Slight hand shake, occasional focus hunting, imperfect framing, natural zoom adjustments, soft tape-like image quality, subtle grain, realistic auto-exposure shifts from bright open-sky daylight. Natural skin tones, mild motion blur, authentic consumer camcorder aesthetic rather than polished cinematic footage.
STYLE: Cozy outdoor kite-flying vlog with gentle ASMR elements. Relaxed pacing, minimal dialogue, candid moments, natural pauses. Focus on satisfying everyday sounds: kite fabric flapping in the wind, string spool unwinding, grass rustling underfoot, light breeze against the microphone.
SUBJECT: Young woman in her mid-20s, plain windbreaker, hair tied back in a loose ponytail, minimal jewelry, no visible logos or branded items. Cheerful, carefree energy on a breezy afternoon.
SETTING: Small open field on a bright breezy afternoon. Wide open sky, plain grass field, no visible signage, buildings with branding, or logos anywhere in frame.
STORYBOARD:
→ (3s, propped medium shot) Places camera on a low tripod in the grass, unrolls a plain kite. "Perfect windy day for this."
→ (3s, overhead shot) Unwinds the string spool, checking it's free of tangles.
→ (3s, close-up) Attaches the string firmly to the kite frame.
→ (3s, handheld shot) Walks backward a few steps, testing the wind direction. "Feels strong enough today."
→ (3s, detail shot) Releases the kite gently into the air. No dialogue.
→ (3s, medium shot) Watches it climb higher, letting the string out slowly. "There it goes."
→ (3s, macro shot) Kite fabric flapping steadily against the open sky.
→ (3s, propped shot) Sits down on the grass, holding the string loosely.
→ (3s, warm ending shot) Looks up at the kite soaring, happy smile. "Love days like this."
→ (5s, final shot) Reels the string in slowly, glances toward camera. "See you next time." Reaches down and covers the lens as recording ends.
AUDIO NOTES: Natural outdoor ambience — kite flapping, string unwinding, breeze, grass rustling should be clearly audible. Dialogue quiet and casual, as if speaking to a small personal audience.
REALISM NOTES: Authentic body language, natural blinking, genuine cheerful smiles, occasional pauses adjusting the string, imperfect framing, focus breathing, bright open-sky lighting shifts. No copyrighted characters, logos, brand names, or recognizable public figures anywhere in frame. Fully original personal vlog content, not AI-generated or commercial in style.

穿着
HKb7_rmbMAARNAP
站在荒凉平原的画面右侧，身体朝向画面左侧。她五官秀美清晰， 远方是低矮山脉、枯草、裸露岩石和灰蓝色阴云。女侠神情凌厉，右脚踩实地面，左脚向前稳定重心，腰部向后扭转，肩膀带动右臂，以全身力量将一块粗糙灰色石块猛力抛向画面左侧。发尾、衣摆和腰间束带受到转身惯性向外甩动。 石槌变成一支商周时期的青铜长矛。矛头具有厚重的青铜质感、铸造纹理和自然氧化斑，木质矛杆继续沿同一轨迹高速飞行。背景升级为尘土飞扬的早期古代战场，远处可见战车、木盾、皮甲士兵和迎风摆动的素色旌旗。 MATCH CUT。 青铜长矛变成一支秦汉重弩射出的弩箭。弩箭具有锋利的三棱青铜箭头、硬木箭杆和稳定尾羽，主体仍位于画面中心。背景升级为秦汉边塞，夯土城墙、木制箭楼、弩阵和远处骑兵在冷灰色风沙中快速掠过。箭杆高速自旋，尾羽受到气流产生细小颤动。 MATCH CUT。 弩箭变成一支宋代火箭矢。箭杆前端保留金属箭头，中段捆绑细长火药筒，尾部喷出明亮橙色火焰与灰白烟迹。火箭矢保持此前弩箭的飞行方向和旋转轴，火焰只在尾部向后喷射，不改变主体轨迹。 背景升级为宋代城防战场，青砖城墙、木制楼橹、床弩、盾阵和瓦顶建筑在浓烟中快速后退。火药燃烧照亮箭杆边缘，烟迹被高速气流拉成长线。 MATCH CUT。 火箭矢前端在经过画面中心时变成一枚宋代震天雷。震天雷是一枚沉重的深灰色球形铁壳火器，表面具有铸铁纹理、接缝和短小燃烧引线。它继续沿同一轨迹高速旋转，燃烧引线向后拉出火星，没有提前爆炸。 背景中的宋代城墙发生远距离爆炸，橙黄色火球、碎土和烟尘形成冲击波。逆光在震天雷边缘形成短促金属高光，主体依然保持锐利。 MATCH CUT。 球形震天雷在旋转遮挡中变成一具明代神火飞鸦。神火飞鸦具有写实的乌鸦形木质外壳、黑色蒙皮、两侧短翼和尾部火箭推进器，不是活鸟。它沿同一方向飞行，尾部数道橙红火焰同时喷射，短翼受到气流产生轻微震动。 背景升级为明代大型城防战场，砖石城楼、火器营、成排火箭架、黑色火药烟雾和迎风摆动的军旗快速掠过。神火飞鸦从传统火器形态逐渐展现出早期飞行器轮廓。 MATCH CUT。 神火飞鸦张开的黑色双翼变成一架银灰色三角翼隐形战斗机。摄影机位于战机前上方约十米处高速后退引导，战机保持画面中心，贴近东方山谷高速俯冲。 下方是云雾笼罩的喀斯特峰林、河流和层叠山脊。战机表面采用克制的深灰色隐身涂层和东方几何分割线，没有文字、编号或标志。机翼切开湿润空气，翼尖形成短暂白色凝结涡，峡谷后方升起浓黑烟柱。 MATCH CUT。 战斗机变成一架白色可重复使用载人航天器。机首倾角、三角翼轮廓和运动方向保持一致，机腹覆盖深色耐热材料，机身具有红色细节线和真实隔热板结构，不出现旗帜、文字或机构标志。 航天器尾部喷射巨大的橙蓝色火焰，冲破云层进入近地轨道。背景从东方山脉自然过渡为大气层边缘，地球蓝色弧线出现在画面下方，阳光在白色机身边缘形成冷白高光。 MATCH CUT。 航天器尾焰中心变成未来东方星际飞船的巨大圆形推进器。推进器内部的同心金属环、耐热陶瓷和磁约束结构逐层亮起橙红色能量。摄影机继续高速后退，飞船正面和完整船体逐渐显露。 星际飞船采用厚重可信的工业结构，主体为深灰金属、玉白色陶瓷装甲和暗红色结构线。船体轮廓具有克制的中式轴线对称、飞檐折线和龙脊般的纵向结构，但不是宫殿、宝塔或卡通龙造型。装甲表面分布细密机械舱门、散热片、微弱红色状态灯和若隐若现的抽象云纹压印。 摄影机贴近飞船外壳掠过船体顶部。大型装甲板、结构梁和散热格栅从镜头下方高速通过，运动方向始终连续。摄影机随后越过船体中轴，自然进入飞船后方视角。 最终画面中，巨型东方星际飞船尾部位于画面中心，多组圆形蓝白色离子引擎由内向外依次点火。发动机亮度迅速增强，冷蓝光反射在玉白陶瓷与深灰金属装甲表面。 飞船产生明确加速度，带着巨大质量感驶向深空。摄影机逐渐停止追随，飞船越来越小，最终缩成远方红蓝星云前的一颗明亮光点。星际飞船消失后，星云轮廓短暂呈现出类似水墨山脉的自然层次，但仍保持真实宇宙影像质感。 【摄影与物理】 飞行物镜头使用29°至47°对角视场角，摄影机与主体保持稳定伴飞距离。主体始终位于画面中心并保持锐利，背景保留高速运动模糊和清楚的时代环境线索。 每种物体具有正确质量、惯性、空气阻力、旋转轴和材质反光：石块旋转不规则；石槌受木柄影响产生偏心旋转；长矛与弩箭沿长轴稳定；震天雷沉重且旋转较慢；神火飞鸦依靠尾部火箭保持姿态；战机、航天器和星际飞船依靠气动面或推进系统稳定飞行。 匹配剪辑只发生在主体经过画面中心、轮廓短暂重叠或旋转至相同角度的瞬间。每次变化都是干净利落的一帧MATCH CUT，不是渐变、融化或零件生长。飞行方向、视觉中心和总体动量始终连续。 【声音】 只生成画面内自然音效：女侠发力时的短促呼气、鞋底摩擦、衣料与发带破风声、手臂挥动声、石块和石槌划破空气的呼啸、青铜矛头的低沉风鸣、弩箭尾羽振动、火箭矢燃烧声、震天雷引线火花、远处爆炸、神火飞鸦火箭喷射、战斗机喷气发动机、航天器推进器轰鸣，以及星际引擎逐级充能和点火声。 声音随时代升级逐渐由原始风声和金属声，发展为火药爆燃、喷气轰鸣和深沉的星际推进器低频震动。无旁白、无对白、无背景音乐。 【写实后缀】 真实电影级运动物理，细腻材质，稳定主体一致性，准确匹配剪辑，真实景深和速度模糊。中国古代女侠面部自然真实，身体结构正确，投掷动作具有明确的脚步支撑、腰部扭转、肩臂传力和释放惯性。 禁止古代女侠变脸、手指异常、服装穿模或宽大袖子缠绕手臂；禁止武器漂浮、橡胶变形、突然减速、反向飞行或改变轨迹；禁止渐变变形、粒子重组和魔法光效；禁止把神火飞鸦生成真实乌鸦；禁止把星际飞船生成宫殿、宝塔或卡通巨龙。 画面内不出现文字、字幕、标志、水印或UI。各时代环境连续升级，飞行主体的方向、视觉中心、旋转节奏和动量始终保持一致。

prompts.prompt:
30-second cinematic historical epic, 16:9. Photorealistic late Egyptian royal court with grounded human behavior, real skin texture, natural facial micro-expressions, historically inspired linen, bronze, gold, leather, horses, papyrus, firelight and stone. Preserve the queen in ivory and deep-blue gown, the kneeling Roman envoy in dark red cloak and bronze armor, the emerald-robed priestess, the enormous blue-and-gold throne hall, burning braziers, reflective black floor, and the Nile beyond the open arches.

0-5s: [Slow low dolly from behind the kneeling Roman envoy toward the queen] The queen studies the Roman treaty in silence. Firelight flickers across her face; the envoy's hands are tense around the ivory tablet. Behind the throne, Egyptian palace guards stand still with bronze spears and large blue-and-gold shields.
Envoy, restrained English: “Rome offers peace.”

5-10s: [Medium close-up on the queen] She looks up slowly. Her expression is calm, intelligent, and cold rather than theatrical.
Queen, clear English: “Rome offers surrender.”
The envoy swallows, briefly losing his composure.

10-15s: [Over-the-shoulder on the envoy, queen in focus behind him] He glances toward the open Nile archway.
Envoy: “Their legions wait at the river.”
The priestess watches the queen closely; only the flames and curtains move.

15-21s: [Camera tracks alongside the queen as she rises and descends the throne steps] The queen hands the treaty to the priestess, who drops it into a bronze brazier. The papyrus burns naturally. The queen walks forward, her heavy blue train sliding across the black stone floor. Palace guards step apart in two disciplined lines, creating a path toward the open terrace. No magical effects, only fire, smoke, fabric, metal, and human tension.

21-26s: [Camera follows behind her, then cranes upward over her shoulder] She reaches the vast palace terrace overlooking the Nile. Below, a real Egyptian royal army fills the riverbank and courtyard: rows of bronze-armored infantry, tall standards moving in hot wind, horse-drawn chariots, shield-bearing guards, priests carrying gold sun emblems, and long riverboats waiting beside the water. Dust hangs in the warm dawn light. The scale is enormous but physically believable.

26-30s: [Low-angle close-up, army blurred behind her] The queen stops at the terrace edge. Wind lifts the edge of her blue train. She looks toward the Roman envoy, then toward her assembled army.
Queen, low and final: “Then Rome will learn whom Egypt follows.”
Hold on her face as the army below strikes spear shafts once against their shields in a single thunderous response.

Grand historical scale, grounded realism, emotionally restrained acting, physically accurate crowd movement, detailed bronze armor, natural fire and smoke, believable horse and chariot motion, rich blue, gold, ivory and desert-stone palette, elegant stable camera movement, precise English lip sync. No magic, no supernatural symbols, no modern objects, no sci-fi effects, no random text, no logos, no extra main characters, no duplicate limbs, no warped faces or hands, no costume drift, no unstable architecture, no chaotic camera shake.

prompts.prompt:
＃　クオリティ
実写でフォトリアリスティック、重厚でシネマティックな映像美。可愛らしさを残しつつ冷静で落ち着いた表情の日本人女性20歳の白髪美少女（身長164cm、刀長67cm）と、高さ約180cmのメカニックネコロボット二体による対決。白髪美少女は険しい表情ではなく、美しく静かな表情を保つ。BGMは完全に禁止。風、衣擦れ、呼吸、足音、金属音、機械音、火花、レーザー、着地、破壊、爆発などの環境音と効果音は立体的かつ丁寧に生成する。戦闘は高速でスピード感に富むが、重要な動作の始点・接触・終点は判別できるようにする。白髪美少女は超人的な身体能力を持ち、アクロバティックかつ滑らかに動く。絵コンテを参考に撮影し、背景は参照画像に基づく荒廃した広大な戦場として作り込む。

＃制約

3Dレンダー風、CGアニメ風、2Dアニメ風は禁止。映像内の日本語音声、日本語字幕、日本語テキストは禁止。白髪美少女は常に右手で刀を保持し、素手状態にしない。刀を左手へ持ち替えない。鞘は一切映さない。余分な刀、銃、人物、装備を追加しない。メカニックネコのデザイン、白髪美少女の顔・髪・衣装を全編で維持する。著作物の無断使用は禁止。単調な定点撮影や陳腐なカメラワークは禁止。高速の戦闘、静かな間、緊張の溜め、突然の加速を明確に使い分け、観客の注意を常に維持する。

＃　展開

- １７，カメラはグラウンドレベルショットで地面辺りを映すところから始まる。ハンディブレあり。すると、画面上からフレームインするように白髪美少女の足元が、膝をしっかり曲げて勢いを和らげてカッコよく着地する。その様子を真横から撮影する（画面左を正面として体を向けている）。そしてジャンプカット→白髪美少女のバストショット（肩から上を映す。ヘッドルームなし）を真正面からクローズアップして撮影する。一旦リラックスしたように落ち着くそぶりを見せるが。。。何かの気配に気付き、背後に振り返る。白髪美少女の後方、つまり先ほど振り向いた先にはなんと！？

- １８，目の前に迫るメカニックネコ２体が横並びになってこちらにしっぽの先端を向け（尻尾は股下から覗かせるのではなく、背中から背後にかけて頭部の上まで持ち上げるようにして向けさせてね）、恐竜のような雄たけびを上げつつ、エネルギー砲を発射するためのエネルギーを溜めている。その様子を白髪美少女の後方からオーバーザショルダーショットで撮影→

- １９，そしてそのエネルギーを溜め込むしっぽをクローズアップして撮影！これは女の子、危険なのでは？と思いきや、ジャンプカット→

- ２０，白髪美少女の顔のドアップで目元を映す。女の子は冷静に目を閉じる。ここで瞑想でもしてるのか？危ないぞ！？

→

- ２１，刀をカッコよく構えてポーズを取る。中断の構え（ここでは鞘は決して映さない！）で、後方に剣を持つ手を引き（まずは手元をカチッとドアップで撮影）、次に腰を軽く落とし、次に膝を軽く曲げ（ここで腰、膝、足元をしっかりクローズアップしてジャンプカットしながら撮影していく）、体を斜め向きにして姿勢よくまっすぐ立つ（これは白髪美少女を画面右側に配置し、画面左を向くようにする、望遠レンズ、サイドビュー。ただし姿勢をしゃんとしており、まっすぐ立った状態。ほんとにそれで対処できるのか？）→そして、

- ２２，遂に画面左側、つまり下手に配置されるメカニックネコのクローズアップ（サイドビュー）に切り替わり、まるで二体の尻尾からマシンガンのように超高出力で一気に放射！！！！→

- ２２，そして遠く離れる白髪美少女に向かって放たれるそのレーザー砲のうち、一個に焦点を合わせ、そのレーザーガンの背後からトラッキングするように撮影！画面奥に構えたまま動かないでいる白髪美少女めがけて接近していく。すると段々白髪美少女に近づいてくるとスローモーションに切り替わると同時に、なんと白黒のモノトーンにうっすら切り替わり....白髪美少女の目の前にやってきた！！広角レンズで、俯瞰で、見下ろすように白髪美少女を撮影して圧迫感をだすと同時に地面を凸に彎曲させて撮影！　そのままスローモーションを維持したまま白髪美少女の冷静で落ち着き、目を閉じた状態の顔の超ドアップにそのまま移動していき。。。近づいたところで

- ２３，両目をバッ！と開眼！！剣を握る手元を超ドアップで映し、ジャンプカット→

- ２４，迫りくる無数のレーザー砲のガトリングキャノン（弾丸を描くのではなく実弾の無いエネルギーの塊を映す）を、なんと白髪美少女はその場に両足を突いたまま、目にもとまらぬ神速の刃の連撃で弾き消し、相殺する！休む暇もなく放たれるガンをことごとく弾きとばすが！！その様子をフルショットかつアオリで撮影した状態から上に上がって、白髪美少女の上半身部分を横から撮影するくらいまで移動しながら、撮影していく。

ここは見せ場なので長い尺を取ってじっくりと撮影する。このとき、白髪美少女はリラックスした姿勢のまま、右手で神速の太刀を放ち続け、相殺し続ける。それによって強者感を演出する。→

- ２５，尻尾と、さらに口元からも新たにガトリング砲を放ち続けるメカニックネコ二体を上半身のクローズアップで撮影（尻尾は背後から頭の上まで持っていくようにしてね。股から放つの禁止！）する。画面右を向いている。→

- ２６，その銃撃をたえ凌ぎ続けようやく最後、銃撃が収まったあと（ここでメカニックネコたちを撮影してそのことを強調）を、白髪美少女は映さずメカニックネコを超ドアップで斜め正面から撮影することで見せる（画面右を向いている）。そしてジャンプカット→

- ２７，白髪美少女は「今だ！」と心の中で言わんばかりに（テキスト表記なし）、「フッ」と軽く笑みをこぼす。口を若干緩める感じ！....隙を突くぞってことです。そしてその瞬間、

- ２８，まるで姿がバッと高速でぶれるように消え去る白髪美少女！！

- ２９，メカニックネコ二体は白髪美少女を完全に見失ってしまい、周囲を見渡す。しかし見つからない（これをクローズアップで上半身だけを映す。他の部位が見切れるように、撮影。画面右側を向いたまま右側に配置することでルッキングルームを消し、不穏感を演出）。。。→

- ３０，そしてここで、メカニックネコ二体をアオリで地面から大きく見上げるように正面から撮影する（広角レンズ）。すると、手前に大きく映るメカニックネコ二体の後ろ、遠方から画面上に向かって勢いよく飛び出す白髪美少女！！　ここで急にスローモーションに切り替わる！画面右からジャンプして宙に舞った白髪美少女が瞬時にフレームイン！！！気づかぬままきょろきょろしてるだけのメカニックネコ二体の背後には、右手に剣を構えた白髪美少女の姿が小さく映る（こちらに体正面を向けている）！（もちろんここは広角レンズなのでクリアには映るよ。そしてもちろん遠方に白髪美少女はいるので、遠近感意識してロングショットで映すようにして。手前にメカニックネコが映り、背景は空です。ここではメカニックネコ二体は完全に後ろの白髪美少女に背後をとられている。全く存在に気づけていない）→

- ３１，そして後方のジャンプして宙に舞った状態の白髪美少女の鋭い眼光にそのままポン寄りで、勢いよくぬわっと超クローズアップする！（メカニックネコは非表示）→

- ３２，ジャンプカットし、メカニックネコの頭上高くに思いっきり宙を舞う白髪美少女の後方、特に上半身のクローズアップ（圧迫感をだすため頭頂部は見切れヘッドルーム無しになるくらい接近してる）。そしてその下には地面にたたずみ、ようやくこちらに気づいたメカニックネコ二体が振り向く瞬間を絶えずスローモーションで撮影する。ここでは広角レンズ（地面は凹に彎曲しているように映すことでダイナミックにする）、俯瞰、白髪美少女の背後からオーバーザショルダーショットで、真上から真下を見下ろすような急な角度で撮影する。こちらに完全に背を向けていたメカニックネコ二体はようやくこちらの存在に気づく！！しかし、もう遅い！！→

- ３３，白髪美少女の顔をドアップかつアオリで真下から撮影し、剣をもつ右手を上の大きく振りかぶったように構えており、剣や手元はほとんどフレームアウトしている。振り下ろす直前のモーション！！！（右手のみで剣をもち、姿勢を崩し腰からしっかり上半身をひねり、画面右上が頭部、胴体が左下に向かうような斜め向きに映す。不安定な構図にするためルッキングルームもヘッドルームも無し。体が見切れてる）、ここでスローモーションは終了し、ジャンプカット→

- ３４，剣を振り下ろしたあとの白髪美少女を画面右側手前、画面左側の画面奥にこちらに背を向けたメカニックネコ二体が軽く小さく映る！メカニックネコは動かない。。。そして白髪美少女は深く腰を下し、そして剣を下に深く振り下ろした状態から....

- ３５，立ち上がり、上半身は画面から見切れるように立ち上がる（つまり白髪美少女の渾身の一撃の瞬間を敢えてカットすることでその神速の一撃の迫力を演出するのだ！）と、満を持してとどめの一撃を食らった画面奥のメカニックネコ二体がドカーーーーーン！！！と爆発。白髪美少女は逆光をあびる。そして、→ジャンプカット- ３６、白髪美少女のクールな決め顔....やや笑みをこぼし達成感を感じているかのようだ。ドアップで終える。ここでも爆発を背景としながら、こちらにむかって歩いてきてそのまま正面からフレームアウトして終了！！ここは望遠レンズ！

prompts.prompt:
Main subject: young Korean woman, early 20s, natural everyday appearance, faded charcoal-grey sleeveless crop top, loose high-waisted light-wash jeans, black canvas sneakers, black cord necklace, black wavy hair in a messy side ponytail with wispy bangs. Realistic skin texture, minimal makeup, warm and approachable personality. Maintain consistent identity, clothing, hairstyle, and appearance throughout the entire video. Location: Authentic Korean residential neighborhood during a calm late morning. Narrow concrete alleys, low-rise homes, small terraces, potted plants, laundry lines, bicycles, utility poles, overhead wires, mature trees casting moving shadows, quiet residential atmosphere. No stores, advertisements, cafés, crowds, or commercial activity. Visual Style: Ultra-realistic documentary realism. Genuine candid behavior. Natural body language. Unscripted slice-of-life feeling. Strong environmental authenticity. Rich real-world details and believable human motion. Camera Style: Early-2000s consumer DV camcorder aesthetic. Friend casually recording everyday moments. Heavy handheld shake, imperfect framing, frequent autofocus hunting, lens breathing, exposure pumping when moving between sun and shade, occasional motion blur, subtle rolling shutter, mild digital compression artifacts, faded colors, soft contrast, slight sensor noise. No stabilization. No cinematic camera moves. No modern color grading.

00:00–00:02 Outside a small house entrance. She sits on a low concrete wall adjusting her ponytail with both hands raised. A light breeze moves loose strands of hair. She smiles naturally while the camera struggles to hold focus.

00:02–00:04 The camera follows her into a narrow alley lined with potted plants and concrete walls. She notices a stray cat approaching and crouches down. Framing drifts off-center as the operator tries to keep up.

00:04–00:06 She gently pets and feeds the cat. Autofocus repeatedly shifts between her face and the animal. Morning sunlight flickers through leaves overhead.

00:06–00:08 Small front yard beside her house. She hangs laundry on a clothesline while fabrics sway in the breeze. Exposure changes as clouds briefly pass overhead.

00:08–00:10 On a quiet terrace with a ceramic coffee cup. She sits comfortably watching the neighborhood, occasionally brushing hair behind her ear. Loose handheld side angle with natural camera drift.

00:10–00:12 Close side profile. Someone off-camera greets her. She turns, raises her hand, smiles warmly, and casually says, "Annyeong." The camera catches the moment slightly late.

00:12–00:15 Walking slowly down a tree-lined residential lane holding her coffee cup. She notices the camera, gives a small genuine smile, then looks away and continues walking.

00:15–00:18 A short flight of worn concrete steps between two low houses. She climbs them one-handed, coffee cup in the other, and pauses to steady a leaning potted plant with her foot. The operator lags a beat behind and the frame tilts hard before correcting. Heavy exposure pumping as she moves from deep shade into open sun at the top of the steps.

00:18–00:20 Narrow alley in full late-morning sun. She stops at a green plastic watering can left by a doorway, picks it up, and waters a row of chili plants and a spider plant along the wall. Water darkens the concrete. Autofocus hunts between the falling water and her hands.

00:20–00:22 An older neighbor passes pushing a small metal handcart. She steps aside, gives a short polite bow, and says a brief warm greeting. The neighbor answers in indistinct background chatter and continues on. The camera swings to follow the cart, then swings back to her, badly framed and slightly late.

00:22–00:24 She crouches at a low wall where the same stray cat has reappeared, sitting in a patch of sun. She holds out one hand, the cat ignores her, and she laughs quietly and stands. Camera drops to knee height and the horizon goes crooked. Motion blur as it lifts again.

00:24–00:26 She wheels an old bicycle out from where it leans against a utility pole, checks the front tyre with her thumb, then leaves it and keeps walking. Overhead wires cut across the bright sky in the top of the frame. Lens breathing as the operator tries to zoom and gives up.

00:26–00:28 Back at the small front yard. The laundry from earlier moves in a stronger breeze now. She reaches up and straightens one sleeve on the line, then stands there a moment looking at the neighborhood, coffee cup empty in her other hand. Soft dappled tree shadow moves across her face and the wall behind her.

00:28–00:30 She turns toward the camera at the house entrance, notices it is still recording, raises her hand in a small casual wave and shakes her head slightly, half-smiling, as if telling the operator to stop filming. Recording cuts abruptly to black mid-motion as if the camcorder was switched off.

Audio: Natural ambient sound only — morning birds, distant motorcycles, light wind, leaves rustling, faint neighborhood chatter, cat sounds, footsteps on concrete, fabric moving on clotheslines, water pouring onto concrete, bicycle chain ticking, handcart wheels on rough ground, subtle residential ambience. No music. No sound design. No narration.

Goal: Authentic Korean neighborhood life captured like a forgotten home video from the early 2000s — candid, imperfect, realistic, warm, and deeply believable.

prompts.prompt:
REFERENCE SCOPE

@ IMAGE1 defines only the artist’s identity and wardrobe. Preserve her face, platinum-white blunt bob, round black sunglasses, slim athletic build, long narrow black coat, oversized white T-shirt, short black technical shorts, heavy black boots, and the small white H on the front left chest.

@ IMAGE2 defines the studio: matte black floor and walls, monumental angled white acoustic structures, large white ceiling panels separated by deep cosmic gaps with restrained violet-blue nebulae, and the sculptural cube-like rear wall.

@ IMAGE3 defines the exact first frame: composition, symmetry, camera position, artist scale and darkness. The ceiling must follow @ IMAGE2.

@ VIDEO1 is the sole fixed audio reference and exact performance-timing reference. Ignore its black visual track.

AUDIO

Keep the audio from @ VIDEO1 unchanged at its original timestamps from beginning to end.

All cuts and camera changes affect only the image. They must not alter the audio timing.

Do not generate any new audio, vocals, voices, sound effects, ambience, room tone, impacts or transition sounds.

DIRECTION

Create a cinematic photorealistic underground female rap performance video, 16:9, 1080p.

Keep the artist recognizable and dominant. Her movements feel natural and confident: brief stillness, loose asymmetric gestures, weight shifts, torso turns, short purposeful steps and occasional approaches toward the lens.

No repetitive foot tapping, stomping or looping gestures.

Use lively human handheld camera work: pushes, recoils, brief impact jolts, small tilts, slight overshoots and quick corrections. Keep her face readable. Avoid continuous random shaking and smooth floating gimbal movement.

SHOT STRUCTURE

0–4 SECONDS — OPENING

Start exactly on @ IMAGE3 with no pre-roll or alternate opening frame.

She prepares in darkness with her mouth closed. The studio wakes suddenly in one synchronized lighting event.

The camera immediately makes one fast physical rush-in with natural motion blur, reaching a tight frontal medium close-up as the performance begins. No cut before this moment.

4–8 SECONDS — FRONTAL CLOSE PERFORMANCE

Tight frontal medium close-up. She performs directly toward the lens with natural varied gestures.

The camera stays close, reacting to her forward movement with short pushes and recoils. Ceiling panels clearly shift between dark, dim and bright groups.

HARD CUT.

8–12 SECONDS — LOW-ANGLE PERFORMANCE

Low wide-angle medium shot near the floor. She remains large in frame, takes one purposeful step and leans toward the lens.

Use one strong handheld jolt, a brief horizon tilt and a fast correction.

WHIP CUT motivated by her movement.

12–16 SECONDS — SIDE STRUCTURE

Three-quarter side performance beside one monumental white acoustic structure.

The camera tracks diagonally closer while she turns toward the lens. The nearby structure shifts subtly once and the ceiling lighting continues changing.

HARD CUT.

16–20 SECONDS — EXTREME CLOSE PERFORMANCE

Frontal close-up with strong proximity.

The camera pushes close, recoils, briefly moves off-axis and recovers her face. Her performance remains natural, intense and varied.

End with a clean hard cut. No palm covering or touching the lens.

20–24 SECONDS — CUBE WALL PERFORMANCE

Close angled performance in front of the exact sculptural cube rear wall from image2.

The cube relief moves in broad connected mechanical waves with visible depth, weight and changing shadows. Nothing detaches or flies.

The camera stays close and handheld while she performs in front of the moving wall.

HARD CUT.

24–30 SECONDS — FINAL CLIMAX

Close hero performance at the exact cube rear wall. Move progressively closer throughout this final shot.

The cube wall, side structures and ceiling lighting reach their strongest controlled kinetic state while the studio remains physically intact.

The camera becomes more energetic with brief jolts, forward pressure and quick corrections, while keeping her face clear and dominant.

Near the end, she smoothly removes her sunglasses and reveals beautiful realistic eyes with subtle natural violet irises. No glow, emitted light or supernatural effects.

She holds direct eye contact for the final beat while the studio continues moving softly behind her.

End in a tight close portrait. No fade, no zoom-out and no empty environment shot.

LOCKS

Follow the stated shot order and framing.

Keep the artist visible, recognizable and dominant in every shot.

Use @ sound1  only as the fixed audio and performance-timing reference.

Do not include written lyrics anywhere in the generated video.

No additional audio of any kind.

No portal, black hole, fantasy reveal, studio destruction, flying cubes or detached fragments.

prompts.prompt:
Jan: tall slim, round red glasses, earpiece right ear, gloves, harness.
Tone: IMAX anamorphic 2x, golden hour. Hard low sun on wet concrete, deep blue shadows, backlight, horizontal blue flares, saturated epic grade. Never grey or flat.
CAMERA: low angle nearly every beat. Crash zooms, straight tracking, tilts. NEVER orbit or arc. Smooth motion, natural blur, 24fps, no stop motion. Jan never looks into the lens.
AUDIO: Renteria only by radio, thin, tinny, filtered, click each side. Jan answers out loud. SFX only: wind, rotor, rope, fabric. NO MUSIC, no subtitles.
0-6s Ground-level low angle, sun flare on puddles. Crash zoom to Jan's hands snapping the case shut, tilt up to earpiece and face, front to camera. Renteria, urgent: "Treinta segundos, Jan. Cincuenta referencias. Una sola toma. Tienes que mandarlo ya."
6-9s Low angle into the sun, camera tracks back ahead of Jan. He lifts the case: "Enterado. Voy por el." and runs.
9-12s Water-level low angle. Jan sprints over the camera, jumps a duct, gold spray on the lens. Renteria: "Cuando te subas, abres tu Capcot y lo generas ya."
12-15s Low angle on Duarte, rim lit. Crash zoom: "Pense que llegabas mas tarde."
15-18s Low angle, helicopter drops into a low hover, rotor wash blasting gold spray. Jan steps up through the door.
18-21s Cabin, over the shoulder behind Jan. He opens the case revealing the laptop, screen square to camera. Push in as he presses Generate.
21-25s Jan clips a rappel line to his harness, grips it with both gloved hands, kicks off the skid and swings out over the facade. Camera whips down with him into a fast controlled descent, boots striking the glass, sunlight tearing past.
25-30s Epic finale. Mid descent Jan yanks a second rope hard. The giant banner bursts open beside him and unrolls floor by floor, snapping taut. He lands on his feet in the plaza. Crash zoom out to a vast skyline wide, the full banner reading ESTO ES SEEDANCE 2.5 above him, helicopter rising into the sunburst.

prompts.prompt:
30-second cinematic aerial action spectacle, breathtaking high-budget feature film, ultra-dynamic editing, fluid aerial choreography, premium cinematic visuals, seamless kinetic camera movement, aggressive speed ramps, rapid match cuts, whip pans, rotating camera moves, dramatic perspective shifts, cinematic lens distortion, volumetric storm clouds, ocean spray, glowing tracer lights, smoke trails, sparks, flying debris, colossal scale, emotionally epic, no dialogue.

0–5s
Dark storm clouds gather above a vast open ocean.
A colossal armored battleship cuts through enormous waves.
Far above, a lone high-performance fighter aircraft emerges from the clouds.
Extreme close-ups.
Pilot visor.
Hands on the controls.
Jet intake vibrating.
Radar display glowing.
The camera alternates between immense aerial vistas and intimate cockpit shots.
Complete silence.

5–10s
The fighter rolls onto its wing and dives toward the ocean.
The camera races only meters from the aircraft before instantly switching to first-person cockpit views, impossible wing-mounted perspectives, sweeping aerial fly-bys and dramatic low-angle shots skimming above the waves.
The ship rapidly grows larger.
The engines reach full power.

10–15s
A breathtaking aerial montage.
The fighter slices between towering smoke columns and dense clouds.
Bright streams of tracer light streak across the sky.
The aircraft performs impossible barrel rolls, high-G turns and vertical climbs while the camera continuously rotates around the fuselage.
Speed ramps amplify every maneuver.

15–20s
The fighter skims just above the ocean surface.
Towering walls of spray rise behind it.
It climbs sharply over the battleship's deck in one uninterrupted shot.
The camera dives beneath the aircraft, then whips upward through drifting smoke, sparks and sunlight breaking through the storm.
Everything feels impossibly fast.

20–25s
The sequence reaches maximum intensity.
The aircraft circles the massive vessel at incredible speed.
Towering water plumes erupt around the ship.
Clouds swirl overhead.
The camera jumps between ultra-wide aerial compositions, intimate cockpit close-ups, spinning chase shots, dramatic slow-motion fly-bys and impossible orbiting movements around both aircraft and ship.
Every cut increases the spectacle.

25–30s
Everything suddenly slows.
The fighter climbs vertically through the storm clouds into brilliant sunlight.
Far below, the gigantic battleship disappears beneath drifting mist and shimmering ocean reflections.
The camera pulls rapidly upward into an immense aerial shot revealing endless sky and sea stretching to the horizon.

Hard cut to black.

Sound design: soaring cinematic orchestra, thunderous percussion, deep brass, roaring jet engines, rushing wind, ocean waves crashing against steel, atmospheric echoes, powerful fly-by whooshes, subtle sonic booms, cinematic bass swells, brief silence before the final climb, overwhelming orchestral finale.

prompts.prompt:
Create an intense 24-second boxing sequence in 10 shots.

The bulldog remains a hand-drawn 2D character inspired by 1969 American TV cartoons, keeping the same face, proportions, red gloves, and striped shorts. Never make him realistic. The human boxer remains fully photorealistic.

Style: heated live sports documentary broadcast. Handheld ringside cameras, reactive pans, imperfect reframing, small zoom corrections, natural shake, motion blur, focus breathing, faded 35mm colors, soft lens bloom, subtle gate weave, and naturally changing film grain. No frozen grain or fixed texture.

Strong white spotlights illuminate the ring. The crowd is darker but visible and constantly reacting. Crowd cheering continues from the first frame to the last: shouting, applause, whistles, and stomping. Reactions grow louder after major punches. An excited male English commentator speaks continuously. No music.

Each numbered shot is one continuous camera take. The camera may pan, track, dolly, or reframe, but must not jump to a new position inside the same shot.

Comic effects must resemble authentic 1969 American comics: imperfect hand-drawn lines, thick black outlines, red, yellow, white, and black colors, halftone dots, faded ink, and slight print misregistration.

Use effects sparingly:
SPEED LINES on fast punches.
One-frame SMEAR FRAME on the strongest punches.
Small IMPACT BURSTS on selected hits.
IMPACT FLASH and SHOCKWAVE RING only on the decisive counter and final uppercut.
WOBBLE LINES and yellow rotating stars only when the human is badly dazed.

Use only these comic sound effects on major clean hits:
THWACK! POW! SMACK! WHAM! CRACK!

SHOT 1 — 0.0–2.0
High-angle view of the packed arena. The ring is under strong spotlights. Both fighters wait in opposite corners. The bell rings, the crowd erupts, and both walk toward the center as the camera pushes closer.

SHOT 2 — 2.0–4.0
Slightly elevated wide shot from outside the ring with ropes in the foreground. The referee steps back. Both fighters raise their guards, circle, and test distance. The handheld camera tracks right.

SHOT 3 — 4.0–6.2
Low canvas-level angle. The bulldog throws a jab with brief SPEED LINES. The human narrowly avoids it and counters with a jab that the bulldog blocks. Quick natural pan. No comic text.

SHOT 4 — 6.2–8.8
Slightly high-angle shot through the ropes. The human attacks with a combination. A left jab lands with a small IMPACT BURST and THWACK! A right straight follows with POW!, a brief IMPACT FLASH, and a small burst. A left hook lands with only a subtle impact mark. The camera tracks as the bulldog retreats.

SHOT 5 — 8.8–11.2
Close handheld shot from the opposite side. The human keeps pressing with short punches. The bulldog blocks several and absorbs one body shot. The camera urgently reframes. The bulldog answers with a short face hook using a small red IMPACT BURST and SMACK!

SHOT 6 — 11.2–14.0
Over-the-shoulder from behind the human. The human throws a powerful right straight. The bulldog slips underneath. The camera pans with the missed glove. Without cutting, the bulldog plants his feet, rotates, and launches a right counterpunch with SPEED LINES and a one-frame SMEAR FRAME.

SHOT 7 — 14.0–16.8
Tight ringside impact shot. The bulldog’s right straight lands on the human’s cheek in very brief slow motion. His cheek compresses and sweat flies. At contact, show a large IMPACT BURST, white IMPACT FLASH, radial lines, short SHOCKWAVE RING, and WHAM! The effects vanish immediately. Return to normal speed as the human staggers backward. The crowd explodes.

SHOT 8 — 16.8–19.2
Slightly elevated ringside shot. The human is badly dazed but standing. WOBBLE LINES and three yellow stars briefly appear. The bulldog lands one body punch without text, then a short face hook with SPEED LINES, a small burst, and SMACK!

SHOT 9 — 19.2–21.5
Low diagonal ringside angle. The bulldog throws a compact uppercut with a one-frame SMEAR FRAME. It lands under the chin with IMPACT FLASH, red-yellow IMPACT BURST, short SHOCKWAVE RING, and CRACK! The human falls into the ropes, drops to one knee, and collapses safely. The referee stops the fight. The bulldog steps back. Yellow stars fade.

SHOT 10 — 21.5–24.0
Final slightly high-angle wide shot. The referee brings the bulldog to the center and raises one arm. Red-and-white paper streamers fly into the ring. Vintage photographers fire flashbulbs and strong white strobes. The crowd remains standing, shouting, clapping, whistling, and waving hats. The handheld camera slowly pushes closer until the final frame.

prompts.prompt:
Style:
Authentic late-1970s Mediterranean documentary captured on vintage 16mm Kodak film, naturally faded colors, subtle film grain, real optical imperfections, slight gate weave, shoulder-mounted handheld camera with imperfect human movement, soft vintage lenses, warm afternoon sunlight, realistic skin texture, no cinematic polish, feels like forgotten archival footage discovered decades later.

0–3 seconds:
A close handheld tracking shot follows a young woman in her 20s walking slowly through a narrow seaside alley lined with whitewashed houses, hanging linen curtains gently moving in the ocean breeze. She wears a simple linen dress, a woven shoulder bag, and naturally messy hair with no makeup. Instead of posing, she lightly brushes her fingertips across the textured walls while quietly observing everyday life around her.

3–7 seconds:
The camera naturally falls slightly behind her as she enters a tiny open courtyard where local people casually gather. An elderly man repairs a bicycle, someone waters colorful plants from a balcony above, laundry sways overhead, and a sleepy orange cat crosses directly in front of the lens. The camera subtly adjusts to avoid the cat, creating an authentic human reaction.

7–11 seconds:
A young child runs toward a rolling wooden toy that passes close to her feet. She instinctively bends down, catches it with one hand, smiles warmly, and hands it back without stopping her walk. The child laughs and runs away. No one performs for the camera; everything feels naturally observed.

11–15 seconds:
She reaches a small overlook facing the sparkling sea. Instead of stopping dramatically, she casually rests one elbow on an old stone railing while watching distant fishing boats. A gust of wind lifts loose strands of hair across her face. She gently moves them aside and continues walking out of frame as the handheld camera hesitates for a second before slowly following behind.

Image Quality:
Ultra-photorealistic vintage documentary, authentic analog exposure, realistic human motion, organic focus breathing, imperfect framing, Kodak 16mm archival texture, subtle light leaks, soft highlight bloom, natural skin pores, no AI smoothness, 4:3 aspect ratio.

生成完整 30 秒中国古风人物小传短片。
严格按照时间轴、多模态素材映射、人物隔离和参考音频执行，不自由修改镜头与剧情。
